fields.Damage: 1d10 Piercing + Strength modifier.
fields.Attack bonus: Strength modifier + Proficiency Bonus if proficient.
fields.Activation: Make a weapon attack. Apply the special power at its listed trigger or action cost.
fields.Special powers: On a natural 20 against a creature, the weapon lodges in it. A Medium or smaller target within 5 feet of a wall or solid object is also Restrained while the weapon remains embedded. At the end of each of the target’s turns, roll 1d10 Piercing damage with no modifiers. The target or another creature within reach can use an action to make a DC 13 Strength check, pulling the weapon free on a success. You can speak the command word to release it without an action.
fields.Conversion notes: Uses the 2024 Lance profile. The conversion uses the base weapon dice for the recurring damage, preserves the grip used for the embedding hit, and treats the command as a verbal release. You cannot attack with the weapon while it is embedded.
fields.Source locator: Kobold Press, Vault of Magic, p. 27.

fields.Special powers: While wearing this armor, your Hit Point maximum cannot be reduced. The armor itself is immune to Necrotic damage and rust. fields.Special powers: On a natural 20, the animated head lodges in the target. While you hold the lodged spear, the target is Grappled by you. You cannot attack with it while lodged. The target or another creature within reach can take an action and make a DC 15 Strength check to pull it out, dealing 1d6 Piercing damage to the target on a success. You can instead take a Magic action to command it loose, and it lands within 5 feet of the target.
fields.Conversion notes: Uses Grappled as specified by the original trigger. A thrown critical can lodge and deal the recurring damage, and the grapple requires holding the spear.

fields.Conversion notes: Keeps the +1 craftsmanship and permanent light as separate effects.
fields.Special powers: The spearhead sheds Bright Light within 30 feet and Dim Light for another 30 feet. It is a level 6 Continual Flame effect for purposes of dispelling and interaction with magical darkness.

fields.Damage: 1d6 Slashing + Strength modifier + 1 (1d8 with two hands).
fields.Attack bonus: Strength modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient.
fields.Activation: Make a weapon attack using the listed range.
fields.Source locator: Magical Items of Mystara, Alfheim, Serpent Blade.
fields.Conversion notes: Keeps the legacy weapon’s 1d6 + 1 damage profile without an attack enhancement. Adapts danger detection with a bounded area and recharge.
fields.Special powers: As a Magic action, focus on an object or a visible point within 30 feet. The blade glows if a trap or immediate physical hazard exists within 10 feet of that point or on the object. Brighter light indicates an imminent danger. This gives no direction or mechanism. Use it three times per dawn.

fields.Damage: 1d6 Piercing (1d8 with two hands in melee) + Strength modifier + 1.
fields.Attack bonus: Strength modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient, plus 1.
fields.Activation: Make a weapon attack using the listed range.
fields.Source locator: Magical Items of Mystara, Ierendi, Spear of Kobos.
fields.Conversion notes: Retains the +1 enhancement and the bonus against giant counterparts of ordinary animals.
fields.Special powers: Against a Beast that is a giant counterpart of an ordinary animal, use +3 instead of +1 on attack and damage rolls.

fields.Damage: 1d6 Piercing (1d8 with two hands in melee) + Strength modifier + 3.
fields.Attack bonus: Strength modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient, plus 3.
fields.Activation: Make a weapon attack using the listed range.
fields.Attunement: None; the curse binds on its own trigger.
fields.Source locator: Magical Items of Mystara, Sind, The Black Spear.
fields.Conversion notes: Applies the catalog’s 2024 Cursed Backbiter conversion to the source’s +3 version.
fields.Special powers: Before the first attack with the spear each turn, roll 1d20 against a threshold that starts at 1. On a roll at or below the threshold, the attack hits you instead and the threshold resets to 1. Take normal weapon damage, doubled if thrown. Otherwise resolve the attack normally and increase the threshold by 1, to a maximum of 20.
fields.Binding: After the first backbite, you cannot willingly part with the spear. When thrown it returns to you. Remove Curse breaks the binding and resets the threshold.

fields.Damage: 1d6 Piercing (1d8 with two hands in melee) + Strength modifier + 3.
fields.Attack bonus: Strength modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient, plus 3.
fields.Activation: Make a weapon attack using the listed range.
fields.Source locator: Emanuele Betti, Unique Magic Armors and Shields, PDF pp. 7–8.
fields.Conversion notes: Caps the legacy +6 at +3 and adds extra damage against sea creatures. Keeps the source’s return-on-miss rule.
fields.Special powers: On a hit against a creature native to the sea with a Swim Speed, add 2d6 Piercing damage. After a thrown attack misses, the spear returns to your free hand or lands at your feet.
fields.Sentience: Neutral; Intelligence 6, Wisdom 16, Charisma 17. It speaks telepathically with you and can initiate a sentient-item conflict if you knowingly separate it from Zargon’s Suit Plate or refuse to fight an immediate sea-monster threat.

fields.Source locator: Maganshire Resource Book, PDF p. 9, Centaur, Combat and Weapons.
fields.Special powers: This fitted suit covers a centaur’s upper body and equine torso. Wear it as one suit of Chain Mail. It gives no separate barding bonus.
fields.Commission: Commission it for a specific centaur. The source charges twice the price of comparable horse barding. Using 2024 Chain Mail barding, that is 600 gp for this configuration.
fields.Conversion notes: Uses a Chain Mail configuration for the source’s combined armor and barding. The weight uses the 2024 barding multiplier.

fields.Source locator: Cyclopaedic Compendium, Volume 2, PDF pp. 68 and 80, Sathar and Yazarian.
fields.Special powers: Connect a compatible charged pack and take a Utilize action to spend 1 charge. You can use AC 18 for the next 24 hours while wearing the suit and keeping the pack connected. Without power you can use AC 11 + Dexterity modifier.
fields.Conversion notes: The source gives descending AC 0 and an external power dependency. The daily rate borrows from Federation Battle Armour, and unpowered AC is an authored fallback.

fields.Source locator: Cyclopaedic Compendium, Volume 2, PDF p. 35, Dobhar-chú.
fields.Special powers: You have Disadvantage on Charisma checks to Influence mustelids such as otters, weasels, badgers, and ferrets while wearing this armor.
fields.Crafting: If the DM calls for an ability check to enchant this suit, add +1 to that check. Normal 2024 crafting time and material requirements still apply.
fields.Conversion notes: Uses ordinary Leather Armor protection. A +1 crafting check replaces the legacy five-point percentile advantage.

fields.Use as armor: Wondrous item. The helmet does not replace your base AC formula.
fields.Source locator: Gilles Leblanc, Magical Items of Mystara, Rockhome, Eagle Helmet.
fields.Special powers: While wearing the attuned helmet, add +2 to AC and saving throws. The AC bonus does not stack with a Ring or Cloak of Protection.
fields.Conversion notes: Preserves the source’s bonuses and uses attunement and a nonstacking rule to limit the combined protection.

fields.Use as armor: Wondrous item. May be worn alone or with Padded, Leather, or Studded Leather Armor, provided the suit has no other metal components beyond the studs. It counts as metal equipment.
fields.Source locator: Gilles Leblanc, Magical Items of Mystara, Thyatis, Magical Shoulder Plate.
fields.Special powers: While wearing the attuned plate in an eligible configuration, gain +1 AC. It does not change the base AC formula or confer armor training.
fields.Conversion notes: Keeps the separate +1 and the source restriction on wearing it over metal armor.

fields.Source locator: Gilles Leblanc, Magical Items of Mystara, Ierendi, Red Chain Mail.
fields.Special powers: While wearing the attuned armor, add +2 to saving throws against effects that deal Fire damage.
fields.Conversion notes: Preserves +2 Chain Mail and the distinct fire-related saving throw bonus.

fields.Special powers: Use the listed AC for all attack rolls, including firearms.
fields.Conversion notes: Uses Chain Mail protection, with about one-third of its weight. The listed Strength requirement and Stealth disadvantage use the Chain Mail baseline.
fields.Source locator: Cyclopaedic Compendium, Volume 2, PDF pp. 7 and 14, Armour descriptions and price table.

fields.Special powers: Use the listed AC for all attack rolls, including firearms.
fields.Conversion notes: Uses Plate Armor protection with half the 2024 weight. This is the full-body configuration.
fields.Source locator: Cyclopaedic Compendium, Volume 2, PDF pp. 7 and 14, Armour descriptions and price table.

fields.Special powers: As a Utilize action, spend 1 charge from a connected compatible pack to power the suit for 24 hours. While powered it provides AC 18. Without power, its AC is 11 + Dexterity modifier. Use one AC formula at a time.
fields.Environment mode: While powered, spend 1 additional charge per hour to ignore Extreme Heat and Extreme Cold and gain Resistance to damage from ambient radiation. Survival in a vacuum or underwater requires a compatible helmet and air supply.
fields.Conversion notes: Translates the powered and unpowered legacy ACs into separate formulas. Keeps the source’s external pack and distinct daily and hourly power rates.
fields.Source locator: Cyclopaedic Compendium, Volume 2, PDF pp. 7 and 14, Armour descriptions and price table.

fields.Use as armor: Clip the projector to your clothing. While powered, you may use AC 16 in place of your ordinary base AC. Apply any permitted Shield bonus separately.
fields.Special powers: Spend 1 charge from a connected compatible pack as a Utilize action to power the screen for seven days. When you would take damage while it is powered, you may use your Reaction to spend up to five additional charges. Reduce that damage by 5 per charge, to a minimum of 0.
fields.Conversion notes: Keeps the weekly passive charge and five points absorbed per charge. The Reaction limits the active protection to one damage event per round under normal combat rules.
fields.Source locator: Cyclopaedic Compendium, Volume 2, PDF pp. 7 and 14, Armour descriptions and price table.

fields.Use as armor: Wondrous garment. The suit provides no AC bonus. It can be used with the Ablative Screen, but not with Federation Battle Armour.
fields.Special powers: Take a Utilize action and spend charges from a connected compatible pack to activate one mode. Activating a different mode ends the current one. Removing the suit or disconnecting the pack ends the active mode.
fields.Invisibility: 1 charge for 1 hour. You gain the Invisible condition. Attacking or casting does not end the effect, but sound and other clues can reveal your location.
fields.Disguise: 2 charges for 1 hour. Project a recorded creature or object up to 3 feet taller or shorter than you. Physical contact reveals mismatched contours. A creature examining the projection can use a Study action and a DC 15 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern it. The suit can store up to 12 saved appearances.
fields.Displacement: 1 charge for 1 minute. Gain the Invisible condition and project your image in an unoccupied space within 5 feet. Attack rolls against you have Disadvantage while the projection is active unless the attacker can see you.
fields.Conversion notes: Keeps the three source modes and their different charge rates. Uses the Invisible condition and a Study check for the optical effects.
fields.Source locator: Cyclopaedic Compendium, Volume 2, PDF pp. 7 and 14, Armour descriptions and price table.
Cyclopaedic Compendium, Volume 2, PDF p. 14, Modern Armour table.
fields.Special powers: While wielding the shield with Shield training, gain +2 AC.
fields.Source value: 30 gp equivalent in the source table.
fields.Conversion notes: Uses published Shield statistics for the modern riot shield. The source gives the standard shield protection.

fields.Source locator: Cyclopaedic Compendium, Volume 2, PDF pp. 7 and 14, Power Shield and High Tech Armour table.
fields.Special powers: As a Utilize action, spend 1 charge from a connected compatible power pack to project a shield for 1 hour. While active, it grants +2 AC if you have Shield training and keep the hand on the projector arm free. It counts as wielding a Shield and its bonus cannot stack with another Shield.
fields.Power supply: External power pack. The projector stores no charges and does not recharge itself.
fields.Source value: 500 gp equivalent in the source table, excluding the power pack.
fields.Conversion notes: Keeps the wrist-mounted projector, one-hour duration, and external charge. The free-hand requirement uses the normal 2024 shield trade-off.

fields.Source locator: Cyclopaedic Compendium, Volume 2, PDF p. 63, Octospider equipment.
fields.Special powers: As a Utilize action while wielding the shield, turn the field on or off. While active and wielded by an attuned creature with Shield training, it adds +2 AC and grants Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage from attacks made with nonmagical, non-technological weapons.
fields.Conversion notes: Preserves the DNA lock. Uses the standard shield AC bonus and replaces mundane-weapon immunity with Resistance. Magical and technological weapons bypass this Resistance.

fields.Source locator: Cyclopaedic Compendium, Volume 2, PDF p. 78, Vrusk equipment.
fields.Use as armor: Protective implement. Hold it in one hand. It grants no AC bonus and does not count as wielding a Shield.
fields.Special powers: As a Utilize action while holding the device, activate its inertial field for 1 minute. At the start of each of your turns while active, roll 4d6 to set a new absorption pool. Roll once when activating it as well. Damage you take first reduces the pool point for point. Remaining damage affects you normally. Any unused pool expires at the start of your next turn or when the field ends.
fields.Recharge: Once activated, the field cannot be activated again until the next dawn. It ends early if you release the device.
fields.Conversion notes: Keeps the legacy 4d6 absorption per round and lack of AC. The activation duration and recharge are conversion choices.

fields.Special powers: Add +2 AC while wielding the shield with Shield training.
fields.Source locator: Extended Equipment List, PDF p. 4, Armour, Shield.
fields.Conversion notes: Use the published 2024 Shield. Its +2 bonus replaces the descending-AC adjustment.

fields.Special powers: Use the listed Armor Class while wearing the armor.
fields.Source locator: Extended Equipment List, PDF p. 4, Armour, Leather Armour.
fields.Conversion notes: Use the published 2024 Leather Armor and its full Dexterity modifier.

fields.Special powers: Use the listed Armor Class while wearing the armor.
fields.Source locator: Extended Equipment List, PDF p. 4, Armour, Scale.
fields.Conversion notes: Use the published 2024 Scale Mail and its Dexterity cap.

fields.Special powers: Use the listed Armor Class while wearing the armor.
fields.Source locator: Extended Equipment List, PDF p. 4, Armour, Chain (Mail).
fields.Conversion notes: Use the published 2024 Chain Mail.

fields.Special powers: Use the listed Armor Class while wearing the armor.
fields.Source locator: Extended Equipment List, PDF p. 4, Armour, Banded.
fields.Conversion notes: Use the published 2024 Splint Armor as the closest comparison for overlapping metal bands.

fields.Special powers: Use the listed Armor Class while wearing the armor.
fields.Source locator: Extended Equipment List, PDF p. 4, Armour, Plate.
fields.Conversion notes: Use Splint Armor for the legacy mail reinforced with large plates. The source distinguishes this from the fully enclosed Suit Armour.

fields.Special powers: While wearing the armor, when you take Acid, Cold, Fire, or Poison damage from an effect that covers an area, you can use your Reaction to reduce that damage by your Proficiency Bonus.
fields.Source locator: Extended Equipment List, PDF p. 4, Armour, Suit.
fields.Conversion notes: Uses full Plate AC and translates the legacy area protection and movement restrictions into modern rules.
fields.Mobility: On foot your Speed is reduced by 10 feet, in addition to any penalty from failing the Strength requirement. Standing from Prone costs all your movement unless an adjacent ally spends a Reaction to assist, in which case it costs the normal amount.
fields.Fitting: The suit must be fitted to its wearer. Donning takes 10 minutes and doffing takes 5 minutes.

fields.Special powers: Wield with Shield training for +2 AC. The AC bonus is suspended from the first attack you make with the shield until the start of your next turn.
fields.Source locator: Extended Equipment List, PDF p. 3, Extended Weapon and Armour Lists, Shield, Horned.
fields.Conversion notes: Uses the 2024 Shield’s defensive bonus and a defined offensive mode. The attack dice and breakage trigger are conversion choices informed by the two legacy references.
fields.Shield attack: 1d4 Piercing, reach 5 feet. Add Strength to the attack roll and add Proficiency Bonus if you have Shield training. Add Strength to damage except where the Light property says otherwise. Use the shield as a Light melee weapon. When you attack with another Light weapon as part of the Attack action, you can make the shield attack as the Light property’s Bonus Action attack. Apply the normal Light damage-modifier rule.

fields.Special powers: Wield with Shield training for +2 AC. The AC bonus is suspended from the first attack you make with the shield until the start of your next turn.
fields.Source locator: Extended Equipment List, PDF p. 3, Extended Weapon and Armour Lists, Shield, Knife.
fields.Conversion notes: Uses the 2024 Shield’s defensive bonus and a defined offensive mode. The attack dice and breakage trigger are conversion choices informed by the two legacy references.
fields.Shield attack: 1d4 + 1 Slashing, reach 5 feet. Add Strength to the attack roll and add Proficiency Bonus if you have Shield training. Add Strength to damage except where the Light property says otherwise. Use the shield as a Light melee weapon. When you attack with another Light weapon as part of the Attack action, you can make the shield attack as the Light property’s Bonus Action attack. Apply the normal Light damage-modifier rule.
fields.Breakage: On a natural 1 when attacking with the shield, its striking fitting breaks. It still grants its normal defensive AC. Replacing the fitting takes 1 hour with Smith’s Tools and 5 gp in materials.

fields.Special powers: Wield with Shield training for +2 AC. The AC bonus is suspended from the first attack you make with the shield until the start of your next turn.
fields.Source locator: Extended Equipment List, PDF p. 3, Extended Weapon and Armour Lists, Shield, Sword.
fields.Conversion notes: Uses the 2024 Shield’s defensive bonus and a defined offensive mode. The attack dice and breakage trigger are conversion choices informed by the two legacy references.
fields.Shield attack: 1d6 Slashing, reach 5 feet. Add Strength to the attack roll and add Proficiency Bonus if you have Shield training. Add Strength to damage except where the Light property says otherwise. Use the shield for one melee weapon attack as part of the Attack action.
fields.Breakage: On a natural 1 when attacking with the shield, its striking fitting breaks. It still grants its normal defensive AC. Replacing the fitting takes 1 hour with Smith’s Tools and 5 gp in materials.

fields.Special powers: Wield with Shield training for +2 AC. The AC bonus is suspended from the first attack you make with the shield until the start of your next turn.
fields.Source locator: Extended Equipment List, PDF p. 3, Extended Weapon and Armour Lists, Shield, Tusked.
fields.Conversion notes: Uses the 2024 Shield’s defensive bonus and a defined offensive mode. The attack dice and breakage trigger are conversion choices informed by the two legacy references.
fields.Shield attack: 1d6 Piercing, reach 5 feet. Add Strength to the attack roll and add Proficiency Bonus if you have Shield training. Add Strength to damage except where the Light property says otherwise. You must hold the shield with both hands. When you attack with it as part of the Attack action, you can make one additional shield attack as a Bonus Action.
fields.Breakage: On a natural 1 when attacking with the shield, its striking fitting breaks. It still grants its normal defensive AC. Replacing the fitting takes 1 hour with Smith’s Tools and 5 gp in materials.

fields.Special powers: While wearing this attuned suit, your AC is 21. Its adamantium construction is the source of its unusually strong protection.
fields.Source locator: Emanuele Betti, Unique Magic Armors and Shields, PDF p. 19, Castle Suit Armor.
fields.Conversion notes: Uses the published +3 Plate Armor ceiling for the legacy +7 suit. The source gives it no separate combat power.
fields.History: The fan account traces the shell to Adamantart and the armor to the Empire of Millennia.

fields.Special powers: While wearing the attuned coat, you have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to Hide or move quietly, and on Wisdom (Survival) checks to track creatures. Your footsteps are silent. Sounds you cause by interacting with objects remain audible.
fields.Source locator: Emanuele Betti, Unique Magic Armors and Shields, PDF p. 13, Hunter's Coat.
fields.Conversion notes: Replaces legacy percentile bonuses with Advantage and models improved aim with a stationary shot.
fields.Aim: As a Bonus Action, if you have not moved on this turn, gain Advantage on your next ranged weapon attack roll this turn. Your Speed becomes 0 until the end of the turn.
fields.History: Attributed to an Ethengarian shaman in the fan account.

fields.Special powers: While wearing the attuned coat, you have Cold Resistance and ignore the effects of Extreme Cold.
fields.Source locator: Emanuele Betti, Unique Magic Armors and Shields, PDF p. 6, Polar Coat.
fields.Conversion notes: Uses +3 Leather Armor for the fur coat and replaces the legacy cold damage adjustments with Cold Resistance.
fields.Control Arctic beast: Once per dawn, cast Dominate Beast as a Magic action (DC 16 Wisdom, Concentration up to 1 minute). Choose one Beast native to a snowy or frozen environment within the spell’s normal range.

fields.Special powers: The shield requires Strength 15 to wield. While wielding it with Shield training, add +3 AC total. Reduce Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage from a nonmagical attack that hits you by 1, to a minimum of 0.
fields.Source locator: Emanuele Betti, Unique Magic Armors and Shields, PDF p. 16, The Ram.
fields.Conversion notes: Retains the +1 enhancement and nonmagical damage reduction. Uses a once-per-turn bonus die for the legacy charge.
fields.Charge: Once per turn, when you move at least 40 feet straight toward a creature on foot and immediately hit it with a melee weapon attack, add 1d8 damage of the weapon’s type.

fields.Special powers: While wearing the attuned armor, gain Advantage on Charisma checks to Influence Undead. An attuned Cleric who is Chaotic adds 2 to the saving throw DC of Turn Undead.
fields.Source locator: Emanuele Betti, Unique Magic Armors and Shields, PDF p. 10, Sematary.
fields.Conversion notes: Uses Splint Armor for banded mail, represents the legacy Dark element as Necrotic damage, and preserves the post-death transformation as a DM-controlled consequence.
fields.Dark absorption: When you would take Necrotic damage while wearing the armor, take none and regain Hit Points equal to that damage, up to your maximum.
fields.Undeath: If you die while wearing it, after 1d4 rounds your body rises as a DM-controlled Undead. The DM chooses a stat block with CR no higher than half your level, rounded down. This transformation is permanent and is not a resurrection.

fields.Special powers: While wearing the attuned armor, you gain a Swim Speed equal to your walking Speed. Its normal Strength requirement still applies.
fields.Source locator: Emanuele Betti, Unique Magic Armors and Shields, PDF p. 7, Zargon's Suit Plate.
fields.Conversion notes: Keeps the +3, swimming, and connection to the spear. Uses sentient-item conflict instead of automatic loss of character control.
fields.Sentience: Neutral armor, Intelligence 9, Wisdom 16, Charisma 14. It communicates telepathically with its wearer and wants to reunite with the returning spear and rescue people lost at sea.
fields.Separated pair: If the spear is on the same plane, once per dawn you can take a Magic action to sense its general direction. The armor can initiate a sentient-item conflict if you knowingly separate the pair or refuse a rescue.
fields.History: The fan account places the lost armor aboard Zargon’s ship in the Sea of Dawn.

mystara-fan-names-reference:a6a5ba9e66ed.label: D&D 2024 adaptation · Mail of the Prophet

fields.Special powers: While attuned and wearing both the mail and its matching helm, you have Immunity to Radiant damage. If you are a Lawful Cleric or Paladin with Turn Undead, increase that ability’s save DC by 3. Without the matching helm, the mail provides AC 19 and its set powers are dormant.
fields.Source locator: Emanuele Betti, Unique Magic Armors and Shields, PDF p. 22, Mail of the Prophet.
fields.Conversion notes: Caps the legacy +4 at +3 for the complete set. Models Holy damage as Radiant and preserves the paired-item requirement.
fields.Set powers: With both pieces worn, take a Magic action to regain 2d6 + 2 Hit Points, or cast Haste on yourself. Each power recharges separately at dawn. Haste uses its normal Concentration and duration.
fields.Matching helm: The source pairs this suit with a helm of Truesight and Detect Lies. The listed AC 21 is for the mail in the complete set before the helm’s own bonus.
fields.History: Attributed to Suleiman Al-Kalim in the fan account.

fields.Source locator: Emanuele Betti, Unique Magic Armors and Shields, PDF p. 15, Robe of Zanar.
fields.Use as armor: Wondrous garment. While attuned and wearing no armor, your base AC is 14 + Dex modifier.
fields.Special powers: While wearing the attuned robe, you understand, speak, read, and write any language you hear or read except languages reserved for Immortals. You can cast Fly on yourself three times per dawn and Identify once per dawn. Use normal casting times and Concentration.
fields.Arcane memories: If you have Spellcasting, roll 1d20 after a Long Rest. On a 20, the DM chooses one spell from your class list of a level you can cast. You can cast it once before your next Long Rest without expending a spell slot, using your spellcasting ability and any costly components. You cannot copy it from this memory.
fields.Conversion notes: Uses an unarmored formula to represent the legacy +4 silk tunic. Preserves its spell, language, and memory powers.

mystara-fan-names-reference:5975fca56449.label: D&D 2024 adaptation · Armor of the Night

fields.Special powers: While wearing the attuned armor, you have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in Dim Light or Darkness. You also have Advantage on Stealth checks to avoid being heard.
fields.Source locator: Emanuele Betti, Unique Magic Armors and Shields, PDF p. 23, Armor of the Night.
fields.Conversion notes: Replaces percentile stealth bonuses with Advantage and retains both stages of the hood’s illusion.
fields.Faceless hood: Raise or lower the hood as a Bonus Action. While raised, your head appears absent inside the hood. If another creature forcibly pulls it down, your face appears monstrous until you raise the hood again. Truesight sees your actual face.
fields.History: Worn by the guildmaster of the thieves’ guild in Selenica.

fields.Special powers: After taking Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Necrotic, Poison, Radiant, or Thunder damage while wearing the jacket, you can take a Reaction to gain Resistance to one triggering type for 2d12 hours. The triggering damage is resolved first. The jacket supports one adaptation at a time. Choosing another type ends the previous one.
fields.Source locator: Emanuele Betti, Unique Magic Armors and Shields, PDF p. 14, Automatic Jacket.
fields.Conversion notes: Uses Resistance in place of repeated immunity. Retains the reactive trigger, duration roll, and exclusion of ordinary physical attacks.
fields.History: The fan account links the jacket’s moving gears to a Blackmoor-era design and places it in Serraine.

fields.Special powers: The emerald holds five charges. When a curse would affect you while wearing the attuned armor, you can expend 1 charge to prevent that curse from affecting you. No action is required. The emerald cracks at 0 charges and never regains them. The armor retains its AC.
fields.Source locator: Emanuele Betti, Unique Magic Armors and Shields, PDF p. 17, Paladin Mail.
fields.Conversion notes: Keeps the finite curse ward separate from the daily spell. Preserves the source’s class or alignment gate for the holy power.
fields.Holy power: If you are a Cleric, a Paladin, or Lawful, you can cast one level 1 spell from the Cleric list per dawn while wearing the armor. Use Wisdom, the spell’s normal casting time, and any costly components.

mystara-fan-names-reference:890d98f62dfc.label: D&D 2024 adaptation · Armor of the Wounds

fields.Special powers: The suit appears to be +3 Leather Armor. Truesight reveals the curse. It binds when donned, and while bound you cannot doff it. After you take damage from another source, take an extra 1d6 Necrotic damage that ignores Resistance and Immunity. The extra damage does not trigger itself.
fields.Source locator: Emanuele Betti, Unique Magic Armors and Shields, PDF p. 18, Armor of the Wounds.
fields.Conversion notes: Translates the legacy −3 into a −3 adjustment to the Leather Armor formula. Keeps the deception, binding, wound trigger, and adventure-specific release.
fields.Curse relief: Wish can suppress the extra damage for 24 hours. The curse ends permanently when a wearer from Clan Feadiel helps save the Sylvan Realm from Moorkroft.
fields.Restored form: After permanent release it becomes +3 Leather Armor (AC 14 + Dex modifier). While wearing it, take a Magic action to heal yourself for 3d6 + 2 HP or gain Truesight out to 60 feet for 10 minutes. Each power recharges separately at dawn.

fields.Special powers: While wearing the attuned armor, you can speak, read, and write Draconic. You have Lightning Resistance against Blue Dragon breath. Once per dawn, take a Magic action to cast Invisibility on yourself for up to 1 hour with Concentration.
fields.Source locator: Emanuele Betti, Unique Magic Armors and Shields, PDF p. 20, Kryll's Mail.
fields.Conversion notes: Caps the legacy +4 at +3. Uses a Young Blue Dragon as the possession form and gates it to level 9 to limit access to a high-CR stat block.
fields.Dragon possession: If you are level 9 or higher and start your turn conscious with fewer than 10% of your maximum Hit Points, roll 1d10. On a 1, your equipment merges into a Young Blue Dragon form for 2d10 rounds. The DM controls the dragon. Use its stat block and Hit Points. When it reaches 0 HP or the duration ends, return to your own form with 1 HP and fall Unconscious until the end of your next turn. After transforming, this property recharges after seven dawns.

mystara-fan-names-reference:b997e66a0271.label: D&D 2024 adaptation · Plate Mail of the Lions

fields.Special powers: Nonhostile feline Beasts are Friendly toward you while you wear the attuned armor. They decide whether to help. Once per dawn, take a Magic action to become a silver Lion for up to 3 hours. Your gear merges into the form. Use the Lion stat block and gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your level, up to 12. You retain your own Hit Points. Revert as a Bonus Action, when the duration ends, or if you become Incapacitated.
fields.Source locator: Emanuele Betti, Unique Magic Armors and Shields, PDF p. 3, Plate Mail of the Lions.
fields.Conversion notes: Uses the 2024 Lion stat block, Temporary Hit Points, and a bounded curse instead of scaling legacy Hit Dice and AC.
fields.Feline curse: If you deliberately harm or trap a feline Beast while wearing the armor, it falls away and you become a Lion for up to one year. You cannot end this form voluntarily. Use the same form rules without Temporary Hit Points. Remove Curse ends this transformation early.
fields.History: Formerly worn by the Thyatian commander Marcus Terentius Iulius.

fields.Special powers: While wielding the attuned shield, you can take a Magic action to project terror. Each other creature of your choice within 60 feet that can see you makes a DC 17 Wisdom save. On a failure it is Frightened of you for 1 minute and can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns. This power recharges at dawn.
fields.Source locator: Emanuele Betti, Unique Magic Armors and Shields, PDF p. 12, Shield of Alphaks.
fields.Conversion notes: Caps the legacy +4 at +3. Converts constant terror into a daily activation. Keeps the new-moon curse and the shield’s hostility toward Lawful wielders.
fields.Curse: Once per new moon, take a Magic action to cast Bestow Curse on a creature within 10 feet (DC 17 Wisdom). It lasts until removed without Concentration. A Lawful wielder takes 2d6 Necrotic damage at the start of each turn while wielding the shield.
fields.History: Crafted by the Black King and Black Queen on Alphaks Volcano for their Black General.

fields.Special powers: When a spell would first affect you while you wield the attuned shield, roll 1d4. On 2–4, the spell has no effect on you for its duration. Other targets and the rest of its area are unaffected. This also applies to beneficial spells. You can stop wielding the shield before receiving a spell.
fields.Source locator: Emanuele Betti, Unique Magic Armors and Shields, PDF p. 9, Shield of Gemstones.
fields.Conversion notes: Caps the legacy +5 at +3 and translates the 75% chance to a d4. Preserves encounter risk and the ruby’s material value as a source estimate.
fields.Encounter risk: While the shield travels with the party, add one additional triggering face to each random-encounter die, up to the die’s maximum. After a year, recurring nightmares begin. Defeating Arik ends the encounter effect and nightmares.
fields.Source material value: 200,000 gp for the materials alone in the fan source. This is a legacy figure.
fields.History: A ruby linked to Arik sits at the center of the shield.

fields.Attunement: Required by a Lawful Good creature.
fields.Special powers: While wielding the attuned shield, make two independent saves against a Dragon’s breath weapon when it normally allows a save. For each success halve the damage, rounding down after each reduction. For effects other than damage, use the first save only. Apply Resistance normally after the reductions.
fields.Source locator: Emanuele Betti, Unique Magic Armors and Shields, PDF p. 4, Virtue Shield.
fields.Conversion notes: Caps the legacy +4 at +3. Keeps two independent saves and translates empathic demands into a defined sentient-item conflict.
fields.Sentience: Lawful Good shield, Intelligence 9, Wisdom 16, Charisma 14. It communicates emotions to its attuned wielder and urges them to protect people in danger.
fields.Detect lies: While wielding it, take a Magic action to cast Zone of Truth at will (DC 15 Charisma). If you knowingly speak a lie while wielding it, take 1d6 + 1 Psychic damage. This damage can occur once per turn.

fields.Special powers: When you roll Initiative while wearing the attuned armor and facing a hostile Humanoid, enter a frenzy. During it, gain +2 to melee weapon attack rolls against Humanoids. On your turns, move toward and attack the nearest creature you can perceive, including an ally, breaking ties randomly. Dash toward it if you cannot reach it. After no conscious hostile creature remains within 60 feet, make a DC 15 Wisdom save at the end of each of your turns to end the frenzy.
fields.Source locator: Emanuele Betti, Unique Magic Armors and Shields, PDF p. 5, Crimson Mail.
fields.Conversion notes: Keeps the legacy bonus, nearest-target compulsion, recovery save, and limited healing. The conversion represents the original alignment change as the armor’s ongoing influence.
fields.Bloodlust: While wearing the armor, take a Magic action to drink blood from a creature you slew within the last minute and regain 1d6 + 1 Hit Points. A corpse can fuel this power only once.
fields.History: Made by Atzanteotl in Aengmor. The fan account places it with Hool of Red Orcland.

fields.Special powers: While wearing the attuned armor you are immune to Frightened and Radiant damage, and have Resistance to Necrotic damage. If you are Chaotic, take 1d6 Fire damage at the start of each turn while wearing it.
fields.Source locator: Emanuele Betti, Unique Magic Armors and Shields, PDF p. 21, Mail of Ranwood.
fields.Conversion notes: Uses Splint as the base for banded mail and caps the legacy +4 at +3. Represents Light and Dark damage with Radiant and Necrotic.
fields.Light: As a Bonus Action, set the topaz bands to off, Dim Light within 10 feet, Bright Light within 30 feet, or Bright Light within 60 feet. The Bright Light settings also shed Dim Light for an equal distance beyond.
fields.History: Forged in Ranwood, Vestland, for a champion devoted to Odin.

fields.Special powers: While wearing the attuned armor, you can breathe underwater and gain a Swim Speed equal to your walking Speed. The suit is weightless while fully submerged, and its Strength requirement and Stealth disadvantage do not apply while submerged.
fields.Source locator: Emanuele Betti, Unique Magic Armors and Shields, PDF p. 11, Wave Mail.
fields.Conversion notes: Caps the legacy +5 at +3. Defines protection against water magic by an explicit trigger, since 2024 rules have no Water damage type.
fields.Water ward: You have Advantage on saves against spells and magical effects that create, move, or weaponize water. You have Resistance to Bludgeoning damage dealt by those effects.
fields.History: A rumored treasure of the Old Man of the Sea, said to be guarded by Leviathan.

fields.Activation: While holding the staff, expend charges to cast a spell using your spell save DC, normal casting time and Concentration.

fields.Dispelling: For an ongoing spell, resolve Dispel Magic as a level 3 spell (spellcasting ability check +5 against DC 10 + spell level for a spell of level 4 or higher). A touched potion or spell scroll is destroyed. A non-artifact permanent magic item loses its magical properties for 1d4 rounds.

fields.Conversion notes: Preserves the single-target touch and limited charges. Artifacts are excluded from suppression. Applies the 2024 dispel check to higher-level spells.

gaz13-online-adaptation-reference:3027c5.label: D&D 2024 adaptation · Ancient Azcan Snake Staff

fields.Damage: 1d6 Bludgeoning (1d8 with two hands) + Strength modifier + 1.
fields.Attack bonus: Strength modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient, plus 1.
fields.Range: 5 feet melee. Spells use their own ranges.

fields.Activation: When you hit a Medium or smaller creature with the staff, you can command it to transform as part of the attack. The target makes a DC 15 Strength save. On a failure it is Grappled and Restrained by the snake for up to 1 minute.
fields.Snake form: The snake has AC 15 and 20 Hit Points. It stays in the target’s space, has no actions, and deals no further damage. The target can use an action to make a DC 15 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check to escape. You can release it as a Bonus Action within 60 feet.
fields.Reversion: When the target escapes, you release it, or the duration ends, the snake reverts in its space and fully heals. If the snake reaches 0 Hit Points, the staff is destroyed.
fields.Charges: None.
fields.Conversion notes: Keeps the legacy Snake Staff’s on-hit restraint and destruction risk. GAZ13 explicitly lets the non-Cleric Xatapechtli use it, so this adaptation has no class gate.

fields.Spell wards: At character level 1, you are immune to Charm Person and Sleep. At level 3, add Hold Person. At level 9, add Hold Monster. At level 11, add Magic Jar. At level 15, add Befuddlement, the 2024 counterpart to Feeblemind.

fields.History: The sword passes through Garafaele’s family, with its protections revealed as the wielder gains experience.

fields.Black lightning: Twice per dawn, release a 100-foot Line, 5 feet wide, originating from you. Each creature in the Line makes a DC 17 Dexterity save, taking 12d6 Lightning damage on a failure or half on a success. This lightning sheds no light.
fields.Darkness: Each creature that takes Lightning damage from the Line also makes a DC 17 Constitution save. On a failure, it has the Blinded condition until the end of its next turn.

fields.Conversion notes: Preserves the +1 to attack and damage. Uses the 2024 bow profiles and modern magic ammunition rules.
fields.Shortbow form: Simple ranged. Ammunition (arrows), Two-Handed, Vex, 2 lb.

fields.Damage: 1d8 Piercing + Dexterity modifier, or use Strength instead of Dexterity for damage if you meet the rating.
fields.Attack bonus: Dexterity modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient.
fields.Activation: Make a weapon attack using the listed range. Expend one piece of ammunition per attack.
fields.Conversion notes: The source requires a bow made for a strong archer to benefit from Strength. This conversion uses Dexterity to aim and Strength in place of Dexterity for damage when you meet the rating.
fields.Special powers: At commissioning, set the Strength rating to 13, 15, or 17. An archer whose Strength equals or exceeds it may use their Strength modifier for damage. Heavy still requires Dexterity 13 to avoid its normal Disadvantage.

fields.Damage: 1d4 Bludgeoning + Strength modifier.
fields.Attack bonus: Strength modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient.
fields.Activation: Make a weapon attack using the listed range.
fields.Conversion notes: The legacy jousting lance has reduced damage. This tournament conversion uses a blunted tip and keeps the reach and mounted handling of the 2024 Lance.
fields.Special powers: When the hit would reduce a creature to 0 Hit Points, you can instead leave it with 1 Hit Point and give it the Unconscious condition under the normal knockout rules.

fields.Damage: 1d8 Piercing. Add your Dexterity modifier.
fields.Attack bonus: Dexterity modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient.
fields.Range: 80/320 feet in air. Underwater, 40 feet maximum.
fields.Activation: Make a weapon attack using the listed range. Expend one piece of ammunition per attack.
fields.Conversion notes: The legacy aquatic design halves range underwater. This adaptation offsets the 2024 underwater Disadvantage within the shortened range.
fields.Special powers: When making a ranged attack underwater, ignore the Disadvantage imposed by underwater combat against a target within 40 feet. Attacks beyond 40 feet automatically miss underwater.

fields.Damage: 1d8 Slashing plus Strength modifier and its current magic bonus. Use 1d10 with two hands.
fields.Attack bonus: Strength modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient, with its current magic bonus applied.
fields.Activation: Make a melee weapon attack. See Special powers for triggers and exceptions.
fields.Special powers: While held, the sword starts at +1. At the end of a turn in which you attacked with it, advance to the next stage: +2, +3, then +3 to attack and +4 to damage. After the fourth stage it returns to +1. On your next turn, you can then release it as a Bonus Action. While dancing it hovers within 30 feet of you. On release, and as a Bonus Action on each of your next three turns, you can move it up to 30 feet to a space within 30 feet of you and make one melee attack against a target within 5 feet of it, using your normal modifiers. Each dancing turn uses the next bonus stage in the same sequence. It cannot make Opportunity Attacks. At the end of the fourth turn, if you are Incapacitated, or if you end a turn without using its dancing attack, it returns to a free hand or falls in its space and resets to +1. If you move more than 30 feet away, it immediately falls in its space and resets to +1. Use it in hand through four more attack turns before releasing it again.
fields.Legacy source: AD&D 2e Dungeon Master Guide, Appendix 3, Sword of Dancing.
fields.Conversion notes: Retains the four-stage attack cycle and four-turn dance. The fourth stage’s attack bonus is capped at +3 and the autonomous attacks use Bonus Actions. Uses a 2024 Longsword as the default form.
fields.Dancing range: The sword can move up to 30 feet per use, remain within 30 feet of you, and attack within 5 feet of its position.

dmg-2e-reference:4f291977ed5d9c72.label: D&D 2024 adaptation · Sword of Life Stealing

fields.Damage: 1d8 Slashing plus Strength modifier and +2. Use 1d10 with two hands.
fields.Attack bonus: Strength modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient, with +2 applied.
fields.Activation: Make a melee weapon attack. See Special powers for triggers and exceptions.
fields.Special powers: When you roll a natural 20 on an attack against a living creature that is neither Undead nor Construct, it takes an extra 15 Necrotic damage. You regain Hit Points equal to the Necrotic damage it takes, up to your Hit Point maximum.
fields.Legacy source: AD&D 2e Dungeon Master Guide, Appendix 3, Sword of Life Stealing.
fields.Conversion notes: Keeps the +2, natural-20 life drain and real healing. Replaces the loss of a level or Hit Die with the 2024 counterpart’s fixed Necrotic damage. Uses a 2024 Longsword as the default form.

fields.Damage: 1d8 Slashing plus Strength modifier and +1. Use 1d10 with two hands.
fields.Attack bonus: Strength modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient, with +1 applied.
fields.Activation: Make a melee weapon attack. See Special powers for triggers and exceptions.
fields.Special powers: When you roll a natural 20 against a creature, add 14 Slashing damage and it gains 1 level of Exhaustion. In a campaign with minimum magic-enhancement thresholds, the sword counts as +3 solely for meeting that threshold. As a Bonus Action while holding it, choose no light, Dim Light to 5 feet, Bright Light to 15 feet, or Bright Light to 30 feet. Each bright setting sheds Dim Light for the same distance beyond its bright radius.
fields.Legacy source: AD&D 2e Dungeon Master Guide, Appendix 3, Sword of Sharpness.
fields.Conversion notes: Retains +1, the legacy +3 eligibility threshold and selectable light. Uses the 2024 Sword of Sharpness’s damage and Exhaustion in place of permanent limb loss. Uses a 2024 Longsword as the default form.

fields.Damage: 1d8 Slashing plus Strength modifier and +1. Use 1d10 with two hands.
fields.Attack bonus: Strength modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient, with +1 applied.
fields.Activation: Make a melee weapon attack. See Special powers for triggers and exceptions.
fields.Special powers: On a hit against a creature, inflict a wound. At the start of each of its turns it takes 1 Necrotic damage per open wound, and its Hit Point maximum decreases by the Necrotic damage it takes. Each wound stops after 10 rounds, or all wounds stop if the creature or an ally within 5 feet spends an action and succeeds on a DC 15 Wisdom (Medicine) check to bandage them. A Long Rest restores Hit Point maximum lost to these wounds. Regeneration and other healing cannot raise current Hit Points above the reduced maximum. Wish can also restore the Hit Point maximum lost to these wounds.
fields.Legacy source: AD&D 2e Dungeon Master Guide, Appendix 3, Sword of Wounding.
fields.Conversion notes: Keeps the +1, stacking one-point wounds and ten-round duration. Uses a Medicine check and temporary maximum reduction to represent treatment and limits on magical healing. Uses a 2024 Longsword as the default form.

fields.Damage: 1d8 Slashing plus Strength modifier and +3 before allocation. Use 1d10 with two hands.
fields.Attack bonus: Strength modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient, with +3 before allocation applied.
fields.Activation: Make a melee weapon attack. See Special powers for triggers and exceptions.
fields.Special powers: The sword has a defense pool of 4. The first time you attack with the sword on your turn, choose how many pool points to allocate to defense, from zero to 4. Your attack and damage bonus becomes the unallocated remainder, capped at +3. The allocated points add to AC only against melee attacks made with a held weapon while you hold the Defender. These adjustments last until the start of your next turn. Bonuses from multiple Defenders do not stack.
fields.Legacy source: AD&D 2e Dungeon Master Guide, Appendix 3, Sword, +4 Defender.
fields.Conversion notes: Keeps the 4-point allocation and the original protection against held melee weapons. Caps the attack and damage bonus at +3. Uses the published 2024 Defender’s allocation timing. The 2e description specifies both the +4 and +5 variants. Uses a 2024 Longsword as the default form.

fields.Damage: 1d8 Slashing plus Strength modifier and +3 before allocation. Use 1d10 with two hands.
fields.Attack bonus: Strength modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient, with +3 before allocation applied.
fields.Activation: Make a melee weapon attack. See Special powers for triggers and exceptions.
fields.Special powers: The sword has a defense pool of 5. The first time you attack with the sword on your turn, choose how many pool points to allocate to defense, from zero to 5. Your attack and damage bonus becomes the unallocated remainder, capped at +3. The allocated points add to AC only against melee attacks made with a held weapon while you hold the Defender. These adjustments last until the start of your next turn. Bonuses from multiple Defenders do not stack.
fields.Legacy source: AD&D 2e Dungeon Master Guide, Appendix 3, Sword +5, Defender.
fields.Conversion notes: Keeps the 5-point allocation and the original protection against held melee weapons. Caps the attack and damage bonus at +3. Uses the published 2024 Defender’s allocation timing. The 2e description specifies both the +4 and +5 variants. Uses a 2024 Longsword as the default form.

fields.Damage: 1d8 Slashing + Strength modifier + 2, or use 1d10 with two hands. An attuned Paladin uses +3 instead.
fields.Attack bonus: Strength modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient, plus 2 (+3 for an attuned Paladin).
fields.Activation: Make a melee attack. An attuned Paladin can also use the aura and dispelling powers.
fields.Special powers: While held by an attuned Paladin, the sword adds 10 Radiant damage on a hit against a Chaotic Evil creature. The Paladin and allies within 5 feet have Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects. The Paladin can spend 1 of 3 charges to cast Dispel Magic on one target within 5 feet, using Charisma. The sword regains all charges at dawn.
fields.Attunement: Required by a Paladin for the full powers. The +2 form works without attunement.
fields.Legacy source: AD&D 2e Dungeon Master Guide, Appendix 3, Sword, +5 Holy Avenger.
fields.Conversion notes: Keeps the dormant +2, Paladin gate, short aura and bonus against Chaotic Evil foes. Caps the original +5 at +3, uses Advantage for magic resistance, and gives the dispel a daily limit.

dmg-2e-reference:0bbcfcfcc1eb2787.label: D&D 2024 adaptation · Sword of the Planes

fields.Damage: 1d8 Slashing + Strength modifier and the planar bonus, or use 1d10 with two hands.
fields.Attack bonus: Strength modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient and the planar bonus, capped at +3.
fields.Activation: Make a melee attack. Determine the bonus from the plane you occupy and the target’s native plane. Apply the higher bonus only.
fields.Planar bonus: +1 by default. +2 on an Inner Plane or against a creature native to one. +3 on an Outer Plane or against a creature native to one. On the Astral or Ethereal Plane or against a creature native to either, use +3 to hit and +4 to damage.
fields.Conversion notes: Preserves the 2e weapon’s planar tiers and caps the highest attack bonus at +3. The legacy +4 tier remains on damage.
fields.Legacy source: AD&D 2e Dungeon Master Guide, Appendix 3, Sword of the Planes.

dmg-2e-reference:f5f4d19a393a9ebf.label: D&D 2024 adaptation · Sword, Short, of Quickness (+2)

fields.Damage: 1d6 Piercing + Strength or Dexterity modifier + 2.
fields.Attack bonus: Strength or Dexterity modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient, plus 2.
fields.Activation: Make a melee attack. The Initiative benefit applies while holding the attuned sword when you roll Initiative.
fields.Special powers: You have Advantage on Initiative rolls while holding the sword. On the first turn of each combat, your first attack with the sword has Advantage if you are not Incapacitated.
fields.Conversion notes: Uses Initiative Advantage and a first-turn attack benefit for the legacy automatic first strike. Keeps the +2 enhancement and shortsword form.
fields.Legacy source: AD&D 2e Dungeon Master Guide, Appendix 3, Sword, Short, of Quickness (+2).

fields.Category: Magic staff and simple melee weapon
fields.Damage: 1d6 Bludgeoning + Strength modifier, or use 1d8 with two hands.
fields.Attack bonus: Strength modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient.
fields.Range: 5 feet for weapon attacks. Special powers use their listed ranges.
fields.Attunement: Required by a Cleric or Wizard.
fields.Legacy source: AD&D 2e Dungeon Master Guide, Appendix 3, Staves.
fields.Charges: 10 maximum. Regains 1d4 + 2 expended charges at dawn.
fields.Activation: While holding the staff, spend the listed charges to cast a spell. Use your spell attack modifier and spell save DC. Spells use their normal casting time, range, duration, and Concentration, with no components except where stated.
fields.Spells and costs: Charm Person (1 charge), Suggestion (2 charges), Dominate Beast (4 charges), Speak with Plants (3 charges). Only a Cleric can cast Speak with Plants from the staff. A Wizard can target only a mammal with Dominate Beast.
fields.Conversion notes: Retains the different class permissions, with 2024 spells for influence, animal control, and plant manipulation.

fields.Category: Magic staff and simple melee weapon
fields.Damage: 1d6 Bludgeoning + Strength modifier, or use 1d8 with two hands.
fields.Attack bonus: Strength modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient.
fields.Range: 5 feet for weapon attacks. Special powers use their listed ranges.
fields.Legacy source: AD&D 2e Dungeon Master Guide, Appendix 3, Staves.
fields.Charges: 8 maximum. Regains 1d4 + 4 expended charges at dawn.
fields.Activation: While holding the staff, touch a creature as a Magic action and spend 1 charge to use one of its four functions. Each function can be used twice between dawns. A creature can benefit from the staff only once between dawns.
fields.Special powers: Heal wounds: restore 3d6 + 3 Hit Points. Restore sight: end the Blinded condition. Cure disease: end a nonmagical disease or a contagion whose rules permit a disease-curing effect. Soothe the mind: end one Charmed or Frightened condition, or one madness effect the DM designates as curable.
fields.Conversion notes: Keeps the original healing dice, four functions, and limits per recipient and function. Translates the older condition categories to current rules.

dmg-2e-reference:b779a5528d55b84c.label: D&D 2024 adaptation · Staff of the Magi

fields.Category: Magic staff and simple melee weapon
fields.Damage: 1d6 Bludgeoning + Strength modifier, or use 1d8 with two hands.
fields.Attack bonus: Strength modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient.
fields.Range: 5 feet for weapon attacks. Special powers use their listed ranges.
fields.Attunement: Required by a Sorcerer, Warlock, or Wizard.
fields.Legacy source: AD&D 2e Dungeon Master Guide, Appendix 3, Staves.
fields.Charges: 25 maximum. Found with 1d20 charges. Spell Absorption is its only recharge.
fields.Activation: While holding the staff, spend the listed charges to cast a spell. Use your spell attack modifier and spell save DC. Spells use their normal casting time, range, duration, and Concentration, with no components except where stated.
fields.Spells without charges: Detect Magic, Enlarge/Reduce (enlarge only), Light, and Protection from Evil and Good.
fields.Spells and costs: Invisibility (2 charges), Knock (2), Blindness/Deafness (2), Web (2), Dispel Magic (3), Fireball (3), Lightning Bolt (3), Ice Storm (4), Wall of Fire (4), Passwall (5), Plane Shift (7), Conjure Elemental (5), and Telekinesis (5). Plane Shift requires its attuned fork. Cast Conjure Elemental at most once between dawns.
fields.Hold Portal: As a Magic action, magically seal a closed door or gate you touch for up to 1 minute with Concentration. It takes a successful Strength check against your spell save DC to force it open. Knock also opens it and ends the effect.
fields.Whirlwind: As a Magic action, spend 5 charges to create a 10-foot-radius, 30-foot-high Cylinder centered within 60 feet. It lasts up to 1 minute with Concentration. The first time a creature enters it on a turn or starts its turn there, it makes a Strength save against your spell save DC. On a failure it takes 3d8 Bludgeoning and falls Prone. On a success it takes half damage. On later turns you can move the Cylinder up to 20 feet as a Bonus Action, keeping its center within 60 feet.
fields.Spell Absorption: While holding the staff you gain +2 to saves against spells. When a spell targets only you, you can use a Reaction to negate it and gain charges equal to its level. The DM can keep that level hidden until after you choose. If the charges would exceed 25, the staff breaks and resolves Retributive Strike with 25 charges.
fields.Retributive Strike: As a Magic action, break the staff over a solid surface or your knee. It is destroyed. There is a 50% chance you travel to a random plane and escape the blast. Otherwise you take 16 Force damage per remaining charge. Each other creature within 30 feet makes a DC 17 Dexterity save, taking Force damage equal to 8 times the remaining charges within 10 feet, 6 times within 20 feet, or 4 times beyond 20 feet. A success halves that creature’s damage.
fields.Conversion notes: Keeps absorption-only recharge, dangerous overflow, free utility and the legacy blast bands. Blindness/Deafness takes Pyrotechnics’s blinding role. Hold Portal and Whirlwind use authored 2024-style rules.

fields.Category: Magic staff and simple melee weapon
fields.Damage: 1d6 Bludgeoning + Strength modifier + 3, or use 1d8 with two hands.
fields.Attack bonus: Strength modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient, plus 3.
fields.Range: 5 feet for weapon attacks. Special powers use their listed ranges.
fields.Legacy source: AD&D 2e Dungeon Master Guide, Appendix 3, Staves.
fields.Charges: 10 maximum. Regains 1d6 + 4 expended charges at dawn.
fields.Activation: When you hit with the staff, you may spend 1–3 charges.
fields.Special powers: The hit deals an extra 1d6 Force damage per charge spent.
fields.Conversion notes: Keeps the +3 enhancement and three levels of strike. Uses the current Staff of Striking’s extra-die convention.

fields.Category: Magic staff and simple melee weapon
fields.Damage: 1d6 Bludgeoning + Strength modifier + 1, or use 1d8 with two hands.
fields.Attack bonus: Strength modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient, plus 1.
fields.Range: 5 feet for weapon attacks. Special powers use their listed ranges.
fields.Legacy source: AD&D 2e Dungeon Master Guide, Appendix 3, Staves.
fields.Charges: 8 maximum. Regains 1d4 + 2 expended charges at dawn.
fields.Activation: On a melee hit, spend 2 charges to Age or 3 charges to Age and Wither. Use one save for both effects.
fields.Special powers: The target makes a DC 15 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 2d8 Necrotic and gains 1 level of Exhaustion. Spending 3 charges also halves its Speed and gives it Disadvantage on Strength-based attacks until the end of your next turn. Ageless creatures, including Undead and Fiends, are immune to these extra effects.
fields.Conversion notes: Retains the cumulative two- and three-charge effects and immunity for ageless creatures. Exhaustion and temporary penalties replace aging and permanent limb loss. Uses 2024 Quarterstaff dice.

fields.Damage: Python: 1d6 Bludgeoning + Strength modifier + 2. Adder: 1d6 Bludgeoning + Strength modifier + 1. Either can use 1d8 with two hands.
fields.Attack bonus: Strength modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient, plus 2 for Python or 1 for Adder.
fields.Attunement: Cleric; the Adder also requires evil alignment.
fields.Charges: None.
fields.Activation: Determine the variant when found (d100: 01–60 Python, 61–100 Adder).
fields.Python: As a Magic action, place or toss the staff into an unoccupied space within 10 feet. It becomes a Giant Constrictor Snake, acts after your turn, and obeys verbal commands. Without a command it Dodges. As a Bonus Action while it is within 60 feet, command it to revert in its space. The staff is destroyed if the snake reaches 0 Hit Points.
fields.Adder: As a Bonus Action, animate the head for 1 minute. Each hit then forces a DC 15 Constitution save for 3d6 Poison damage on a failure or half on a success. The active head can be targeted separately (AC 15, 20 Hit Points). At 0 Hit Points the staff is destroyed. The head regains its Hit Points when it reverts.
fields.Conversion notes: Keeps the original variant odds, bonuses, class limits, and destruction risks. Uses current snake rules and poison damage for the legacy lethal save.
fields.Legacy source: AD&D 2e Dungeon Master Guide, Appendix 3, Staves.

fields.Damage: Melee 1d6 Bludgeoning (1d8 with two hands) + Strength modifier + 1. Sling shot 1d8 Bludgeoning + Strength modifier + 1. Charged shot 3d10 + 3 Bludgeoning.
fields.Attack bonus: Strength modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient, plus 1.
fields.Range: 5 feet melee, 60/180 feet for sling shots, 300 feet for the charged shot.
fields.Attunement: Required. Only a Druid can use the ranged attacks.
fields.Activation: With two hands, touch the staff to a roughly round object up to 9 inches across and 5 lb to load it as part of a ranged weapon attack. Use Strength and proficiency with the staff for the ranged attack. The staff gives +1 to hit.
fields.Special powers: As a Magic action, spend 1 charge to load and launch an ordinary rock up to 30 lb at one target within 300 feet. Make one ranged weapon attack using the staff bonus. A projectile is expended with either ranged attack.
fields.Charges: 5 maximum. Regains 1d4 + 1 at dawn.
fields.Conversion notes: Keeps the Druid-only sling, standard and charged maximum distances, and legacy +1 per die on the charged shot. The 30 lb limit and dawn recharge are conversion choices.
fields.Legacy source: AD&D 2e Dungeon Master Guide, Appendix 3, Staves.

dmg-2e-reference:749cd4586909c31f.label: D&D 2024 adaptation · Staff of Thunder & Lightning

fields.Damage: 1d6 Bludgeoning + Strength modifier + 2, or use 1d8 with two hands.
fields.Attack bonus: Strength modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient, plus 2.
fields.Charges: 8 maximum. Regains 1d4 + 2 at dawn.
fields.Activation: While attuned, use one strike option per attack or one discharge as a Magic action.
fields.Thunder (1 charge): Before rolling a melee attack, spend 1 charge to use +3 instead of +2 for the attack and damage. On a hit, the target makes a DC 16 Constitution save or is Stunned until the start of your next turn.
fields.Lightning (1 charge): On a melee hit, spend 1 charge to add 2d6 Lightning damage.
fields.Thunderclap (2 charges): Each creature in a 40-foot Cone makes a DC 16 Constitution save. Failure causes Stunned until the start of your next turn. Each creature in the cone is Deafened until the end of your next turn.
fields.Lightning Stroke (2 charges): Cast Lightning Bolt (DC 16 Dexterity, 8d6 Lightning, half on a success).
fields.Thunder & Lightning (4 charges): Resolve both the Thunderclap and Lightning Stroke from your space using the same chosen direction. Creatures in both areas make both saves.
fields.Conversion notes: Keeps all five powers and their relative costs. Uses standard Cone and Line rules, one Lightning Bolt line, and short durations for the control effects.
fields.Legacy source: AD&D 2e Dungeon Master Guide, Appendix 3, Staves.

fields.Damage: 1d6 Bludgeoning + Strength modifier + 3, or use 1d8 with two hands.
fields.Attack bonus: Strength modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient, plus 3.
fields.Activation: While holding it, speak the command word as a Bonus Action to choose one of three forms. The form lasts until changed.
fields.Quarterstaff form: Simple melee weapon, +3 to attack and damage. 1d6 Bludgeoning, Versatile (1d8), Topple.
fields.Mace form: Simple melee weapon, +2 to attack and damage. 1d6 Bludgeoning, Sap.
fields.Great mace form: Martial melee weapon, +1 to attack and damage. 2d6 Bludgeoning, Heavy, Two-Handed, Topple. Use Maul proficiency and mastery.
fields.Conversion notes: Retains all three forms and bonuses. The Maul represents the two-handed great mace.
fields.Legacy source: AD&D 2e Dungeon Master Guide, Appendix 3, Staves.

dmg-2e-reference:90882d9d6a06db49.label: D&D 2024 adaptation · Staff of the Woodlands

fields.Damage: 1d6 Bludgeoning + Strength modifier + the rolled enhancement, or use 1d8 with two hands.
fields.Attack bonus: Strength modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient, plus the rolled enhancement (maximum +3).
fields.Charges: 8 maximum. Regains 1d4 + 2 at dawn.
fields.Activation: While holding the staff, use its spell powers with your Druid spell save DC, normal casting times and Concentration. Animate Tree uses a Magic action.
fields.Spells and costs: Wall of Thorns (6 charges). Animal Friendship (1 charge); casting it this way also casts Speak with Animals as part of the same action, without extra charges.
fields.Animate Tree (4 charges): Choose a nonmagical Large or Huge tree within 60 feet. It animates for 1 minute with the Animated Tree stat block from the Treant’s Animate Trees action. It acts immediately after you and obeys verbal commands. Without commands it Dodges. Only one tree can be animated by this staff at a time. It roots again when the effect ends if it survives.
fields.Conversion notes: Retains Druid attunement, the treant-style animation and the trade-off between weapon bonus and utility. Uses 2024 spell-based charge costs. Legacy +4 grants +3 to hit and +4 to damage.
fields.Daily powers: Roll 1d4 when found for the enhancement. +1 grants Pass without Trace, Barkskin, and Tree Shape. +2 grants Pass without Trace and Barkskin. +3 grants Pass without Trace. +4 grants no daily powers. Each listed power is usable once per dawn at no charge cost.
fields.Tree Shape: As a Magic action, become a Large ordinary tree in your space for up to 1 hour (Concentration). You remain aware of your surroundings, have Speed 0, and cannot take actions or reactions in that form. Revert when Concentration ends or when reduced to 0 Hit Points. You retain your own Hit Points and AC.
fields.Legacy source: AD&D 2e Dungeon Master Guide, Appendix 3, Staves.

It acts immediately after you and obeys verbal commands. Without commands it Dodges. Only one tree can be animated by this staff at a time. It roots again when the effect ends if it survives.
fields.Conversion notes: Retains Druid attunement, the treant-style animation and the trade-off between weapon bonus and utility. Uses 2024 spell-based charge costs. Legacy +4 grants +3 to hit and +4 to damage.
fields.Daily powers: Pass without Trace. Each listed power is usable once per dawn at no charge cost.
fields.Legacy source: AD&D 2e Dungeon Master Guide, Appendix 3, Staves.

fields.Attack bonus: Strength modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient, plus 3.
fields.Charges: 8 maximum. Regains 1d4 + 2 at dawn.
fields.Activation: While holding the staff, use its spell powers with your Druid spell save DC, normal casting times and Concentration. Animate Tree uses a Magic action.
fields.Spells and costs: Wall of Thorns (6 charges). Animal Friendship (1 charge); casting it this way also casts Speak with Animals as part of the same action, without extra charges.

fields.Damage: 1d8 Slashing plus Strength modifier and +1. Use 1d10 with two hands.
fields.Attack bonus: Strength modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient, with +1 applied.
fields.Activation: Make a melee weapon attack. See Special powers for triggers and exceptions.
fields.Special powers: Curse. The first time you draw or attack with the sword, it binds to you. When you roll Initiative while a hostile creature is present, the sword appears in your hand if you have a free hand. If both hands are occupied, it replaces one held object of your choice, dropping that object in your space. While fighting a hostile creature you cannot drop or stow the sword. On each of your turns, if able, use your action to attack a hostile creature with it or Dash toward the nearest one if you cannot reach any. Once no conscious hostile creature remains within 60 feet, the compulsion ends. The binding persists until Remove Curse is cast on you.
fields.Attunement: None; the curse binds on its own trigger.
fields.Legacy source: AD&D 2e Dungeon Master Guide, Appendix 3, Sword +1, cursed.
fields.Conversion notes: Retains +1, compulsory fighting and the sword returning to the wielder’s hand. Uses initiative, a defined encounter boundary, and Remove Curse for the legacy release. Uses a 2024 Longsword as the default form.

fields.Damage: 1d8 Slashing + Strength modifier, or use 1d10 with two hands. Subtract 2 from damage against creatures in combat.
fields.Attack bonus: Strength modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient. Subtract 2 against creatures in combat.
fields.Activation: Make a melee weapon attack. See Special powers for triggers and exceptions.
fields.Special powers: Curse. The sword displays ordinary magic and reveals its penalty only when used against a creature in combat. On the first such attack it binds to you. Whenever you roll Initiative with hostile creatures present, it returns to your hand. If necessary you drop one held object of your choice to make room. While a hostile creature is within 60 feet, you cannot willingly drop or stow the sword or attack with another weapon. Its −2 applies to attack and damage rolls against creatures in combat. It deals at least 1 damage on a hit before Resistance or Immunity. Only Wish ends this binding.
fields.Attunement: None; the curse binds on its own trigger.
fields.Legacy source: AD&D 2e Dungeon Master Guide, Appendix 3, Sword -2, Cursed.
fields.Conversion notes: Keeps the hidden −2 penalty, minimum damage, and forced use. Wish stands in for the legacy limited wish or wish.

fields.Damage: 1d8 Slashing plus Strength modifier and +2. Use 1d10 with two hands.
fields.Attack bonus: Strength modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient, with +2 applied.
fields.Activation: Make a melee weapon attack. See Special powers for triggers and exceptions.
fields.Special powers: Curse. When you first attack a creature with this sword in combat, it binds to you. It appears in your hand when you roll Initiative while bound, displacing one held object of your choice if necessary. When the sword first binds or you roll Initiative while bound, you enter a frenzy. During it you cannot willingly stow or drop the sword. While another living creature is within 60 feet, use your movement and action, if able, to approach and attack the nearest such creature with this sword, including an ally. Break ties at random. If you cannot reach it, use your action to Dash toward it. The compulsion ends if you are Incapacitated or no other living creature remains within 60 feet. Remove Curse or Wish can end the binding.
fields.Attunement: None; the curse binds on its own trigger.
fields.Legacy source: AD&D 2e Dungeon Master Guide, Appendix 3, Sword, Cursed Beserking.
fields.Conversion notes: Keeps +2, forced attacks on the closest living creature, and the exorcism or wish remedy. Defines the compulsion with 2024 movement and action rules. Uses a 2024 Longsword as the default form.

fields.Damage: 1d6 Piercing + Strength modifier + 1, or 1d8 with two hands.
fields.Attack bonus: Strength modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient, plus 1.
fields.Activation: Make a melee or thrown weapon attack. The first time you make an attack with the spear on a turn, roll a d20 before resolving it.
fields.Special powers: The curse starts at a threshold of 1. If your curse roll is at or below the threshold, the attack hits you instead and you take its normal damage, doubled if you threw it. The threshold resets to 1. Otherwise, resolve the attack normally and increase the threshold by 1, to a maximum of 20. After the first backbite you cannot willingly part with the spear. If thrown, it returns immediately to your hand. Remove Curse ends the binding and resets the threshold. The spear itself remains cursed.
fields.Attunement: None; the curse binds on its first trigger.
fields.Conversion notes: Keeps the cumulative risk and doubled thrown damage. A curse roll replaces the special legacy Armor Class rules. Check once per turn to account for Extra Attack.
fields.Legacy source: AD&D 2e Dungeon Master Guide, Appendix 3, Spear, Cursed Backbiter.
fields.Variant: The default is +1. If the DM uses the legacy +2 or +3 variant, replace +1 on attack and damage rolls with the selected bonus, including damage to the wielder.

fields.Damage: 1d8 Piercing + Strength modifier + 1, or 1d10 with two hands in melee.
fields.Attack bonus: Strength modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient + 1.
fields.Activation: Once per turn when you hit a creature with the trident while attuned, you can spend 1 charge to compel a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw.
fields.Special powers: On a failure, the target has the Frightened condition for up to 1 minute. While Frightened this way, it cannot make attacks. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. A target immune to Frightened is unaffected.
fields.Charges: The trident has 1d4 + 16 charges when found. It never regains charges and remains a +1 trident at 0 charges.
fields.Conversion notes: Combines the legacy spell save and morale check into one Wisdom save and uses repeat saves for recovery. Keeps the +1 enhancement, finite charges, and loss of the will to fight.
fields.Legacy source: AD&D 2e Dungeon Master Guide, Appendix 3, Trident of Submission.

fields.Damage: 1d8 Piercing + Strength modifier + 2, or 1d10 with two hands in melee.
fields.Attack bonus: Strength modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient + 2.
fields.Activation: Take a Magic action while holding the trident and spend 1 charge. Point it in a direction to scan a 240-foot hemisphere centered on you and facing that direction. At the start of your next turn, if you are still holding it and are not Incapacitated, you can scan again in any direction without spending another charge or action.
fields.Special powers: At each scan, learn the locations, depths, kinds, and count of hungry or hostile marine predators in the hemisphere. It requires neither line of sight nor Concentration.
fields.Charges: Roll 1d6 + 18 charges when found. The trident never regains charges and remains a +2 trident at 0 charges.
fields.Conversion notes: Uses a Magic action for the first scan and one follow-up to reflect the two rounds of sensing per charge. Keeps the 2e range and finite charge pool.
fields.Legacy source: AD&D 2e Dungeon Master Guide, Appendix 3, Trident of Warning.

fields.Damage: 1d8 Piercing + Strength modifier − 2, or 1d10 with two hands in melee.
fields.Attack bonus: Strength modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient − 2.
fields.Attunement: None. The curse binds when you grasp it.
fields.Activation: On first grasping the trident, you become bound and cannot willingly release it.
fields.Special powers: On your turns, use your movement and, if necessary, the Dash action to reach the deepest body of water you know how to reach that can cover you. If none is known, seek the nearest such body of water. Once you reach it, submerge and remain submerged. Use the normal underwater movement and suffocation rules.
fields.Breaking the curse: Wish ends the binding. Alternatively, while you are fully submerged, receiving the effects of a Water Breathing spell ends the binding. Once released, the trident remains cursed.
fields.Conversion notes: Keeps the −2 attack and damage modifiers, compulsion on grasp, and the two source remedies. Uses 2024 movement and suffocation rules.
fields.Legacy source: AD&D 2e Dungeon Master Guide, Appendix 3, Trident of Yearning.

fields.Damage: 1d8 Slashing + Strength modifier + 2, or use 1d10 with two hands. See Special powers for target-specific changes.
fields.Attack bonus: Strength modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient, plus 2. See Special powers for conditional bonuses.
fields.Activation: Make a melee weapon attack. Apply the listed target and trigger rules.
fields.Special powers: Against a true dragon, use +3 instead of +2 on the attack roll and deal an extra 1d6 Slashing on a hit. Against the keyed dragon kind, deal an extra 3d6 Slashing instead of 1d6. The normal +2 still applies to weapon damage.
fields.Legacy source: AD&D 2e Dungeon Master Guide, Appendix 3, Sword +2, Dragon Slayer.
fields.Conversion notes: The 2024 Dragon Slayer’s extra dice replace the legacy multiplier. This conversion preserves the +2 base and keys the full 3d6 to one dragon kind. It caps the legacy +4 attack bonus at +3.
fields.True dragons: Apply the conditional bonus to creatures identified as true dragons, including the listed chromatic and metallic kinds. Drakes and wyverns do not qualify.

fields.Damage: 1d8 Slashing + Strength modifier + 1, or use 1d10 with two hands. See Special powers for target-specific changes.
fields.Attack bonus: Strength modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient, plus 1. See Special powers for conditional bonuses.
fields.Activation: Make a melee weapon attack. Apply the listed target and trigger rules.
fields.Special powers: Use +2 instead of +1 on attack and damage rolls against a creature that can cast spells using its own traits or class features, or that is currently created, summoned, or brought to the battlefield by a spell or magical effect. Casting only through a magic item does not qualify.
fields.Legacy source: AD&D 2e Dungeon Master Guide, Appendix 3, Sword +1, +2 vs. magic-using and enchanted creatures.
fields.Conversion notes: Retains the +2 target rule and the original exception for creatures that get spellcasting solely from an item. Uses the longsword, the source table’s most common sword form.

fields.Conversion notes: Retains the original +3 against shape changers and currently transformed targets. Uses the longsword, the source table’s most common sword form.
