fields.Damage: 1d6 Piercing + Strength modifier; 2d6 Piercing + Strength modifier + 3 when activated.
fields.Attack bonus: Strength modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient. Add 3 when activated.
fields.Range: 5 feet melee or 30/120 feet thrown. The activated attack reaches 60 feet in any direction.
fields.Activation: As a Magic action while holding it, speak its command word and choose a target within 60 feet. Make a ranged weapon attack against that target using Strength. This activation has no long-range Disadvantage.
fields.Special powers: The javelin propels itself for the activated attack. After resolving it, hit or miss, it loses its magic and becomes a normal javelin.
fields.Conversion notes: Preserves the self-launch and single use. Replaces the legacy +6 attack bonus and flat damage range with a +3 attack bonus and a damage roll.
fields.Legacy source: AD&D 2e Dungeon Master Guide, Appendix 3, Javelin of Piercing.
fields.Treasure quantity: When generated from the legacy treasure table, roll 2d4 javelins.

fields.Damage: 1d4 Bludgeoning + Dexterity modifier + 2.
fields.Attack bonus: Dexterity modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient, plus 2.
fields.Activation: Make a ranged weapon attack, expending one sling bullet.
fields.Special powers: In a campaign that uses minimum magic-enhancement thresholds, a bullet counts as +1 for meeting that threshold. The sling still grants +2 on attack and damage rolls.
fields.Legacy source: AD&D 2e Dungeon Master Guide, Appendix 3, Sling of Seeking +2.
fields.Conversion notes: Preserves the original distinction between the attack and damage bonus and its legacy ability to harm certain creatures. The conversion adds no homing or sight benefit.

fields.Damage: 1d6 Slashing in melee or 2d6 Slashing when thrown. Add your Strength modifier and the full rolled bonus.
fields.Attack bonus: Strength modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient, plus the rolled bonus (maximum +3).
fields.Activation: Make a melee or thrown weapon attack while attuned.
fields.Special powers: Immediately after a throw hits or misses, the axe returns to your hand. If you have no free hand, it lands in your space.
fields.Conversion notes: Retains the legacy maximum throwing distance and higher thrown damage. Uses the same base weapon dice for all target sizes. The attack bonus caps at +3, with legacy +4 and +5 retained as damage bonuses.
fields.Legacy distribution: Roll 1d20 when found. 1–5 gives +1, 6–10 gives +2, 11–15 gives +3, 16–19 gives legacy +4, and 20 gives legacy +5.
fields.Legacy source: AD&D 2e Dungeon Master Guide, Appendix 3, Axe of Hurling.

fields.Category: Simple ranged weapon (light form), or Martial (heavy form)
fields.Damage: 1d8 Piercing + Dexterity modifier + 1 in light form. See Heavy form for its damage.
fields.Attack bonus: Dexterity modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient, plus 1.
fields.Activation: Choose light or heavy when the item is found. Make a ranged weapon attack, expending one bolt.
fields.Special powers: Both normal and long range are doubled. Attacks beyond normal range still have Disadvantage unless another rule says otherwise.
fields.Heavy form: Martial ranged weapon. 1d10 Piercing + Dexterity modifier + 1. Range 200/800 feet. Ammunition (bolts), Heavy, Loading, Two-Handed. Push mastery. 18 lb.
fields.Legacy distribution: The 2e source makes 10% of these crossbows heavy.
fields.Conversion notes: Retains +1 and doubles both 2024 range bands for the chosen base form.
fields.Legacy source: AD&D 2e Dungeon Master Guide, Appendix 3, Crossbow of Distance.

fields.Category: Simple ranged weapon (light form), or Martial (heavy form)
fields.Damage: 1d8 Piercing + Dexterity modifier + 1 in light form. See Heavy form for its damage.
fields.Attack bonus: Dexterity modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient, plus 1.
fields.Activation: Choose light or heavy when the item is found. Make a ranged weapon attack, expending one bolt.
fields.Special powers: The crossbow cocks itself while held. Ignore the Loading property for attacks with this weapon. You must still expend a bolt for each attack. When you fire the crossbow as part of the Attack action on your turn, you may fire it once more as a Bonus Action. If you are holding it when you roll Initiative and are not surprised, you have Advantage on that roll.
fields.Heavy form: Martial ranged weapon. 1d10 Piercing + Dexterity modifier + 1. Range 100/400 feet. Ammunition (bolts), Heavy, Two-Handed. Push mastery. 18 lb.
fields.Legacy distribution: The 2e source makes 10% of these crossbows heavy.
fields.Conversion notes: Extra Attack compatibility and one Bonus Action shot replace double legacy rate of fire. Initiative Advantage represents first fire without creating a separate surprise phase.
fields.Legacy source: AD&D 2e Dungeon Master Guide, Appendix 3, Crossbow of Speed.

dmg-2e-reference:6c1e3ae59d0adb5d.label: D&D 2024 adaptation · Dagger +1, +2 vs. Tiny or Small creatures

fields.Damage: 1d4 Piercing + Strength or Dexterity modifier + 1. Use +2 instead against Small or Tiny creatures.
fields.Attack bonus: Strength or Dexterity modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient, plus 1. Use +2 instead against Small or Tiny creatures.
fields.Activation: Make a melee or thrown weapon attack. Use the target’s current size to determine the weapon’s bonus.
fields.Special powers: The +2 replaces the normal +1 on both attack and damage rolls against a Small or Tiny creature.
fields.Conversion notes: Retains both enhancement values. Uses 2024 size categories in place of the AD&D size comparison.
fields.Legacy source: AD&D 2e Dungeon Master Guide, Appendix 2, Table 110.

dmg-2e-reference:93abeb4177f895df.label: D&D 2024 adaptation · Dagger +2, +3 vs. larger than man-sized

fields.Damage: 1d4 Piercing + Strength or Dexterity modifier + 2. Use +3 instead against Large, Huge, or Gargantuan creatures.
fields.Attack bonus: Strength or Dexterity modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient, plus 2. Use +3 instead against Large, Huge, or Gargantuan creatures.
fields.Activation: Make a melee or thrown weapon attack. Use the target’s current size to determine the weapon’s bonus.
fields.Special powers: The +3 replaces the normal +2 on both attack and damage rolls against a Large, Huge, or Gargantuan creature.
fields.Conversion notes: Retains both enhancement values. Uses 2024 size categories in place of the AD&D size comparison.
fields.Legacy source: AD&D 2e Dungeon Master Guide, Appendix 2, Table 110.

fields.Category: Simple ranged weapon (light form), or Martial (heavy form)
fields.Damage: 1d8 Piercing + Dexterity modifier (light) or 1d10 Piercing + Dexterity modifier (heavy).
fields.Attack bonus: Dexterity modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient, plus 3.
fields.Properties: Ammunition (bolts), Loading, Two-Handed. Heavy form also has Heavy.
fields.Activation: Make a ranged attack, expending one bolt. Fix the weapon form when found.
fields.Special powers: Attacking beyond normal range with this crossbow imposes no Disadvantage for distance. Other sources of Disadvantage still apply.
fields.Legacy distribution: The 2e source makes 10% of these crossbows heavy.
fields.Conversion notes: Preserves the +3 to hit and treats both 2024 range bands as normal for the attack. The enchantment grants no damage bonus.
fields.Legacy source: AD&D 2e Dungeon Master Guide, Appendix 3, Crossbow of Accuracy, +3.

fields.Category: Simple melee weapon (Dagger); Martial melee weapon (Shortsword form)
fields.Damage: 1d4 Piercing + Strength or Dexterity modifier + 2 as a dagger. Shortsword form uses 1d6 Piercing with the same modifiers.
fields.Attack bonus: Strength or Dexterity modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient with the current form, plus 2.
fields.Range: 5 feet melee in either form, 20/60 feet thrown in dagger form.
fields.Properties: Finesse, Light. Only dagger form has Thrown.
fields.Activation: A Small creature holding the dagger can change its form once per turn without an action. It reverts to a dagger when released. Resolve a thrown attack using dagger form.
fields.Special powers: On a hit against a wooden or stone object in either form, use the highest result on each weapon damage die. The attack still needs to hit the object’s AC and meet any damage threshold.
fields.Conversion notes: Uses Small size as the modern eligibility rule. Retains the +2, compact weight, and exceptional ability to damage wood and stone.
fields.Legacy source: AD&D 2e Dungeon Master Guide, Appendix 3, Dagger +2, Longtooth.

fields.Damage: Shortbow 1d6 Piercing or Longbow 1d8 Piercing, plus Dexterity modifier. If the arrow damages an eligible target, add 6d10 Force on a failed save or half as much on a success.
fields.Activation: Expend one arrow when making a ranged attack with a compatible bow. The bow determines attack modifier and mastery.
fields.Saving throw: DC 17 Constitution after an eligible target takes damage from the arrow.
fields.Expenditure: After dealing its extra damage, the projectile becomes nonmagical.
fields.Target type: Choose or roll d100. 01–10 Aberration; 11–15 Beast; 16–20 Celestial; 21–25 Construct; 26–35 Dragon; 36–45 Elemental; 46–50 Humanoid; 51–60 Fey; 61–70 Fiend; 71–75 Giant; 76–80 Monstrosity; 81–85 Ooze; 86–90 Plant; 91–00 Undead.

fields.Conversion notes: The 2024 effect replaces the legacy +3 enhancement and instant kill. The arrow grants no flat attack or damage bonus.

fields.Special powers: While holding the staff, you gain +2 to Armor Class and saving throws. Once per turn when you hit with it, spend 1 charge to deal an extra 1d8 Force damage.
fields.Guarding Shield: As a Reaction when you or an ally you can see within 5 feet is hit by an attack, spend 3 charges. You and allies within 5 feet gain +2 AC until the start of your next turn, including against the triggering attack.
fields.Paralyzing Cone: As a Magic action, spend 5 charges. Each creature in a 30-foot Cone makes a Wisdom save against your spell save DC. On a failure it is Paralyzed for up to 1 minute with Concentration. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
fields.Retributive Strike: As a Magic action, break the staff over a solid surface or your knee. It is destroyed. There is a 50% chance you travel to a random plane and escape the blast. Otherwise you take 16 Force damage per remaining charge. Each other creature within 30 feet makes a DC 17 Dexterity save, taking Force damage equal to 8 times the remaining charges within 10 feet, 6 times within 20 feet, or 4 times beyond 20 feet. A success halves that creature’s damage.
fields.Conversion notes: Keeps the legacy repertoire, group shield, cone and strike. Charge costs and limited smite dice replace the legacy one-charge spell list and multiplied weapon damage.

Plane Shift requires its attuned fork. Cast Conjure Elemental at most once between dawns.
fields.Hold Portal: As a Magic action, magically seal a closed door or gate you touch for up to 1 minute with Concentration. It takes a successful Strength check against your spell save DC to force it open. Knock also opens it and ends the effect.
fields.Whirlwind: As a Magic action, spend 5 charges to create a 10-foot-radius, 30-foot-high Cylinder centered within 60 feet. It lasts up to 1 minute with Concentration. The first time a creature enters it on a turn or starts its turn there, it makes a Strength save against your spell save DC. On a failure it takes 3d8 Bludgeoning and falls Prone. On a success it takes half damage. On later turns you can move the Cylinder up to 20 feet as a Bonus Action, keeping its center within 60 feet.
fields.Spell Absorption: While holding the staff you gain +2 to saves against spells. When a spell targets only you, you can use a Reaction to negate it and gain charges equal to its level. The DM can keep that level hidden until after you choose. If the charges would exceed 25, the staff breaks and resolves Retributive Strike with 25 charges.
fields.Retributive Strike: As a Magic action, break the staff over a solid surface or your knee. It is destroyed. There is a 50% chance you travel to a random plane and escape the blast. Otherwise you take 16 Force damage per remaining charge. Each other creature within 30 feet makes a DC 17 Dexterity save, taking Force damage equal to 8 times the remaining charges within 10 feet, 6 times within 20 feet, or 4 times beyond 20 feet. A success halves that creature’s damage.
fields.Conversion notes: Keeps absorption-only recharge, dangerous overflow, free utility and the legacy blast bands. Blindness/Deafness takes Pyrotechnics’s blinding role. Hold Portal and Whirlwind use authored 2024-style rules.

If both hands are occupied, it replaces one held object of your choice, dropping that object in your space. While fighting a hostile creature you cannot drop or stow the sword. Once no conscious hostile creature remains within 60 feet, the compulsion ends. The binding persists until Remove Curse is cast on you.

While a hostile creature is within 60 feet, you cannot willingly drop or stow the sword or attack with another weapon. Its −2 applies to attack and damage rolls against creatures in combat. fields.Attack bonus: Strength modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient, with +2 applied.
fields.Activation: Make a melee weapon attack. See Special powers for triggers and exceptions.
fields.Special powers: Curse. When you first attack a creature with this sword in combat, it binds to you. It appears in your hand when you roll Initiative while bound, displacing one held object of your choice if necessary. When the sword first binds or you roll Initiative while bound, you enter a frenzy. During it you cannot willingly stow or drop the sword. While another living creature is within 60 feet, use your movement and action, if able, to approach and attack the nearest such creature with this sword, including an ally. Break ties at random. If you cannot reach it, use your action to Dash toward it. The compulsion ends if you are Incapacitated or no other living creature remains within 60 feet. Remove Curse or Wish can end the binding.
fields.Attunement: None; the curse binds on its own trigger.

fields.Attack bonus: Strength modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient, with its current magic bonus applied.
fields.Activation: Make a melee weapon attack. See Special powers for triggers and exceptions.
fields.Special powers: While held, the sword starts at +1. At the end of a turn in which you attacked with it, advance to the next stage: +2, +3, then +3 to attack and +4 to damage. After the fourth stage it returns to +1. On your next turn, you can then release it as a Bonus Action. While dancing it hovers within 30 feet of you. On release, and as a Bonus Action on each of your next three turns, you can move it up to 30 feet to a space within 30 feet of you and make one melee attack against a target within 5 feet of it, using your normal modifiers. Each dancing turn uses the next bonus stage in the same sequence. It cannot make Opportunity Attacks. At the end of the fourth turn, if you are Incapacitated, or if it leaves the 30-foot limit, it returns to a free hand or falls in its space and resets to +1. Use it in hand through four more attack turns before releasing it again.
fields.Legacy source: AD&D 1e Dungeon Masters Guide, pp. 124 and 165–166; III.G Swords, roll 81.
fields.Conversion notes: Retains the four-stage attack cycle and four-turn dance. The fourth stage’s attack bonus is capped at +3 and the autonomous attacks use Bonus Actions. Uses the longsword, the source table’s most common sword form.

fields.Damage: 1d8 Bludgeoning + Strength modifier + 2, or use 1d10 with two hands. An awakened hammer uses +3.
fields.Attack bonus: Strength modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient, plus 2 (+3 when awakened).
fields.Range: 5 feet melee; 20/60 feet thrown when awakened.
fields.Activation: A Dwarf with proficiency in Warhammers can attune to this hammer and speak its command word as a Magic action to awaken it. It stays awakened for that wielder until their attunement ends.
fields.Special powers: In its awakened state, it returns to your hand immediately after a thrown attack hits or misses. On a thrown hit it deals an extra 1d8 Force damage, or 2d8 against a Giant.
fields.Attunement: Required to awaken. The +2 melee form works without attunement.
fields.Legacy source: AD&D 1e Dungeon Masters Guide, printed p. 168; III.H Miscellaneous Weapons, roll 63.
fields.Conversion notes: Preserves the dormant +2 and the command-word unlock. Warhammer proficiency replaces the original fighter-class gate. Uses the 2024 item’s Force dice instead of doubling or tripling all damage.

fields.Damage: 2d6 Bludgeoning + Strength modifier + 3 while attuned.
fields.Attack bonus: Strength modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient, plus 3 while attuned.
fields.Range: 5 feet melee; 20/60 feet thrown with a charge.
fields.Activation: Make a melee attack. While attuned, you can instead spend one charge to throw the hammer as one attack. It returns to your hand immediately after hitting or missing.
fields.Special powers: The hammer has 5 charges and regains 1d4 + 1 expended charges at dawn. On a thrown hit, creatures within 30 feet of the target, including the target but excluding you, make a DC 17 Constitution save or are Stunned until the end of your next turn. If you are wearing and attuned to both a Belt of Giant Strength and Gauntlets of Ogre Power and know the hammer’s true name, a natural 20 against a Giant forces it to make a DC 17 Constitution save or die.
fields.Attunement: Required by a creature with a Strength score of 19 or higher.
fields.Legacy source: AD&D 1e Dungeon Masters Guide, printed pp. 168–169; III.H Miscellaneous Weapons, roll 64.
fields.Conversion notes: Keeps the strong-wielder requirement, +3 and the original paired gear and true-name gates. Replaces legacy +5, damage multiplication and instant kills on ordinary hits with 2024-style charges, a natural-20 trigger and saves.

fields.Category: Simple ranged weapon (light form), or Martial (heavy form)

fields.Damage: 1d6 Piercing + Strength modifier + 1, or 1d8 with two hands.
fields.Attack bonus: Strength modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient, plus 1.
fields.Activation: Make a melee or thrown weapon attack. The first time you make an attack with the spear on a turn, roll a d20 before resolving it.
fields.Special powers: The curse starts at a threshold of 1. If your curse roll is at or below the threshold, the attack hits you instead and you take its normal damage, doubled if you threw it. The threshold resets to 1. Otherwise, resolve the attack normally and increase the threshold by 1, to a maximum of 20. After the first backbite you cannot willingly part with the spear. If thrown, it returns immediately to your hand. Remove Curse ends the binding and resets the threshold. The spear itself remains cursed.

fields.Conversion notes: Uses the default +1 form and keeps the cumulative risk and doubled thrown damage. The curse roll replaces special legacy Armor Class rules. Checks occur once per turn to account for Extra Attack.

fields.Special powers: When you hit with a natural 20, you can expend one of the dagger’s 6 charges to inject its magical venom. The creature makes a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failure it takes 3d10 Poison damage and is Poisoned for 1 minute. On a success it takes half the poison damage and avoids the condition. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the condition on a success. The dagger regains 1d4 expended charges daily at dawn.
fields.Legacy source: AD&D 1e Dungeon Masters Guide, p. 168, Dagger of Venom.
fields.Conversion notes: Keeps the legacy natural-20 trigger, +1 weapon and six-dose limit. Replaces instant death and physical refilling with a bounded poison effect and dawn recharge.

fields.Damage: 1d6 Piercing + Strength modifier
fields.Range: 5 feet melee, 30/120 feet thrown; lightning property within 90 feet
fields.Attack bonus: Strength modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient.
fields.Activation: Make a weapon attack using the listed reach or thrown range.
fields.Special powers: When a thrown attack hits a target within 90 feet, it takes an extra 4d8 Lightning damage and the javelin is consumed. A 5-foot-wide Line extends from the impact point up to 30 feet back toward you, ending before your space. Each other creature in the Line makes a DC 13 Dexterity save, taking 4d8 Lightning on a failure or half as much on a success. A miss leaves the javelin intact.
fields.Legacy source: AD&D 1e Dungeon Masters Guide, pp. 148–149, Javelin of Lightning.
fields.Conversion notes: Keeps the source’s backward lightning stroke and consumption on a hit. The legacy +2 equivalency only determined whether it could harm protected creatures. It adds no numerical attack or damage bonus here.

fields.Damage: 1d6 Bludgeoning + Strength modifier + 1
fields.Attack bonus: Strength modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient, plus 1.
fields.Activation: Make a weapon attack using the listed reach or thrown range.
fields.Special powers: On a hit against an Undead or Fiend, add 2d6 Radiant. If it has 25 Hit Points or fewer afterward, it makes a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. It is destroyed on a failure or Frightened until the end of your next turn on a success. The first time a creature of evil alignment touches the mace each day, it takes 2d8 Radiant damage.
fields.Legacy source: AD&D 1e Dungeon Masters Guide, p. 168, Mace of Disruption.
fields.Conversion notes: Keeps the +1, harmful touch and anti-Undead and anti-Fiend role. Uses the 2024 Mace of Disruption’s Hit Point threshold and save in place of the cleric turning table.

fields.Damage: 1d6 Slashing + Strength or Dexterity modifier + 2
fields.Attack bonus: Strength or Dexterity modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient, plus 2.
fields.Activation: Make a weapon attack using the listed reach or thrown range.
fields.Special powers: You have Advantage on Initiative rolls if you are holding the scimitar when you roll. On each of your turns you can use a Bonus Action to make one attack with it. This attack is independent of Extra Attack or an Attack action granted by Haste.
fields.Legacy source: AD&D 2e Dungeon Master Guide, Table 110, section 2, roll 12 and Scimitar of Speed description.
fields.Conversion notes: Uses the typical +2 treasure result. Advantage on Initiative replaces automatic first attack. The extra attack uses the 2024 Scimitar of Speed’s Bonus Action.

fields.Damage: 1d8 Radiant + Strength or Dexterity modifier + 2. Use 1d10 for the base die with two hands.
fields.Attack bonus: Strength or Dexterity modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient, plus 2.
fields.Activation: Make a weapon attack using the listed reach or thrown range.
fields.Special powers: A hit deals an extra 1d8 Radiant damage to a creature of evil alignment or an extra 2d8 Radiant to an Undead or a creature the DM identifies as drawing power from the Negative Plane. Apply only the highest applicable extra damage. Once per dawn, take a Magic action to start the Sunray. You shed sunlight as Bright Light in a 10-foot radius. It expands by 5 feet at the start of each of your next ten turns, to 60 feet. You can end the light on your turn without an action, and it ends automatically at the end of your tenth turn after activation. The last radius then sheds Dim Light for 1 minute.
fields.Legacy source: AD&D 2e Dungeon Master Guide, Table 110, section 3, roll 1 and Sun Blade description.
fields.Conversion notes: Keeps the +2, the light handling and expanding sunray. Typed damage replaces the legacy conditional +4 and doubled damage. Finesse represents the lighter handling, using the published 2024 Sun Blade as a benchmark.

fields.Attack bonus: Dexterity modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient.

fields.Attack bonus: Use the host’s normal attack modifier, including its separate magic bonus if any.
fields.Range: Use the host’s reach or range unless this property gives a different value.

fields.Damage: Normal damage plus any effect of the released spell.
fields.Attack bonus: Use the host’s normal attack modifier, including its separate magic bonus if any.
fields.Range: Use the host’s reach or range unless this property gives a different value.

Use the original caster’s slot level, save DC, and spell attack bonus. You maintain any Concentration the released spell requires.

fields.Range: Use the host’s reach or range unless this property gives a different value.

fields.Range: Use the host’s reach or range unless this property gives a different value.

fields.Eligible weapon: melee weapon that deals Slashing damage

fields.Attack bonus: Use the host’s normal attack modifier, including its separate magic bonus if any.
fields.Range: Use the host’s reach or range unless this property gives a different value.

fields.Attunement: Required for the finished weapon in this conversion.

fields.Damage: Normal damage. The target takes 1d4 Necrotic damage per wound at the start of each of its turns.
fields.Attack bonus: Use the host’s normal attack modifier, including its separate magic bonus if any.
fields.Range: Use the host’s reach or range unless this property gives a different value.

fields.Damage: No direct damage.

fields.Activation: When you take the Attack action, replace one attack with throwing the net over a 10-foot square you can see whose center is within 20 feet. Each Large or smaller creature in the square makes the save. As an alternative, spend 1 minute spreading the net on the floor or hanging it overhead. While within 30 feet, take a Magic action to speak its command word and close the net around creatures in a 5-foot cube immediately above it on the floor or immediately below it overhead. Each Large or smaller creature in that cube makes the save. A creature that fails has the Restrained condition.
fields.Escape: The target or a creature within 5 feet can take an action to attempt a DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check, freeing one restrained creature on a success. The net has AC 19, 10 Hit Points, and Immunity to Bludgeoning, Poison, and Psychic damage. Destroying it frees everyone.
fields.Release and reuse: The user can take a Bonus Action to speak the release word from within 30 feet, freeing everyone. No recharge is required, but the intact net must be retrieved before it can be deployed again.
fields.Source locator: AD&D 1e Dungeon Master’s Guide, Net of Entrapment. Table III.E.4 and linked description.
fields.Conversion notes: Preserves the 20-foot throw, broad mesh, and two anchored modes. Replaces the edition’s legacy save with a Dexterity save, translates the Strength threshold into a check, and assigns 2024 object defenses. The anchored mode uses a 5-foot cube.

fields.Special powers: While wearing this armor, take a Magic action to become a flood of water and immediately move up to your Speed. fields.Special powers: When you finish a Short or Long Rest while wearing this armor, you or a willing Battle Master who completed that rest with you can store one maneuver they know. Storing a maneuver replaces any previous one. Once per dawn, while wearing the armor, you can use the stored maneuver at its usual trigger and action cost without expending your own Superiority Die. Use a d8 as the die and your own statistics for the maneuver’s effects. If it calls for a saving throw, the DC is 8 plus your Proficiency Bonus plus your choice of Strength or Dexterity modifier. Only one maneuver can apply to an attack. Using the stored maneuver empties the armor.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 41 (PDF p. 42), Armor of Exploits.
fields.Conversion notes: Maps the original stored martial power to a 2024 Battle Master maneuver. Its trigger and action cost apply normally, and the daily limit prevents repeat use by refilling at Short Rests. Uses +1 armor under the 2024 rules and requires attunement.

Storing a maneuver replaces any previous one. Once per dawn, while wearing the armor, you can use the stored maneuver at its usual trigger and action cost without expending your own Superiority Die. Use a d8 as the die and your own statistics for the maneuver’s effects. If it calls for a saving throw, the DC is 8 plus your Proficiency Bonus plus your choice of Strength or Dexterity modifier. Only one maneuver can apply to an attack. Using the stored maneuver empties the armor.

fields.Special powers: While wearing this armor, take a Bonus Action to choose an ally within 5 feet and one effect on it that it can end by making a repeated saving throw. If that effect can apply to you, transfer it to yourself with the same remaining duration, DC, and end conditions. You cannot make a save to end it before the end of your next turn. This transfer is usable at will. As a separate Bonus Action, you can spend one of your unspent Hit Point Dice to heal an ally you can see within 25 feet. It regains Hit Points equal to the die roll plus its Constitution modifier, with a minimum of 1. This healing power recharges at dawn.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 41 (PDF p. 42), Armor of Sacrifice.
fields.Conversion notes: Retains condition transfer, delayed escape save, and separate healing activation. Uses a Hit Point Die in place of the sacrificed healing surge. Uses +1 armor under the 2024 rules and requires attunement.

fields.Conversion notes: Retains one saving throw per Beast and replaces encounter duration with one minute. Uses +1 armor under the 2024 rules and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While wearing this armor, take a Bonus Action to enter or leave its flexible mode. In that mode you take a −1 penalty to AC, and the armor imposes no Speed penalty for failing to meet its Strength requirement and no Disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. The mode lasts until you change it or remove the armor. You still need Heavy armor training to use it normally.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 54 (PDF p. 55), Versatile Armor.
fields.Conversion notes: Preserves the original one-point AC tradeoff and maps the removable penalties to the 2024 Strength and Stealth rules. Uses +1 armor under the 2024 rules and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While wearing this armor, add 2 to your Death Saving Throws. If you fail any saving throw, you can replace the d20 result with 20 without taking an action and resolve the save again with the original modifiers. If it was a Death Saving Throw, apply the normal rule for rolling a 20 on the die. Recharges at dawn.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 54 (PDF p. 55), Verve Armor.
fields.Conversion notes: Preserves the +2 bonus and daily substitution. Under 2024 rules, 20 on the die is not an automatic success for an ordinary saving throw. Uses +1 armor under the 2024 rules and requires attunement.

fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 55 (PDF p. 56), Veteran’s Armor. Official 4e errata appended at PDF p. 226.
fields.Conversion notes: Uses Action Surge as the 2024 analogue of spending an action point. Follows the official 4e errata that removed the printed daily power that recovered another power. Uses +1 armor under the 2024 rules and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While wearing this armor, when a creature misses you with a melee attack made with a weapon, an Unarmed Strike, or a natural weapon, you can take a Reaction. The attacker makes a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, if it used a held weapon, halve all damage dealt by that weapon for up to 1 minute. Otherwise the attacker takes 10 Force damage at the start of each of its turns for up to 1 minute. The attacker repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. Recharges at dawn.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 55 (PDF p. 56), Voidcrystal Armor.
fields.Conversion notes: Retains distinct held-weapon and natural or unarmed effects. Assigns Force to the ongoing damage and adds a save DC and one-minute cap. Uses +1 armor under the 2024 rules and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While wearing this armor, take a Bonus Action to draw in hostile creatures within 10 feet of you that you can see. Each makes a DC 15 Strength saving throw. On a failure, pull it along a straight line toward you into the nearest unoccupied space within 5 feet of you that it can occupy. A creature already within 5 feet of you does not move. A creature that cannot reach an eligible space is unaffected. Recharges at dawn.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 55 (PDF p. 56), Warsheath Armor.
fields.Conversion notes: Retains the original lowest-tier two-square reach as 10 feet, adds a Strength save, and specifies the forced-movement destination. Uses +1 armor under the 2024 rules and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While wearing this armor outdoors, Difficult Terrain costs you no extra movement. The armor does not remove damage or other effects of moving through a hazard.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 55 (PDF p. 56), Wildleaf Armor.
fields.Conversion notes: Preserves the original outdoor terrain benefit. Padded Armor represents cloth. Uses +1 armor under the 2024 rules and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While wearing this armor outdoors, Difficult Terrain costs you no extra movement. The armor does not remove damage or other effects of moving through a hazard.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 55 (PDF p. 56), Wildleaf Armor.

fields.Special powers: While wearing this armor, whenever an Undead hits you with a melee attack, it takes 1 Radiant damage immediately after the hit resolves. This requires no action.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 55 (PDF p. 56), Zealot’s Armor.
fields.Conversion notes: Keeps the original Undead melee trigger and ties the damage to the converted +1 enhancement. Padded Armor represents cloth. Uses +1 armor under the 2024 rules and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While wearing this armor, when a melee or ranged attack hits you, the attacker takes a −2 penalty to subsequent attack rolls against you until the start of your next turn. This requires no action, and multiple hits do not stack the penalty.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 48 (PDF p. 49), Prismatic Robe.
fields.Conversion notes: Retains the original retaliatory attack penalty and duration. Uses +1 armor under the 2024 rules and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While wearing this armor, take a Bonus Action to activate it for 1 minute. While active, when a hostile creature you can see moves into a space within 5 feet of you, you can take a Reaction to push it 5 feet directly away from you. A creature more than one size category larger than you is unaffected. The activation recharges at dawn.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 49 (PDF p. 50), Repulsion Armor.
fields.Conversion notes: Uses a one-minute duration in place of the encounter. Keeps the adjacent movement trigger and five-foot push and adopts the 2024 Shove size limit. Uses +1 armor under the 2024 rules and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While wearing this armor, take a Bonus Action to activate it for 1 minute. While active, when a hostile creature you can see moves into a space within 5 feet of you, you can take a Reaction to push it 5 feet directly away from you. A creature more than one size category larger than you is unaffected. The activation recharges at dawn.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 49 (PDF p. 50), Repulsion Armor.
fields.Conversion notes: Uses a one-minute duration in place of the encounter. Keeps the adjacent movement trigger and five-foot push and adopts the 2024 Shove size limit. Uses +1 armor under the 2024 rules and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While wearing this armor, immediately after a hostile creature hits you with an attack roll made with Advantage, that creature takes 1 Radiant damage. This requires no action.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 49 (PDF p. 50), Righteous Armor.
fields.Conversion notes: Maps 4e combat advantage to Advantage on the triggering attack roll and uses the converted +1 armor bonus for damage. Uses +1 armor under the 2024 rules and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While wearing this armor, immediately after you reduce a creature within 50 feet of you to 0 Hit Points, you can teleport to an unoccupied space it occupied when it dropped to 0 Hit Points. No action is required. This power recharges when you finish a Short or Long Rest.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 49 (PDF p. 50), Robe of Bloodwalking.
fields.Conversion notes: Preserves the original defeat trigger, range, and destination. Uses the printed teleport effect and rest recharge in place of encounter recharge. Uses +1 armor under the 2024 rules and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While wearing this armor, after an attack deals damage to you, if you are Bloodied and able to take a Reaction, you can take a Reaction to teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. You can then spend one unspent Hit Point Die to regain Hit Points equal to the roll plus your Constitution modifier, minimum 1 Hit Point. Recharges at dawn.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 49 (PDF p. 50), Robe of Contingency.
fields.Conversion notes: Converts six squares to 30 feet and the optional healing surge to one Hit Point Die. Checks Bloodied after the triggering damage. Uses +1 armor under the 2024 rules and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While wearing this armor, you have Resistance to Fire damage. When you would take Fire damage, you can take a Reaction to take no Fire damage from that instance and increase your Speed by 10 feet until the end of your next turn. After the damage resolves, you can spend one unspent Hit Point Die to regain Hit Points equal to the roll plus your Constitution modifier, minimum 1 Hit Point. The Reaction recharges at dawn.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 49 (PDF p. 50), Robe of Defying Flames.
fields.Conversion notes: Converts flat Fire protection to Resistance, the two-square Speed bonus to 10 feet, and the optional healing surge to one Hit Point Die. Uses +1 armor under the 2024 rules and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While wearing this armor, you have Resistance to Cold damage. When you would take Cold damage, you can take a Reaction to take no Cold damage from that instance and gain +1 AC until the end of your next turn. After the damage resolves, you can spend one unspent Hit Point Die to regain Hit Points equal to the roll plus your Constitution modifier, minimum 1 Hit Point. The Reaction recharges at dawn.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 49 (PDF p. 50), Robe of Defying Frost.
fields.Conversion notes: Converts flat Cold protection to Resistance and the optional healing surge to one Hit Point Die. Preserves the original AC bonus. Uses +1 armor under the 2024 rules and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While wearing this armor, you have Resistance to Lightning and Thunder damage. When you would take Lightning or Thunder damage, you can take a Reaction to take neither type of damage from that instance and gain +1 on attack rolls until the end of your next turn. After the damage resolves, you can spend one unspent Hit Point Die to regain Hit Points equal to the roll plus your Constitution modifier, minimum 1 Hit Point. The Reaction recharges at dawn.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 49 (PDF p. 50), Robe of Defying Storms.
fields.Conversion notes: Converts the two flat reductions to Resistance and the optional healing surge to one Hit Point Die. Preserves the original attack bonus. Uses +1 armor under the 2024 rules and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While wearing this armor, you have immunity to the Blinded condition and gain +1 on Wisdom (Perception) checks.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 50 (PDF p. 51), Robe of Eyes.
fields.Conversion notes: Preserves the 4e immunity and uses the converted +1 armor enhancement for Perception. This entry uses the Adventurer’s Vault version. Uses +1 armor under the 2024 rules and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While wearing this armor, immediately after an attack roll by a hostile creature hits you, you can take a Reaction. That creature subtracts 1 from its attack rolls against you for 1 minute. The effect ends early if you make an attack roll against that creature. Recharges at dawn.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 50 (PDF p. 51), Robe of Forbearance.
fields.Conversion notes: Uses the converted armor enhancement for the penalty and replaces the encounter duration with one minute. Uses +1 armor under the 2024 rules and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While wearing this armor, after a hostile creature within 5 feet of you makes a melee attack against you, hit or miss, you can take a Reaction. It takes 1d6 Piercing damage and takes 1 Piercing damage at the start of each of its turns for up to 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns it makes a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, ending the recurring damage on a success. Recharges at dawn.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 50 (PDF p. 51), Robe of Quills.
fields.Conversion notes: Uses the lowest-tier initial and ongoing damage. Assigns Piercing damage and adds an end-of-turn saving throw and duration cap. Uses +1 armor under the 2024 rules and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While wearing this armor, immediately after a creature hits you with a melee attack, you can take a Reaction to sap its defenses for up to 1 minute. It takes −2 AC and you gain +2 AC. At the end of its next turn and at the end of each subsequent turn, it makes a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. The first success reduces the penalty and bonus to 1 each, and the second success ends both. The effect also ends early if you remove the armor. Recharges at dawn.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 50 (PDF p. 51), Robe of Sapping.
fields.Conversion notes: Preserves the two stages of opposing AC adjustments and the delayed first saving throw. Adds a Constitution DC and a one-minute cap for the entire effect. Uses +1 armor under the 2024 rules and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While wearing this armor, take a Bonus Action to shed Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for another 20 feet. You can end the light without taking an action on your turn. As a Magic action, you can also release a 10-foot Emanation of dazzling color. Each other creature in the area that can see the display makes a Wisdom saving throw against DC 8 plus your Proficiency Bonus plus your Intelligence or Charisma modifier (your choice). On a failure, it cannot take Bonus Actions or Reactions, and on its turn it can move or take one action, but cannot do both. It repeats the save at the end of each turn, ending the effect on a success. The effect lasts at most 1 minute. The Emanation power recharges at dawn.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 50 (PDF p. 51), Robe of Scintillation.
fields.Conversion notes: Uses torch illumination for the at-will light and converts the original Will attack and Dazed condition into a Wisdom save and explicit action limits. Uses +1 armor under the 2024 rules and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While wearing this armor, take a Bonus Action to make its stars flare until the end of your next turn. When a hostile creature that can see the flare targets you with an attack roll during that time, it must first make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failure it has the Blinded condition for up to 1 minute, including during the triggering attack. It repeats the save at the end of each turn, ending the effect on a success. A creature already Blinded by this activation does not save again when it attacks you. Recharges at dawn.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 50 (PDF p. 51), Robe of Stars.
fields.Conversion notes: Keeps the original pre-attack timing and short activation window. Adds a Constitution save and duration cap for Blinded. This entry uses the Adventurer’s Vault version. Uses +1 armor under the 2024 rules and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While wearing this armor, immediately after a creature you can see within 50 feet attacks you, you can take a Reaction. The attacker makes a Wisdom saving throw against DC 8 plus your Proficiency Bonus plus your Charisma modifier. A creature immune to the Charmed condition is unaffected. On a failure it has the Charmed condition and must use its next turn to follow one telepathic command you give it, including moving or taking an action it can legally take. It ignores an obviously self-destructive command. The effect lasts until the end of your next turn. Before it ends, you can take a Bonus Action to force a new save if the target is still within 50 feet and visible to you. On a failure, extend the effect until the end of your following turn and issue a new command. On a success, the effect ends and cannot be extended. Total duration cannot exceed 1 minute. Recharges at dawn.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 50 (PDF p. 51), Robe of the Archfiend.
fields.Conversion notes: Uses a Wisdom save for the original Charisma attack against Will. Retains triggered domination and repeat-save sustain, with defined commands and a one-minute cap. Uses +1 armor under the 2024 rules and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While wearing this armor, immediately after a creature succeeds on an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma saving throw against a spell or class feature you used, you can force that creature to reroll the save without taking an action. The creature subtracts 1 from the new roll and must use the new result. If several creatures saved against the effect, choose only one. Recharges at dawn.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 47 (PDF p. 48), Irrefutable Armor.
fields.Conversion notes: Maps a missed attack against Will to a successful mental save by one target. The reroll penalty follows the converted enhancement’s magnitude. Uses +1 armor under the 2024 rules and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While wearing this armor, take a Bonus Action to choose one creature you can see within 50 feet that is standing on soil or sand. It must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or have the Restrained condition for up to 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns, it repeats the save, ending the effect on a success. Recharges at dawn.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 47 (PDF p. 48), Loamweave Armor.
fields.Conversion notes: Preserves the 50-foot range and terrain requirement. Adds an initial Strength save, end-of-turn escape saves, and a duration cap. Padded Armor represents the original cloth armor. Uses +1 armor under the 2024 rules and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While wearing this armor, you have Resistance to Necrotic damage. Immediately after a creature hits you with a melee attack, you can take a Reaction. The attacker takes 2d6 Necrotic damage and subtracts 2 from its Strength and Constitution saving throws until the end of your next turn. The Reaction recharges when you finish a Short or Long Rest.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 47 (PDF p. 48), Laughing Death Armor.
fields.Conversion notes: Converts flat Necrotic protection to Resistance and the Fortitude penalty to Strength and Constitution save penalties. Keeps the 2d6 lowest-tier retaliation and maps cloth armor to Padded Armor. Uses +1 armor under the 2024 rules and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While wearing this armor, you have Resistance to Necrotic damage. While Bloodied, take a Bonus Action to regain Hit Points equal to 20 minus your number of unspent Hit Point Dice, with a minimum of 1. This power does not expend any dice. Recharges at dawn.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 47 (PDF p. 48), Lifegiving Armor.
fields.Conversion notes: Preserves the original healing formula and Bloodied requirement, using unspent Hit Point Dice in place of remaining healing surges. Uses +1 armor under the 2024 rules and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While wearing this armor, you can take a Bonus Action to grant each ally within 5 feet of you +1 AC. When an attack targets an ally within 5 feet of you, you can take a Reaction before the attack roll to grant that ally +1 AC, including against the triggering attack. Either use gives you a −1 AC penalty and lasts until the end of your next turn. You can use the Bonus Action at will. The Reaction recharges at dawn. Multiple uses of this armor do not stack their bonuses or penalties.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 47 (PDF p. 48), Martyr’s Armor.
fields.Conversion notes: Retains the original two activations. Both use the converted +1 enhancement for the armor tradeoff. Uses +1 armor under the 2024 rules and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While wearing this armor, after you finish your second combat encounter since your last Long Rest, its magical AC bonus increases from +1 to +2. After your fourth such combat, the bonus increases to +3. The DM determines when an encounter qualifies. The bonus returns to +1 when you finish a Long Rest.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 47 (PDF p. 48), Meliorating Armor.
fields.Conversion notes: Maps the original milestone mechanic to successive pairs of combat encounters and caps the enhancement at +3. The displayed AC is the resting +1 value. Uses +1 armor under the 2024 rules and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While wearing this armor, you gain +2 AC against attack rolls that would deal Radiant damage or come from an effect that requires you to see the attacker or its gaze. You also gain +2 on saving throws against such effects. If a creature hits you with such an attack or you fail such a save against its effect, that creature subtracts 2 from attack rolls until the end of its next turn. When a ranged attack roll targets only you, you can take a Reaction before the roll to redirect it to a different valid target you can see within 25 feet of you, other than the attacker. The attacker resolves the roll against the new target using the original range and targeting rules. The Reaction recharges at dawn.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 48 (PDF p. 49), Mirrorsheen Coat.
fields.Conversion notes: Translates the original defenses and gaze keyword to attack rolls and saves against radiant and sight-dependent effects. Retains pre-roll redirection and the 25-foot retargeting limit. Padded Armor represents cloth. Uses +1 armor under the 2024 rules and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While wearing this armor, take a Magic action to transform yourself and your gear into a Tiny rat until the end of your next turn. On each of your turns you can use another Magic action to extend the duration until the end of your following turn, up to 1 hour total. In this form you have a Speed and Climb Speed of 20 feet, Darkvision to 30 feet, and a +5 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks. You retain your AC, Hit Points, ability scores, and saving throws. Your equipment merges into the form and cannot be used. You cannot attack, speak, or cast spells. You can revert on your turn without taking an action and revert automatically if you become Unconscious or drop to 0 Hit Points. The initial transformation recharges at dawn.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 48 (PDF p. 49), Rat Form Armor.
fields.Conversion notes: Keeps the original defenses, gear restrictions, Stealth bonus, and turn-by-turn sustain. Uses the 2024 Rat’s size, movement, and Darkvision as benchmarks for the form. Uses +1 armor under the 2024 rules and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While wearing this armor, when you are about to make a Dexterity saving throw, you can take a Reaction. For that save and each Dexterity save you make through the end of your next turn, you can substitute the armor’s current AC contribution minus 10 for your normal Dexterity saving throw modifier. Calculate the armor’s AC using its listed formula, including its magic bonus and any allowed Dexterity modifier, and exclude bonuses from shields, spells, and other gear. Any applicable Advantage or Disadvantage still applies. Recharges at dawn.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 48 (PDF p. 49), Reflexive Armor.
fields.Conversion notes: Converts defending with AC against Reflex attacks to using the armor’s AC as a saving throw modifier. Limits the calculation to the armor so external AC bonuses do not inflate the save. Uses +1 armor under the 2024 rules and requires attunement.
