fields.Conversion notes: Maps the original flat Cold protection to Resistance and Immobilized to Speed 0. Uses the lowest-tier damage die. Uses +1 armor under the 2024 rules and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While wearing this armor, you have Resistance to Cold damage. Immediately after a melee attack hits you, you can take a Reaction to deal 1d6 Cold damage to the attacker and reduce its Speed to 0 until the end of your next turn. Recharges at dawn.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 46 (PDF p. 47), Frozen Armor.
fields.Conversion notes: Maps the original flat Cold protection to Resistance and Immobilized to Speed 0. Uses the lowest-tier damage die. Uses +1 armor under the 2024 rules and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While wearing this armor, when a creature at least one size category larger than you misses you with a melee attack, you can take a Reaction to move up to 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks. You cannot use this movement if your Speed is 0. Recharges when you finish a Short or Long Rest.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 46 (PDF p. 47), Giantdodger Armor.
fields.Conversion notes: Converts the original two-square shift to 10 feet of movement that does not provoke Opportunity Attacks. Uses +1 armor under the 2024 rules and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While wearing this armor, gain a +1 bonus on saving throws to avoid or end the Frightened condition. When you use the Fighter’s Second Wind feature, you also gain 3 Temporary Hit Points.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 46 (PDF p. 47), Heartening Armor.
fields.Conversion notes: Uses the original lowest-tier bonus against fear and the original three Temporary Hit Points. Second Wind means the 2024 Fighter feature. Uses +1 armor under the 2024 rules and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While wearing this armor, gain a +1 bonus on saving throws to avoid or end the Frightened condition. When you use the Fighter’s Second Wind feature, you also gain 3 Temporary Hit Points.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 46 (PDF p. 47), Heartening Armor.
fields.Conversion notes: Uses the original lowest-tier bonus against fear and the original three Temporary Hit Points. Second Wind means the 2024 Fighter feature. Uses +1 armor under the 2024 rules and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While wearing this armor, you automatically succeed on any saving throw made solely to end an effect that deals recurring Poison damage to you. When an effect first applies recurring Poison damage to you, you can take a Reaction to end the recurring Poison damage on yourself. This leaves any initial damage and other effects, including the Poisoned condition, in place. The Reaction recharges when you finish a Short or Long Rest.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 46 (PDF p. 47), Immunizing Armor.
fields.Conversion notes: Preserves the original automatic save and triggered protection against ongoing Poison damage. It applies to a persistent effect on you, not repeated exposure to a poison hazard. Uses +1 armor under the 2024 rules and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While wearing this armor, you automatically succeed on any saving throw made solely to end an effect that deals recurring Poison damage to you. When an effect first applies recurring Poison damage to you, you can take a Reaction to end the recurring Poison damage on yourself. This leaves any initial damage and other effects, including the Poisoned condition, in place. The Reaction recharges when you finish a Short or Long Rest.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 46 (PDF p. 47), Immunizing Armor.
fields.Conversion notes: Preserves the original automatic save and triggered protection against ongoing Poison damage. It applies to a persistent effect on you, not repeated exposure to a poison hazard. Uses +1 armor under the 2024 rules and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While wearing this armor, you can take a Bonus Action to transform it into ordinary-looking clothing or restore its true form. While transformed it counts as clothing for AC, Speed, Strength requirements, and Stealth, and you gain a +1 bonus on Charisma (Deception) checks made to pass off your appearance as a disguise. Only the armor changes appearance. The form lasts until you transform it again or remove it.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 46 (PDF p. 47), Imposter’s Armor.
fields.Conversion notes: Retains the at-will switch between real armor and clothing, including the loss of armor protection in clothing form. Converts the original lowest enhancement to +1 AC and a +1 Deception bonus. Uses +1 armor under the 2024 rules and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While wearing this armor, you can take a Bonus Action to transform it into ordinary-looking clothing or restore its true form. While transformed it counts as clothing for AC, Speed, Strength requirements, and Stealth, and you gain a +1 bonus on Charisma (Deception) checks made to pass off your appearance as a disguise. Only the armor changes appearance. The form lasts until you transform it again or remove it.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 46 (PDF p. 47), Imposter’s Armor.
fields.Conversion notes: Retains the at-will switch between real armor and clothing, including the loss of armor protection in clothing form. Converts the original lowest enhancement to +1 AC and a +1 Deception bonus. Uses +1 armor under the 2024 rules and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While wearing this armor, you can take a Bonus Action to transform it into ordinary-looking clothing or restore its true form. While transformed it counts as clothing for AC, Speed, Strength requirements, and Stealth, and you gain a +1 bonus on Charisma (Deception) checks made to pass off your appearance as a disguise. Only the armor changes appearance. The form lasts until you transform it again or remove it.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 46 (PDF p. 47), Imposter’s Armor.
fields.Conversion notes: Retains the at-will switch between real armor and clothing, including the loss of armor protection in clothing form. Converts the original lowest enhancement to +1 AC and a +1 Deception bonus. Uses +1 armor under the 2024 rules and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While wearing this armor, you have Resistance to Acid damage. Once per dawn, immediately after you hit with a melee attack on your turn, you can shroud yourself in shadow without taking an action. Until the end of your next turn, attack rolls against you have Disadvantage. Each time a hostile creature hits you with a melee attack during this effect, it takes Acid damage equal to 1d6 plus your Constitution modifier (minimum 0 damage).
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 44 (PDF p. 45), Dragonscale Armor, Black.
fields.Conversion notes: Maps concealment to Disadvantage on incoming attack rolls and keeps the original retaliation die, trigger, and duration. Uses +1 Scale Mail, Very Rare rarity, and attunement as benchmarks from 2024 Dragon Scale Mail. The daily power is specific to this conversion.

fields.Special powers: While wearing this armor, you have Resistance to Lightning damage. Once per dawn, immediately after you hit a creature with a melee attack on your turn, you can arc lightning to up to two other creatures you can see within 25 feet of you, without taking an action. Each chosen creature takes Lightning damage equal to 1d8 plus your Constitution modifier (minimum 0 damage). No saving throw.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 44 (PDF p. 45), Dragonscale Armor, Blue.
fields.Conversion notes: Keeps the original lowest-tier dice, two secondary targets, and automatic damage. Five 4e squares become 25 feet. Uses +1 Scale Mail, Very Rare rarity, and attunement as benchmarks from 2024 Dragon Scale Mail. The daily power is specific to this conversion.

fields.Special powers: While wearing this armor, you have Resistance to Poison damage. Once per dawn, immediately after you hit a creature with a melee attack on your turn, you can release poison centered on it without taking an action. Each hostile creature in a 10-foot Emanation from the target, including the target if hostile, makes a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 plus your Proficiency Bonus plus your Constitution modifier). Roll 1d6 plus your Constitution modifier (minimum 0). On a failed save, the creature takes that much Poison damage. Until the start of your next turn, it cannot take Reactions or Bonus Actions, and on its turn it can either move or take one action. On a successful save it takes half as much damage only.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 44 (PDF p. 45), Dragonscale Armor, Green.
fields.Conversion notes: Maps the original close burst to an Emanation, Fortitude defense to a Constitution save, and Dazed to a defined movement and action limit. Retains half damage on a successful defense. Uses +1 Scale Mail, Very Rare rarity, and attunement as benchmarks from 2024 Dragon Scale Mail. The daily power is specific to this conversion.

fields.Special powers: While wearing this armor, you have Resistance to Fire damage. Once per dawn, immediately after you hit a creature with a melee attack on your turn, you can bind it in flame without taking an action. Its Speed is 0 for up to 1 minute. At the start of each of its turns while bound, it takes Fire damage equal to 5 plus your Constitution modifier (minimum 0 damage). At the end of each of those turns it makes a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 plus your Proficiency Bonus plus your Constitution modifier). On a success, both effects end.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 45 (PDF p. 46), Dragonscale Armor, Red.
fields.Conversion notes: Translates Immobilized to Speed 0 and uses an end-of-turn Constitution save to end both effects. Keeps the original lowest-tier damage and adds a one-minute cap. Uses +1 Scale Mail, Very Rare rarity, and attunement as benchmarks from 2024 Dragon Scale Mail. The daily power is specific to this conversion.

fields.Special powers: While wearing this armor, you have Resistance to Cold damage. Once per dawn, immediately after you hit a creature with a melee attack on your turn, you can release a burst of frost without taking an action. The target and each of its allies within 5 feet of it take Cold damage equal to 1d4 plus your Constitution modifier (minimum 0 damage). No saving throw.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 45 (PDF p. 46), Dragonscale Armor, White.
fields.Conversion notes: Keeps the original lowest-tier damage, automatic effect, and target’s adjacent allies. Adjacent squares become 5 feet. Uses +1 Scale Mail, Very Rare rarity, and attunement as benchmarks from 2024 Dragon Scale Mail. The daily power is specific to this conversion.

fields.Special powers: While holding the shield, take a Bonus Action to choose a hostile creature you can see and begin a charge. For the rest of the turn, reduce damage you take from each Opportunity Attack provoked by moving straight toward that creature by 5, to a minimum of 0. If you move at least 10 feet straight toward the chosen creature and immediately make a melee attack against it on the same turn, you cannot be pushed or pulled until the end of your next turn. The charge uses your normal movement and does not grant an attack.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 118 (PDF p. 119), Jousting Shield.
fields.Conversion notes: Defines a 2024 charge using straight movement and a melee attack. Retains the original lowest-tier damage reduction and protection against forced movement. The Bonus Action declares the charge before its Opportunity Attacks. Uses the 2024 Shield and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While holding the shield, take a Magic action to fire a volley at a 15-foot Cube whose point of origin you can see within 50 feet of you and that has no Total Cover from you. Make a separate ranged attack roll against each creature in the Cube that lacks Total Cover from the point of origin. The attack bonus is your Strength modifier plus your Proficiency Bonus if you have Shield training. On a hit, a creature takes 1d8 plus your Strength modifier Piercing damage, with a minimum of 0. Recharges at dawn.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 118 (PDF p. 119), Manticore Shield. Official 4e errata appended at PDF p. 226.
fields.Conversion notes: Uses the Strength-based attack from the 4e errata and the original lowest-tier damage and reach. Maps the burst to a 15-foot Cube and uses Shield training for the attack roll. Uses the 2024 Shield and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While holding the shield, immediately after an attack roll hits you and deals Radiant damage to you, the attacker takes 2 Radiant damage. The shield can retaliate once per triggering hit.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 118 (PDF p. 119), Mithral Shield.
fields.Conversion notes: Maps the 4e Radiant keyword to an attack that actually deals Radiant damage and retains the original lowest-tier retaliation. This is the retaliatory shield from Adventurer’s Vault. Uses the 2024 Shield and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While holding the shield, take a Bonus Action to protect all allies within 5 feet of you at that moment. Until the end of your next turn, the chosen allies cannot be pushed or pulled or otherwise forced to move across the ground or through the air by another creature or its effect. The protection does not prevent falling or teleportation. Recharges when you finish a Short or Long Rest.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 118 (PDF p. 119), Mountain Shield.
fields.Conversion notes: Uses the lowest-tier radius and retains the original forced-movement protection. Rest recharge replaces encounter recharge, and the standard 2024 Shield replaces the original heavy shield. Uses the 2024 Shield and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While holding the shield, if an attack roll against you misses and would have dealt Fire or Radiant damage on a hit, the next melee attack you hit with before the end of your next turn deals 2 extra Radiant damage. Additional qualifying misses refresh the duration without adding damage.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 118 (PDF p. 119), Pelaurum Shield.
fields.Conversion notes: Maps the 4e Fire and Radiant keywords to the damage the missed attack would have dealt. Uses the original lowest-tier damage and duration. Uses the 2024 Shield and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While holding the shield, immediately after a creature within 5 feet of you hits you with a melee attack, you can take a Reaction. The attacker takes Slashing damage equal to 1d8 plus your Constitution modifier, with a minimum of 0. Recharges at dawn.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 119 (PDF p. 120), Razor Shield.
fields.Conversion notes: Retains the lowest-tier dice and Constitution modifier. Assigns Slashing damage to the shield’s blades and limits retaliation to a creature within blade reach. Uses the 2024 Shield and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While holding the shield, immediately after a creature within 5 feet of you hits you with a melee attack, you can take a Reaction to force the attacker to make a DC 15 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, it has the Prone condition. Recharges when you finish a Short or Long Rest.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 119 (PDF p. 120), Recoil Shield.
fields.Conversion notes: Retains the melee-hit trigger, adds a Strength save and adjacent reach for the shield bash, and replaces encounter recharge with rest recharge. Uses the 2024 Shield and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While holding the shield, when a melee or ranged attack targeting only you misses you, you can take a Reaction to reflect it at the attacker. The attacker rolls a new d20 with the original attack bonus against its own AC. Resolve the attack’s damage and any applicable on-hit effects against the attacker if it hits. The reflected attack does not expend another action, spell slot, or piece of ammunition. Recharges at dawn.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 119 (PDF p. 120), Reflective Shield.
fields.Conversion notes: Maps the original AC and Reflex attack rolls to 2024 single-target attack rolls. Keeps a fresh attack roll against the attacker’s own defense and leaves area effects outside the conversion. Uses the 2024 Shield and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While holding the shield, when a ranged attack targeting only you misses you, you can take a Reaction to redirect it. Choose a different creature within 50 feet of you that you can see and that lacks Total Cover from you. The attacker rolls a new d20 with the original attack bonus against that creature’s AC, applying cover from your position. On a hit, resolve the attack’s damage and any applicable on-hit effects against the new target. The redirected attack does not expend another action, spell slot, or piece of ammunition. Recharges at dawn.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 119 (PDF p. 120), Ricochet Shield.
fields.Conversion notes: Retains the original 50-foot redirection range and fresh attack roll. The ricochet starts at the shield for distance and cover, and applies to single-target ranged attacks. Uses the 2024 Shield and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While holding the shield, when an attack roll hits an ally within 5 feet of you, you can take a Reaction after resolving that attack. The ally gains +1 AC for 1 minute. Recharges at dawn.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 114 (PDF p. 115), Angelsteel Shield.
fields.Conversion notes: Uses the original lowest-tier defense bonus. Attack rolls target AC in 2024, and a one-minute duration replaces the encounter duration. Uses the 2024 Shield and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While holding the shield, when an ally within 5 feet of you regains Hit Points, you can take a Reaction to let that ally immediately spend one unspent Hit Point Die. The ally rolls the die and regains Hit Points equal to the roll plus its Constitution modifier, with a minimum of 1 Hit Point. Recharges at dawn.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 114 (PDF p. 115), Battleforged Shield.
fields.Conversion notes: Replaces the original healing surge with one Hit Point Die. Uses a Reaction for the triggered activation and the standard 2024 Shield for the original heavy shield. Uses the 2024 Shield and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: When you take a Critical Hit while holding the shield, you can take a Reaction before damage is rolled. From that hit through the end of your next turn, reduce the total damage you take from each attack, spell, or other effect by 5, to a minimum of 0. Apply the reduction once per instance of damage before applying Resistance or Vulnerability. Recharges at dawn.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 114 (PDF p. 115), Bloodguard Shield.
fields.Conversion notes: Retains the original lowest-tier flat reduction and includes the triggering critical hit. Uses the 2024 Shield and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While holding the shield, take a Bonus Action to choose yourself or an ally within 5 feet of you. The chosen creature must be Bloodied. Until the end of your next turn, reduce the total damage that creature takes from each attack, spell, or other effect by 5, to a minimum of 0. Apply the reduction once per instance of damage before applying Resistance or Vulnerability. Recharges at dawn.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 114 (PDF p. 115), Bloodshored Shield.
fields.Conversion notes: Retains the original flat reduction and checks the 2024 Bloodied threshold when choosing the recipient. Uses the 2024 Shield and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While holding the shield and Bloodied, you can take a Bonus Action to activate it. For 1 minute, reduce the total damage you take from each attack, spell, or other effect by 2, to a minimum of 0. Apply the reduction once per instance of damage before applying Resistance or Vulnerability. The effect ends early if you cease to be Bloodied. Recharges at dawn.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 114 (PDF p. 115), Bloodsoaked Shield.
fields.Conversion notes: Retains the original lowest-tier flat reduction and early end condition. A one-minute duration replaces the encounter duration. Uses the 2024 Shield and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While holding the shield, when an ally within 5 feet of you fails an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma saving throw, you can take a Reaction. Add 4 to the ally’s total for that save, potentially turning the failure into a success. Recharges at dawn.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 116 (PDF p. 117), Cold Iron Shield.
fields.Conversion notes: Maps 4e Will defense to 2024 mental saving throws. Retains the original lowest-tier bonus for a single ally and uses the standard 2024 Shield for the original heavy shield. Uses the 2024 Shield and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While holding the shield, you gain an additional +1 AC during the first round of combat. The bonus applies even if you are surprised.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 116 (PDF p. 117), Darkleaf Shield.
fields.Conversion notes: Retains the original lowest-tier AC bonus. The single first round covers 2024 surprise, which is handled through Initiative. Uses the 2024 Shield and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While holding the shield, when an ally within 5 feet of you fails a Strength or Constitution saving throw, you can take a Reaction. Add 4 to the ally’s total for that save, potentially turning the failure into a success. Recharges at dawn.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 117 (PDF p. 118), Direbeast Shield.
fields.Conversion notes: Maps 4e Fortitude defense to Strength and Constitution saving throws and retains the original lowest-tier bonus. Uses the 2024 Shield and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While holding the shield, when a creature you can see misses you with a melee attack, you can take a Reaction to flash light at the attacker. It must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or have the Blinded condition until the end of your next turn. Recharges at dawn.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 117 (PDF p. 118), Flaring Shield.
fields.Conversion notes: Retains the original trigger and duration and adds a Constitution save for the 2024 Blinded condition. Uses the 2024 Shield and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While holding the shield, you stay on the surface of a liquid unless you choose to submerge. You have a Swim Speed equal to your Speed while swimming on the surface. You have Advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks to swim on the surface and Constitution checks to keep swimming for extended periods. The shield grants no protection from the liquid itself.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 117 (PDF p. 118), Floating Shield.
fields.Conversion notes: Replaces the original check bonuses with Advantage and preserves surface-only movement and voluntary submersion. Uses the 2024 Shield and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While holding the shield, when you or an ally you can see within 60 feet of you would regain Hit Points, you can take a Reaction before the healing is applied. Treat any dice used for that instance of healing as having rolled their maximum. Increase the healing further by the higher of your Wisdom and Charisma modifiers, with a minimum bonus of 0. Recharges at dawn.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 117 (PDF p. 118), Healer’s Shield.
fields.Conversion notes: Retains maximized healing and the original lowest-tier ability bonus. Uses a Reaction and caps the original line-of-sight range at 60 feet. Uses the 2024 Shield and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While holding the shield, when a creature within 5 feet that can see you misses you with a melee attack, you can take a Reaction. The attacker must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or become mesmerized for up to 1 minute. While mesmerized, it can move or take one action on its turn, but cannot do both, take a Bonus Action, or take a Reaction. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. The effect also ends if it can no longer see you or is farther than 5 feet from you at the end of your turn. Recharges at dawn.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 117 (PDF p. 118), Hypnotic Shield.
fields.Conversion notes: Models the action limits of 4e dazed as an item-specific effect. Adds a Wisdom save and duration cap, and preserves the proximity and sight limits. Uses the 2024 Shield and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While holding the shield, you have Resistance to Fire damage. When an ally within 5 feet of you would take Fire damage, you can take a Reaction to grant it Resistance to Fire damage, including against the triggering damage, until the end of your next turn. The Reaction power recharges at dawn.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 117 (PDF p. 118), Flamedrinker Shield.
fields.Conversion notes: Converts the original passive and triggered flat reductions to Fire Resistance. Uses the 2024 Shield and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: When you take a Critical Hit while holding the shield, you can take a Reaction before damage is rolled to turn it into a normal hit. Recharges at dawn.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 122 (PDF p. 123), Wyrmguard Shield.
fields.Conversion notes: Retains the lowest-tier self-only trigger and converts the original daily interrupt into a 2024 Reaction. Uses the 2024 Shield and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While holding this shield, when you and another creature within 5 feet of you are both about to make saving throws against the same area effect, you can take a Reaction to protect that creature. It skips this saving throw and suffers none of the damage or other effects that the save would determine. Resolve the effect against you as usual. Recharges at dawn.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 120 (PDF p. 121), Spellshield.
fields.Conversion notes: Converts the original protected adjacent square to one adjacent creature and an area saving throw. It does not protect against later exposures to an ongoing effect. Uses the 2024 Shield and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While holding this shield, take a Magic action to raise up to three connected stone panels on solid ground within 25 feet. Each panel is 5 feet wide, up to 10 feet high, and 6 inches thick. Each must share a vertical edge with another panel if you create more than one. The wall cannot appear in occupied space. It provides Total Cover where it fully blocks a target. It lasts 1 hour without Concentration. Each panel has AC 17, 40 Hit Points, and Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage. A panel crumbles at 0 Hit Points, leaving the others standing. Recharges at dawn.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 120 (PDF p. 121), Stonewall Shield.
fields.Conversion notes: Keeps the original lowest-tier range, maximum height, panel count, duration, and Hit Points. Uses 2024 stone object defenses and replaces the legacy Strength check with the 2024 object damage rules. Uses the 2024 Shield and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While holding this shield, you have Resistance to Lightning and Thunder damage. When a melee attack hits you while you hold it, you can take a Reaction immediately after resolving the hit to deal 1d6 Lightning damage and 1d6 Thunder damage to the attacker. The Reaction power recharges at dawn.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 121 (PDF p. 122), Storm Shield.
fields.Conversion notes: Maps flat resistance to 2024 Resistance. Divides the original lowest-tier retaliation dice between the two types, with Resistance and Immunity applied separately to each type. Uses the 2024 Shield and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While holding this shield, add 2 to the saving throw DC when you try to Shove with an Unarmed Strike and choose to push the target. On a failed save, push the target 10 feet away from you. Apply the normal Shove size and reach limits.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 121 (PDF p. 122), Tauran Shield.
fields.Conversion notes: Converts the original bull rush bonus to +2 save DC in 2024 bounded accuracy. Preserves the extra 5 feet of push, and applies only to a push. Uses the 2024 Shield and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While holding this shield, take a Magic action to make a ranged attack against a target within 50 feet. The attack bonus is your Strength modifier plus your Proficiency Bonus if you have Shield training. On a hit, the shield deals 1d8 + your Strength modifier Bludgeoning damage. It returns to your hand immediately after the attack, hit or miss. Once per dawn, when this attack hits a creature, you can also push it 5 feet directly away from you without a save.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 121 (PDF p. 122), Throwing Shield.
fields.Conversion notes: Retains the lowest-tier attack damage, range, automatic return, and daily push. Maps the original attack bonus to Shield training and uses a Magic action, so Extra Attack cannot grant additional throws. Uses the 2024 Shield and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: As a Bonus Action while holding the shield, choose one ally within 5 feet. Until the start of your next turn, attack rolls against that ally have Disadvantage. Recharges when you finish a Short or Long Rest.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 119 (PDF p. 120), Shadowflow Shield.
fields.Conversion notes: Represents 4e concealment as Disadvantage on incoming attack rolls. Rest recharge replaces encounter recharge. Uses the 2024 Shield and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: As a Bonus Action while holding the shield, activate its protection for 1 minute. Reduce the total damage you take from each melee attack by 5, to a minimum of 0. Recharges at dawn.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 119 (PDF p. 120), Shield of Blocking.
fields.Conversion notes: Uses the original lowest-tier reduction. A one-minute duration replaces the original encounter duration. Uses the 2024 Shield and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While holding the shield, gain an additional +2 AC against Opportunity Attacks. As a Bonus Action, guard your blind spots until the end of your next turn. During that time an enemy cannot gain Advantage against you solely from an ally being on your opposite side. This activation recharges at dawn.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 120 (PDF p. 121), Shield of Eyes.
fields.Conversion notes: Retains the original extra shield bonus against opportunity attacks. The active effect applies when the table uses a flanking rule that grants Advantage. Uses the 2024 Shield and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: As a Bonus Action while holding the shield, choose one ally within 5 feet. That ally gains +1 AC for 1 minute. Recharges at dawn.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 120 (PDF p. 121), Shield of the Guardian.
fields.Conversion notes: Uses the original lowest-tier ally bonus. A one-minute duration replaces the original encounter duration. Uses the 2024 Shield and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: When an attack roll hits an ally within 5 feet of you while you hold the shield, take a Reaction. The ally gains +4 AC against that attack, potentially turning the hit into a miss. Recharges at dawn.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 120 (PDF p. 121), Shimmerlight Shield.
fields.Conversion notes: Uses the original lowest-tier defensive bonus and translates an attack against Reflex into an attack roll against AC. Uses the 2024 Shield and requires attunement.

fields.Special powers: While wearing the armor, when a spell or class feature uses your Intelligence modifier to determine a value other than an attack roll, add 1 to that value. Apply the bonus once per calculation. Your Intelligence score and modifier are unchanged for other purposes.
fields.Source locator: Adventurer’s Vault (4e), p. 54 (PDF p. 55), Tactician’s Armor.
fields.Conversion notes: Uses the lowest 4e enhancement and maps powers to 2024 spells and class features. This conversion requires attunement.

fields.Category: Martial melee weapon (Greatsword) · Legendary · Attunement unlocks additional powers
fields.Damage: 2d6 Slashing + Strength modifier + 1, plus 1d6 Necrotic. While attuned, use +2 instead of +1 and 2d6 Necrotic instead of 1d6.
fields.Attack bonus: Strength modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient. Add +1, or +2 while attuned.
fields.Range: 5 feet melee. Detection spells use their own range.
fields.Activation: Make a melee attack. While attuned and holding the sword, you can also spend charges to cast its spells.
fields.Wounding: While attuned, a creature hit by the sword cannot regain Hit Points for 1 minute. It makes a DC 15 Constitution save at the end of each turn, ending the effect on a success.
fields.Spells: Detect Magic (1 charge), Detect Evil and Good (1), or Detect Thoughts (2). Use the spells’ 2024 casting times and Concentration rules.
fields.Charges: 4 charges. Regain 1d4 expended charges at midnight.
fields.Sentience: Neutral Evil. Speaks Common and Netherese.
fields.Adventure source: Hoard of the Dragon Queen, appendix C, p. 94, with the official erratum.
fields.Conversion notes: Uses the 2024 Greatsword. The erratum confirms that the +1 enhancement and 1d6 Necrotic damage apply without attunement.

fields.Category: Any base weapon · Uncommon · No attunement
fields.Damage: Use the base weapon’s normal damage dice and damage type.
fields.Attack bonus: Use the base weapon’s normal attack formula. No magical attack or damage bonus.
fields.Range: Use the selected weapon’s reach or normal and long range.
fields.Mastery: Use the selected weapon’s mastery if eligible.
fields.Activation: Attack normally. The soul effect triggers when an attack made with the weapon kills a Humanoid.
fields.Hellfire: The slain Humanoid’s soul goes to the River Styx and immediately becomes a Lemure.
fields.Light: Veins of hellfire in the infernal iron shed Dim Light in a 5-foot radius.
fields.Adventure source: Baldur’s Gate: Descent into Avernus, appendix C, p. 223.
fields.Conversion notes: Keeps the original light and soul effects and uses the 2024 profile of the selected weapon.

fields.Category: Martial melee weapon (Longsword) · Legendary · Requires attunement by a non-Evil creature
fields.Damage: 1d8 Radiant (1d10 in two hands) + Strength or Dexterity modifier + 2. Add 1d8 Radiant against Undead.
fields.Attack bonus: +2 plus Strength or Dexterity modifier and Proficiency Bonus if proficient with Longswords or Shortswords.
fields.Range: 5 feet melee. Lesser Restoration uses Touch.
fields.Mastery: Sap if your feature grants mastery with Longswords.
fields.Activation: While grasping the hilt, use a Bonus Action to manifest or dismiss the blade. Use a Magic action to touch a creature with the blade and cast Lesser Restoration. The spell use recharges at dawn.
fields.Light: The active blade sheds sunlight. Bright Light extends 15 feet and Dim Light another 15 feet. A Magic action adjusts both by 5 feet, within 10 to 30 feet each.
fields.Sentience: Neutral Good; Intelligence 12, Wisdom 15, Charisma 14. Hearing and Darkvision to 120 feet. Speaks, reads, and understands Common and knows your languages while attuned. Communicates telepathically with its wielder.
fields.Acquisition: The gilded hilt lies in the Lost Tomb of Khaem. Dawnbringer fears the dark and resists being separated from its wielder.
fields.Conversion notes: Uses the 2024 Sun Blade and Lesser Restoration. The item retains its original action cost for casting the spell.

fields.Attunement: Requires a Good-aligned Dwarf, Fighter, or Paladin.
fields.Damage: 1d12 Slashing + Strength modifier + 2.
fields.Attack bonus: +2 plus Strength modifier and Proficiency Bonus if proficient.
fields.Range: 5 feet melee. Orc awareness 120 feet. Fear protection 30 feet.
fields.Activation: Make a melee weapon attack. On a natural 20 against an Orc, it makes a DC 17 Constitution save or drops to 0 Hit Points.
fields.Orc awareness: While holding the axe, sense whether any Orcs are within 120 feet and outside Total Cover. You do not learn their locations. If you are not Incapacitated, surprise caused by Orcs does not impose Disadvantage on your Initiative roll.
fields.Fear protection: While you hold the axe and are not Incapacitated, you and your friends within 30 feet cannot be Frightened.
fields.Sentience: Lawful Good; Intelligence 6, Wisdom 15, Charisma 10. Hearing and Darkvision to 120 feet. Communicates emotions and occasionally shares Dwarvish verse telepathically.
fields.History: Once wielded by King Torhild Flametongue. It wants a courageous wielder and seeks to defend dwarves.
fields.Conversion notes: Uses the 2024 Greataxe and translates protection from surprise into the 2024 Initiative rule.
fields.Adventure source: Princes of the Apocalypse, chapter 7, Magic Items.

fields.Category: Simple ranged weapon (Dart) · Uncommon · No attunement
fields.Damage: Seeking mode deals 1d4 Piercing plus 3d4 Lightning on a failed save. Normal dart damage is 1d4 Piercing plus Strength or Dexterity modifier.
fields.Attack bonus: Seeking mode uses a saving throw. Normal throws use Strength or Dexterity and Proficiency Bonus if proficient.
fields.Range: Seeking mode reaches 120 feet. Ordinary throws use 20/60 feet.
fields.Mastery: Vex applies only to ordinary dart attacks, if eligible.
fields.Activation: Take a Magic action, whisper the command word, and hurl the dart at one target you have seen before.
fields.Seeking path: You need not see the target now. The dart can turn corners and pass through openings at least 1 inch wide. With no clear path or a target out of range, the dart falls and its magic is spent.
fields.Saving throw: The target makes a DC 16 Dexterity save. It takes the listed damage only on a failure. After this use the dart becomes ordinary.
fields.Conversion notes: Uses a Magic action for the command-word attack and retains the source’s saving throw and one-use effect.
fields.Adventure source: Princes of the Apocalypse, chapter 7, Magic Items.

fields.Damage: 1d4 Bludgeoning + Dexterity modifier on a hit. While charged, add 3d4 Thunder.
fields.Attack bonus: Dexterity modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient. Javelin proficiency qualifies.
fields.Properties: Thrown. Returns to your hand immediately on a miss.
fields.Mastery: None assigned to this unique weapon.
fields.Activation: Make a ranged attack. On a charged hit, the target makes a DC 10 Constitution save or is Stunned until the end of its next turn.
fields.Recharge: When the boomerang deals Thunder damage, it loses its Thunder and stun effects. Both return after at least 1 hour inside an elemental air node.
fields.Conversion notes: Uses the 2024 ranged attack ability modifier and keeps the adventure’s own range, proficiency, and recharge.
fields.Adventure source: Princes of the Apocalypse, chapter 7, Magic Items.

fields.Category: Martial melee weapon · Legendary · Requires attunement
fields.Damage: 1d8 Piercing (1d10 in two hands in melee) + Strength modifier + 1. Add 1d8 Cold on a hit.
fields.Attack bonus: +1 plus Strength modifier and Proficiency Bonus if proficient.
fields.Activation: Attack normally, or while holding the weapon take a Magic action to cast Dominate Monster.
fields.Water Mastery: While holding the weapon, you can speak Aquan and have Resistance to Cold damage.
fields.Dominate Monster: Target only a water elemental you can see within 60 feet. Wisdom save DC 17. Concentration up to 1 hour. Recharges at dawn.
fields.Devastation orb ritual: Perform Tears of Endless Anguish at a matching elemental node. The ritual takes 1 hour and consumes 2,000 gp of special components to create a devastation orb of water. Recharges separately at dawn.
fields.Attunement flaw: You become possessive and demand the largest share of the spoils.
fields.Adventure source: Princes of the Apocalypse, chapter 7, Elemental Weapons. The weapon is associated with Gar Shatterkeel.
fields.Conversion notes: Uses the 2024 base weapon, mastery, and spell rules and keeps the adventure’s item powers.
fields.Special powers: Floats on water and hangs in place when released underwater. Water exposure cannot damage the trident.

fields.Category: Any base weapon · Rarity varies by state · Requires attunement
fields.Damage: Use base weapon dice and type. Add the enhancement and extra breath damage shown for the current state.

fields.Activation: Attack normally. At Wakened or Ascendant, take a Magic action to use the cone. It recharges at dawn.
fields.Slumbering · Uncommon: On a natural 20 with the weapon, each creature you choose within 5 feet of the target takes 5 damage of the infused breath type.
fields.Stirring · Rare: Keeps the natural-20 burst. Gain +1 to attack and damage rolls and deal an extra 1d6 of the infused breath type on each hit.
fields.Wakened · Very Rare: Keeps the burst. Enhancement becomes +2 and extra damage becomes 2d6. Each creature in a 30-foot Cone makes a DC 16 Dexterity save, taking 8d6 of the infused type on a failure or half on a success.

fields.Hoard progression: Ordinarily, one year in a hoard attains the state allowed by its dragon: Young (Stirring), Adult (Wakened), or Ancient (Ascendant). Starting within 1 hour of the dragon’s death, 8 hours in the hoard in its lair raises the item by one state up to the age limit.
fields.Hoard decay: While unattuned and outside a dragon’s hoard, the item drops one state every 30 days until Slumbering.
fields.Infused damage: Use the breath damage type of the dragon whose hoard infused the weapon.

fields.Range: 20 ft to a point you can see.
fields.Area: 5-ft-radius sphere.

fields.Saving throw: Sleep and choke require a DC 12 Constitution save from breathing creatures in the area. Fog has no save.

fields.Duration: Until the start of your next turn (fog) or the end of the affected creature’s next turn (sleep or choke).
fields.Crafting: Draft: Alchemist’s Supplies proficiency and access to Cayma recipes at the DM’s discretion; use the 2024 nonmagical crafting guideline.
fields.Creative use: Use fog to break line of sight while an ally retreats.
fields.Attack bonus: No inherent bonus.
fields.Conversion notes: Uses 2024 conditions and a fixed DC. Shortens legacy control to one turn and standardizes the area for a 5-ft grid.

fields.Category: Rare magic consumable · thrown by hand · one use.
fields.Activation: A halfling holding the arrow takes the Magic action and chooses Strike, Bind, or both. Strike is the default.

Your fifth such hit blesses you for 1 minute, adding 1d4 to your attack rolls and saving throws. The blessing needs no Concentration and can trigger once per Long Rest.
fields.Creative use: Carry it when the group needs to bring a fugitive back alive.

fields.Source locator: Printed p. 50, PDF p. 51 · Da-Ka-Xeen.

fields.Creative use: Carry one while handing the second to an ally who lost their weapon.

fields.Legacy source facts: +2 returning spear with doubled thrown range. Can bring back a slain animal weighing up to 100 pounds.
fields.Source locator: Printed p. 55, PDF p. 56 · Atruaghin Magic Items.

fields.Damage: 1d6 + your Strength modifier + 2 Piercing, or 1d8 + the same modifiers on a two-handed melee attack.

fields.Special powers: The harpoon returns immediately after resolving a thrown attack and can be caught in a free hand. It falls at your feet if no hand is free. If the attack kills a Beast weighing 100 lb or less, the harpoon pulls that Beast to your feet if there is a clear path for it. If the path is blocked, the harpoon returns alone.
fields.Creative use: Recover a small slain Beast across a stream without wading in.

fields.Legacy source facts: Obsidian-edged club functioning as a +1 longsword. Hits can cause ongoing bleeding.
fields.Source locator: Printed p. 56, PDF p. 57 · Atruaghin Magic Items.

fields.Damage: 1d8 + your Strength modifier + 1 Slashing, or 1d10 + the same modifiers when wielded with two hands.
fields.Attack bonus: Add Strength and your Proficiency Bonus if proficient. Add +1 from the weapon.
fields.Activation: Make a weapon attack with the Attack action.
fields.Conversion notes: Uses a +1 2024 longsword. Converts the legacy poison save to a Constitution save and limits repeated bleeding from the same weapon.
fields.Special powers: A creature hit by the weapon must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On failure it takes 1d4 Slashing at the start of each of its turns for up to 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. Regaining any Hit Points also ends the effect. A creature can have only one instance of this bleeding at a time.
fields.Creative use: Force a wounded opponent to choose between spending healing resources and staying in the fight.

fields.Legacy source facts: A +3 shortbow that briefly helps nearby allies hit and damage an animal it strikes.
fields.Source locator: Printed p. 56, PDF p. 57 · Atruaghin Magic Items.

fields.Damage: 1d6 + your Dexterity modifier + 3 Piercing.
fields.Attack bonus: Add Dexterity and your Proficiency Bonus if proficient. Add +3 from the weapon.
fields.Activation: Make a weapon attack with the Attack action.
fields.Conversion notes: Keeps the +3 shortbow and group hunting effect. Replaces the legacy +4 bonus with +2 on each ally’s first attack.
fields.Special powers: Once per turn when you hit a Beast with the bow, you can mark it until the start of your next turn. Each ally within 100 ft of you gains +2 on their first attack roll against that Beast while it is marked, and +2 to the damage roll if that attack hits. Marking a new target ends the previous mark.
fields.Creative use: Mark large prey before the hunting party commits its attacks.

fields.Category: Magical adventuring gear. No weapon mastery or attunement.
fields.Range: One creature you can see within 15 ft.
fields.Activation: Replace one attack during the Attack action to throw the net. Resolve a saving throw.
fields.Escape: A Restrained creature or a creature within 5 ft of it can use an action to free it on a successful DC 10 Strength (Athletics) check. Destroying the net also frees it.
fields.Net defenses: AC 10, 5 HP. Immune to Bludgeoning, Poison, and Psychic damage.
fields.Damage: No direct damage.
fields.Saving throw: Dexterity DC = 9 + your Dexterity modifier + proficiency bonus. Huge or larger creatures succeed automatically. On failure the target is Restrained until freed.
fields.Conversion notes: The 2024 Net uses a save instead of an attack roll. This conversion applies the legacy +1 bonus to the save DC and keeps the published escape and object rules.

fields.Damage: 1d6 Piercing plus 3. On a qualifying natural 20, sever a head or deal 30 extra Slashing as described below.

fields.Exceptions: A target immune to Slashing, one that does not need its head, or one the DM judges too large to decapitate instead takes the 30 extra Slashing. A target with Legendary Resistance can expend one use to take the extra damage instead. Normal damage immunities still apply.
fields.Special powers: Ignore Slashing Resistance for the enchantment’s extra damage. The normal Piercing damage uses the target’s normal defenses.
fields.Conversion notes: Extends the 2024 enchantment to the legacy Shortsword while retaining its Piercing base.

fields.Special powers: Kelar’s suit uses Plate Armor rules at the weight of Leather Armor. Strength below 15 reduces Speed by 10 ft.

fields.Source locator: GAZ9, pp. 21 and 61–62. Guild Elsan makes shell armor. Captain Kelar’s suit protects like plate and has leather encumbrance. Supplied PDF p. 23.

fields.Attack bonus: +2 to attack and damage rolls.
fields.Special powers: Veiled Flight grants you the Invisible condition and a 60 ft Fly Speed with hover. Concentrate for up to 10 minutes, as if concentrating on a spell. If you make an attack roll, deal damage, or cast a spell, the invisibility ends and flight can continue. Both effects end if Concentration ends.
fields.Recharge: Once used, Veiled Flight is unavailable until the fourth dawn after use.

fields.Damage: 1d8 Piercing one-handed or 1d10 two-handed, plus Strength modifier and the current enhancement.
fields.Activation: Make a normal trident attack. The enhancement reverses when the summoning imp is destroyed on the Material Plane.
fields.Attack bonus: +2 to attack and damage rolls before the curse, then −2 to both rolls.
fields.Special powers: After you first attack with the cursed trident, you are unwilling to part with it and use it whenever you make a weapon attack and can do so. Remove Curse ends your bond. The trident remains cursed for future users.
fields.Legacy source: GAZ3, p. 94, Imp. The red imp summons a small +2 trident that becomes a cursed −2 weapon if the imp is destroyed on the Prime Material Plane.
fields.Conversion notes: The bond and its removal are 2024 conversion choices. The reversal trigger and values come from the Gazetteer.

fields.Special powers: Use standard Chain Shirt rules. The Rollstone supply markings and sizing are source details.
fields.Legacy source: GAZ8, p. 40, Rollstone Keep. The arsenal holds oiled mail shirts made for halflings.

fields.Legacy source: GAZ4, p. 49, Utter Island. The weapon is treated with the compound used to harden sand architecture.
fields.Special powers: The treatment is a construction detail. Use the published base weapon’s combat rules.

fields.Damage: 1d6 Piercing one-handed or 1d8 two-handed, plus Strength modifier.
fields.Activation: Make a normal weapon attack.
fields.Legacy source: GAZ4, p. 49, Utter Island. The weapon is treated with the compound used to harden sand architecture.
fields.Special powers: The treatment is a construction detail. Use the published base weapon’s combat rules.

fields.Damage: 1d6 Piercing plus Strength or Dexterity modifier.
fields.Activation: Make a normal weapon attack.
fields.Special powers: The imitation does not qualify as a silvered or magical weapon.
fields.Legacy source: GAZ3, p. 84, Adventures in Glantri. A werewolf shopkeeper sells convincing imitation silver blades.
fields.Conversion notes: The source does not specify a blade type. Use a Shortsword for this example.

fields.Damage: 1d8 Bludgeoning one-handed or 1d10 two-handed, plus 3 and Strength modifier.
fields.Activation: Make a normal weapon attack. While holding the hammer, use a Magic action to invoke flight.
fields.Attack bonus: +3 to attack and damage rolls.
fields.Special powers: Gain a Fly Speed of 60 ft with hover. Concentrate for up to 10 minutes, as if concentrating on a spell. The effect ends early if you stop holding the hammer.
fields.Recharge: Once used, flight recharges at dawn.
fields.Legacy source: GAZ3, p. 66, Generic List of Enchantment Costs. 24,250 ducats and 32 days.
fields.Conversion notes: The crafting table names the power without specifying its operation. The draft uses the 2024 Fly spell as its benchmark.

fields.Damage: 1d10 Piercing plus 3 and Strength modifier.
fields.Activation: You can make one attack with this lance as a Bonus Action on each of your turns.
fields.Attack bonus: +3 to attack and damage rolls.
fields.Legacy source: GAZ3, p. 66, Generic List of Enchantment Costs. 45,000 ducats and 52 days.
fields.Conversion notes: The named speed enchantment uses the 2024 Scimitar of Speed’s Bonus Action attack as its benchmark.

fields.Damage: 1d6 Piercing one-handed or 1d8 two-handed, plus Strength modifier. Against a native of the Plane of Fire, add 3 to damage and add 2d6 Force if you are on that plane.
fields.Range: 5 ft melee; 20/60 ft thrown; 300 ft for the warning.
fields.Activation: Make a normal spear attack. While holding the spear, use a Magic action to cast See Invisibility on yourself.
fields.Attack bonus: +3 to attack and damage rolls against a native of the Plane of Fire, such as an efreeti.
fields.Special powers: The spear sparkles when a native of the Plane of Fire comes within 300 ft. The warning gives neither direction nor number.
fields.Duration and recharge: See Invisibility lasts 1 hour and recharges at dawn.
fields.Legacy source: GAZ2, p. 59, Fabled Treasures of Ylaruam. Farid’s spear grants +4 against Fire Plane denizens on the Prime Plane and +6 against them on the Plane of Fire. It reveals invisibility and warns at 300 ft.
fields.Conversion notes: The conversion caps the attack bonus at +3 and expresses the extra home-plane potency as Force damage.

fields.Damage: 1d8 Slashing one-handed or 1d10 two-handed, plus 2 and Strength modifier.
fields.Range: 5 ft melee; touch triggers the curse.
fields.Activation: Make a normal weapon attack. A creature handling the sword makes a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw, at most once per 24 hours and only if it is not already under this curse.
fields.Attack bonus: +2 to attack and damage rolls.
fields.Special powers: On a failed save, the handler is affected for 30 days by the 2024 Geas rules. The command is to travel to Shireton and attack the Karameikan ambassador. The sword delivers this curse without a separate casting action or components.
fields.Escape: Remove Curse ends the effect on the handler. A successful save protects that creature from this sword’s curse for 24 hours.
fields.Legacy source: GAZ8, p. 58, The Bones Out Back. Handling the +2 sword triggers a quest to attack the ambassador, with a −2 penalty to the legacy save.
fields.Conversion notes: Longsword is the chosen base. The 2024 Wisdom DC and Geas duration replace the legacy saving throw and quest procedure.

fields.Damage: 1d8 Slashing one-handed or 1d10 two-handed plus Strength modifier. A hovering strike deals 1d8 Slashing plus Strength modifier.
fields.Range: 5 ft held or within 5 ft of the hovering sword.
fields.Activation: Use a Bonus Action to release the sword or command it while hovering. Move it up to 30 ft to a point within 30 ft of you and make one melee weapon attack from its space.
fields.Special powers: A hovering attack can target only a creature with the Spellcasting trait or a magical action or trait identified by the DM. Use your normal attack modifier. The sword returns after four hovering attacks, when you grasp it, or when it is more than 30 ft from you. If it cannot return to your hand, it falls.
fields.Light: Use a Bonus Action while holding the sword to light or extinguish its fire. It sheds Bright Light in a 20 ft radius and Dim Light for another 20 ft.
fields.Legacy source: GAZ8, p. 57, The Old Sword. The story describes a floating blade that strikes magical creatures and ignites on command. The DM decides whether the legend is true.
fields.Conversion notes: Use this draft if the DM makes the legend real. The Dancing Sword supplies the movement and return benchmark.

fields.Category: Very Rare staff and simple melee weapon
fields.Damage: 1d6 Bludgeoning one-handed or 1d8 two-handed, plus 2 and Strength modifier.
fields.Activation: Make a normal staff attack, or cast one listed spell while holding the staff and spending its charge cost. Use the spell’s normal casting time, range, duration, and Concentration rules.
fields.Attack bonus: +2 to staff attack and damage rolls.
fields.Spellcasting: Magic Missile (1 charge), Dispel Magic (3), Fireball (3), or Wall of Force (5). Use your spellcasting ability and save DC. Cast at the spell’s base level without expending a spell slot or providing components.
fields.Charges: 20 charges. Regain 2d8 + 4 expended charges at dawn, up to 20.
fields.Legacy source: GAZ3, p. 66, Generic List of Enchantment Costs. 156,200 ducats, 164 days, and twenty rechargeable charges.
fields.Conversion notes: The Gazetteer table specifies the crafting figures and charges. The combat bonus, recharge rate, and selected spells use Staff of Power as a 2024 benchmark.

fields.Damage: 1d6 Bludgeoning one-handed or 1d8 two-handed, plus Strength modifier.
fields.Activation: Make a normal staff attack. While holding the staff and attuned, its breathing and movement effects are active.
fields.Special powers: You can breathe water and gain a Swim Speed equal to your Speed. On the Elemental Plane of Water, those benefits also apply to each creature of your choice within 10 ft of you. A creature loses the shared benefit when it leaves the area.
fields.Legacy source: GAZ9, p. 42, Relic Crafts. The staff uses three Pearl of Power fragments. The water elves may grant it for a significant quest.
fields.Conversion notes: Use Quarterstaff combat rules. Swim Speed expresses the legacy underwater movement effect. The shared radius follows the source and applies on the Elemental Plane of Water.

fields.Damage: 1d6 Bludgeoning one-handed or 1d8 two-handed, plus Strength modifier.
fields.Range: 5 ft melee; 120 ft for Dispel Magic.
fields.Activation: Make a normal staff attack, or use a Magic action while holding the staff and expend 1 charge to cast Dispel Magic at level 3.
fields.Charges: 3 charges. Regain 1d3 spent charges at dawn.
fields.Special powers: For effects above level 3, make the normal Dispel Magic ability check using your spellcasting ability.
fields.Legacy source: GAZ8, p. 33, Halflings, Heroes and Highwayhin. Marintor Treeshadow carries the staff. The Gazetteer gives its name without a spell or charge procedure.
fields.Conversion notes: The spell, charges, and attunement are 2024 design choices for this Gazetteer appearance.

fields.Damage: 1d4 Piercing plus Strength or Dexterity modifier.
fields.Activation: Make a normal dagger attack.
fields.Attunement: Set by the DM if an enchantment is assigned.
fields.Special powers: Use the standard Dagger profile until the DM assigns any magic. The mithril blade and bone grip describe its construction.
fields.Legacy source: GAZ11, p. 57, The Eagle’s Talons. Sahlynda offers the dagger for help escaping. The referee determines its magic.

fields.Damage: 1d4 Bludgeoning plus Strength modifier.
fields.Activation: Make a normal melee weapon attack with one bludgeon.
fields.Special powers: Each bludgeon occupies one hand while in use. Use the normal Light weapon rules when wielding a pair.
fields.Legacy source: GAZ8, p. 25, Malaric, Lord Caine. Caine conceals these alongside daggers while wearing a court rapier openly.
fields.Conversion notes: The source gives no construction or attack details. The Club profile represents a compact hand-held bludgeon.

gazetteer-local-pdf-reference:6a9440c634.label: D&D 2024 adaptation · Karst’s Razor-Edged Throwing Shield

fields.Damage: 2d4 Slashing plus Strength modifier.
fields.Activation: If you are wielding the shield, you can replace one attack during the Attack action with throwing it. Make a ranged attack using Strength. Add your proficiency bonus if you have Shield training.
fields.Special powers: With Shield training, gain +2 AC while wielding it. Throwing ends your AC bonus immediately. The shield lands in the target’s space on a hit or miss, and it does not return by itself. Recover it and use a Utilize action to don it again.
fields.Conversion notes: Preserves the source’s damage as 2d4. Uses the 2024 Shield’s AC and donning rules. Range and attack procedure are conversion choices.
fields.Source locator: GAZ8, p. 48, Rundegos. Karst sells the spinning razor-edged shield for 1 gp. The source gives 2–8 damage. Supplied PDF p. 73.

gazetteer-local-pdf-reference:65281be9fe.label: D&D 2024 adaptation · Guildmaster’s Guard Magical Armor

fields.Special powers: Use Chain Mail +1 for the guard’s magical armor. Strength below 13 reduces Speed by 10 ft.
fields.Conversion notes: Chain Mail +1 supplies modern AC 17 as the chosen heavy-armor profile.
fields.Source locator: GAZ11, p. 51, Guard Room. The magical armor grants legacy AC 3. The entry gives no base armor type. Supplied PDF p. 52.

fields.Category: Legendary magic scabbard and summoned martial melee weapon
fields.Damage: 2d8 Slashing plus 3 on a hit by the summoned blade.
fields.Range: The blade strikes a creature within 5 ft of itself.
fields.Activation: While holding the attuned scabbard, use a Magic action to summon the blade in an unoccupied space within 30 ft. On later turns, use a Bonus Action to move it up to 30 ft within 30 ft of you and make one attack from its space.
fields.Attack bonus: +11 for the summoned blade’s attacks.
fields.Properties: Summoned blade. The scabbard controls its movement.
fields.Duration and recharge: Lasts 1 minute. The blade vanishes early if it is more than 30 ft from you or you release the scabbard. Once summoned, it cannot be summoned again until dawn.
fields.Legacy source: GAZ2, p. 63, The City of Brass. The scabbard is the actual treasure. It calls forth a sword that fights as a 20th-level fighter in the original rules.
fields.Conversion notes: The summoned sword has a fixed attack and damage profile inspired by Dancing Sword. The displayed Longsword link is a reference for its form.

fields.Damage: 1d8 Slashing one-handed or 1d10 two-handed, plus Strength modifier.
fields.Activation: Make a normal weapon attack.
fields.Legacy source: GAZ3, p. 10, The Glantrian Economy. Fine swords are a specialty of Belcadiz metalworkers.
fields.Conversion notes: Longsword is the base chosen for this example. Fine workmanship adds no combat bonus.

fields.Damage: 1d8 Piercing plus Dexterity modifier.
fields.Activation: Make a normal ranged weapon attack using an arrow.
fields.Legacy source: GAZ3, p. 11, Wealth of the Principalities. Erewan bowyers produce small quantities of excellent bows.
fields.Conversion notes: Longbow is the base chosen for this example. Workmanship adds no combat bonus.

gazetteer-local-pdf-reference:b27c92b4ae.label: D&D 2024 adaptation · Belcadiz Light Metal Armor

fields.Special powers: Use the Chain Shirt’s standard donning and doffing rules.
fields.Conversion notes: Chain Shirt is the chosen 2024 profile for a light metal suit. Its training category is Medium armor.
fields.Source locator: GAZ3, p. 10, The Glantrian Economy. Belcadiz metalworkers specialize in light metal armor. Supplied PDF p. 11.

fields.Damage: 1d4 Bludgeoning plus Strength modifier.
fields.Activation: Make a melee attack. If you would reduce a creature to 0 HP, you can instead leave it at 1 HP and give it the Unconscious condition.
fields.Special powers: The knocked-out creature begins a Short Rest. It wakes at the end of that rest, if it regains HP, or if someone uses an action and succeeds on a DC 10 Wisdom (Medicine) check to give first aid.
fields.Legacy source: GAZ2, p. 47. The mock-war contests use blunted arms.
fields.Conversion notes: A Club is the chosen sample blunted weapon. Use the 2024 knockout procedure.

gazetteer-local-pdf-reference:d40bbd47d4.label: Armor accessory · Nob Nar’s Bone Helm

fields.Special powers: The helm is a piece of costume or armor trim. It grants no separate AC or magical protection.
fields.Conversion notes: The 2024 armor table has no separate helmet AC. A suit of armor can include this helm as part of its appearance.
fields.Source locator: GAZ8, p. 16, The Ballad of Nob Nar. The verse describes an old bone helm. Supplied PDF p. 17.
fields.Use as armor: +0. Use the AC of any armor worn with it.

fields.Role: Clerical holy symbol in the form of a claymore.
fields.Tabletop use: Treat the carried symbol as a Spellcasting Focus for a Cleric or Paladin.
fields.Combat rules: The source gives this object a ceremonial role. Use a separate weapon profile for any functional claymore assigned by the DM.
fields.Legacy source: GAZ3, p. 28, Marauders, Mages and Masters. Sir Bruce carries the claymore as his holy symbol and does not fight with it.

fields.Tabletop use: Choose the individual weapon from the 2024 equipment table. Use that weapon’s damage, range, properties and mastery.
fields.Combat rules: An etched blade, pommel or grip with a sea motif grants no combat bonus.
fields.Legacy source: GAZ9, p. 24, Guild Hammer. Minrothad smiths incorporate sea motifs into metal weapons.

fields.Tabletop use: Choose the individual weapon from the 2024 equipment table. Use its damage, range, properties and mastery.
fields.Combat rules: Highland steel is a material description. Apply a magical or special-material rule only if the specific weapon has one.
fields.Legacy source: GAZ2, p. 10, Economics of the Emirates. Dwarven smiths work ore from the Nithian and Dythestenian highlands.

fields.Tabletop use: Choose the individual simple or martial weapon. Use its published damage, range, properties and mastery, then apply the inherited +1 or +2 enhancement.
fields.Combat rules: Add the specified bonus to attack and damage rolls made with the weapon. A +1 weapon is Uncommon. A +2 weapon is Rare. Neither requires attunement.
fields.Legacy source: GAZ2, p. 44, The Village of Kirkuk. Some Humum warriors carry +1 or +2 weapons inherited from forebears who fought with Al-Kalim.

fields.Damage: 1d4 Piercing plus Strength or Dexterity modifier.
fields.Range: 5 ft melee; 20/60 ft thrown. Soul capture requires a melee hit.
fields.Activation: Make a normal dagger attack. When a melee hit with it kills a Humanoid, you can take a Reaction to trap that creature’s soul.
fields.Special powers: The dagger can contain one soul for up to 24 hours. While trapped, the creature cannot be returned to life. You can release the soul as a Magic action while holding the dagger. Destroying the dagger also releases the soul.
fields.Recharge: After trapping a soul, this property cannot be used again until the next dawn, and the dagger must be empty.
fields.Legacy source: GAZ2, p. 44, The Village of Kirkuk. Barimoor’s apprentices made soul daggers to gather souls for an enchantment ritual.
fields.Conversion notes: The death trigger, duration, and release procedure are 2024 conversion choices. The legacy ritual remains a story use.

fields.Category: Rare staff and simple melee weapon
fields.Damage: 1d6 Bludgeoning one-handed or 1d8 two-handed, plus Strength modifier.
fields.Range: 5 ft melee. Use the selected spell’s range.
fields.Activation: Make a normal staff attack, or cast one of its spells while holding it and spending the listed charges. Use the spell’s normal casting time and Concentration rules.
fields.Spellcasting: Create or Destroy Water (1 charge), Lesser Restoration (2), or Protection from Energy (3). Cast at base level using your spellcasting ability. No spell slot or components required.
fields.Charges: 6 charges. Regain 1d4 + 2 spent charges at dawn, up to 6.
fields.Legacy source: GAZ2, p. 34, Dervishes. Saddam the Aged carries a staff charged with dervish clerical spells.
fields.Conversion notes: The source leaves the spells unspecified. The draft chooses three 2024 Cleric spells for desert travel and protection.

fields.Damage: No damage or condition.
fields.Range: Choose an unoccupied point you can see in the air within 60 ft.
fields.Activation: While holding the staff, take a Magic action to launch its one display. Afterward the staff is inert.
fields.Special powers: The display produces colored sparks at the chosen point and a report audible within 300 ft. It lasts until the end of your turn.
fields.Legacy source: GAZ3, p. 43, Glantri City by Night. The single-use staff makes noisy, colorful aerial explosions and costs 30 ducats.
fields.Conversion notes: The range and duration are tabletop defaults for a harmless display.

fields.Category: Mounted magical weapon for a Dragonfly construct
fields.Damage: Three darts, each dealing 1d4 + 1 Force.
fields.Activation: A creature operating one mounted staff uses a Magic action and spends 1 charge to cast Magic Missile at level 1. Choose one or more visible targets for the three darts.
fields.Special powers: The darts strike without an attack roll or save. Shield can negate Magic Missile as described by that spell. Operate each swivel staff separately.
fields.Charges: 3 charges per staff. Regain 1d3 spent charges at dawn, up to 3.
fields.Legacy source: GAZ3, p. 88, Apocalypse Then. The Dragonfly carries rapid-fire magic missile staffs, one mounted on each side.
fields.Conversion notes: The standard 2024 spell supplies the shot rules. The charge limit and operator action are conversion choices.

fields.Damage: 20d6 Lightning on a failed save, half as much on a successful one.
fields.Range: A 120 ft line, 5 ft wide, originating from you.
fields.Activation: While holding the attuned device, take a Magic action and expend 1 charge to fire a bolt.
fields.Saving throw: Each creature in the line makes a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw.
fields.Charges: Jaggar’s device has 50 charges remaining. Expended charges do not return. It is inert when empty.
fields.Recharge: After firing, the device cannot fire again until dawn, even if charges remain.
fields.Legacy source: GAZ3, p. 24, Marauders, Mages and Masters. The blue-metal relic deals 20d6 damage and has 50 charges left.
fields.Conversion notes: The source damage and remaining charges are preserved. The 2024 Staff of Thunder and Lightning supplies the line and save benchmark. The once-per-dawn limit is a conversion choice.

fields.Damage: 2d6 Acid on a failed save. A creature that fails the save can take 1d6 additional Acid damage at the start of its next turn.
fields.Range: One creature or object you can see within 20 ft.
fields.Activation: Replace one attack during the Attack action with throwing the container. The item is expended.
fields.Saving throw: Dexterity DC = 8 + your Dexterity modifier + proficiency bonus. A success avoids both damage effects.
fields.Special powers: Before the start of the affected creature’s next turn, it or a creature within 5 ft of it can use a Utilize action to remove the slime and prevent the additional damage. Objects take only the initial damage.
fields.Legacy source: GAZ3, p. 88, Adventures in Glantri, Reds. The adventure names the insurgents’ green slime bombs without a combat procedure.
fields.Conversion notes: This draft uses the 2024 Acid item as its throw benchmark and gives the slime one brief follow-up effect.

fields.Special powers: While wearing the armor, resist Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.
fields.Metal Shell: Use a Magic action to become immune to those three damage types for 10 minutes. The effect ends if you remove the armor. Recharges at dawn.

fields.Special powers: While wielding it, add +2 AC on top of the shield’s usual +2. Shield training is required for the AC benefit.
fields.Forceful Bash: During the Attack action, use one attack to bash a target within 5 ft. Roll with Strength and proficiency. On a hit deal 2d6 + 2 + Strength modifier Force damage. You may push a creature up to 10 ft directly away and also knock it Prone if it is your size or smaller.
fields.Protective Field: Use a Reaction when you or a visible ally within 5 ft is targeted by an attack or rolls a save against an area effect. A stationary 5 ft Emanation forms around you and lasts for up to 1 minute with Concentration. Anything partly outside is pushed into the nearest unoccupied space outside.
fields.Field protection: The triggering effect cannot affect anything inside. Nothing can cross the field, and effects and attacks cannot deal damage across it in either direction. Recharges at dawn.

fields.Special powers: Advantage on saves against Dragon breath weapons. The dragon’s scales determine one damage resistance.
fields.Resistance: Black or copper: Acid. Blue or bronze: Lightning. Brass, gold or red: Fire. Green: Poison. Silver or white: Cold.
fields.Detect Dragon: Use a Magic action to learn the distance and direction to the nearest matching dragon within 30 miles. Recharges at dawn.

dndbeyond:9228928.label: Verified 2024 armor rules · Half Plate Armor

fields.Special powers: While wearing the armor, use a Magic action and the command word to gain the effect of Etherealness for up to 8 hours. The effect ends if you remove the armor or use a Magic action to repeat the command word.
fields.Recharge: Recharges at dawn.

fields.Special powers: While wearing the armor, use a Magic action and the command word to gain the effect of Etherealness for up to 8 hours. The effect ends if you remove the armor or use a Magic action to repeat the command word.
fields.Recharge: Recharges at dawn.

fields.Attack bonus: +3 to attack and damage rolls.
fields.Damage: 2d6 Slashing plus 3 and Strength modifier. On a hit against an Undead, you take 1d10 Necrotic and the target regains 1d10 HP.
fields.Activation: Make a normal Greatsword attack. Devour Soul triggers at 0 HP.
fields.Devour Soul: Reducing a creature to 0 HP with the sword slays it and consumes its soul, except for Constructs and Undead. If the sword’s Necrotic backlash reduces you to 0 HP, it consumes your soul. Only Wish can revive a consumed creature. When it consumes another soul, gain temporary HP equal to the slain creature’s HP maximum.
fields.While held: Immunity to Charmed and Frightened. Blindsight to 30 ft.
fields.Haste: The sword chooses when to cast Haste on you at the start of your turn, once per dawn. It lasts up to 1 minute without Concentration. The sword can end it at the end of any of your turns.
fields.Sentience: Chaotic Neutral; Intelligence 17, Wisdom 10, Charisma 19. Hearing and Darkvision to 120 ft. Speaks Common and communicates telepathically with its wielder. While attuned, it understands your languages.
fields.Conflict: If three or more days pass without a soul, conflict occurs at the next sunset.
fields.Destruction: The great gears of Mechanus can crush it. A sequence of tones known by Primus can also shatter it.

fields.Attack bonus: +3 to attack and damage rolls.
fields.Damage: 1d8 Piercing one-handed or 1d10 two-handed, plus 3 and Strength modifier. A natural 20 adds 21 Necrotic.
fields.Activation: Make a normal Trident attack, or cast one of the item’s spells using its normal casting time.
fields.While held: Advantage on Initiative. You can breathe normally underwater.
fields.Aquatic Command: While carrying Wave, spend 1 charge to cast Dominate Beast (DC 20) on a Beast with a Swim Speed. Wave has 3 charges and regains 1d3 spent charges at dawn.
fields.Globe of Invulnerability: While holding Wave, cast the level 9 version of Globe of Invulnerability. This property recharges at dawn.
fields.Sentience: Neutral; Intelligence 14, Wisdom 10, Charisma 18. Hearing and Darkvision to 120 ft. Speaks Aquan and communicates telepathically with its wielder.
fields.Conflict: Wave promotes worship of sea gods and clashes with a wielder who fails to advance its aims.
fields.Destruction: It must be melted down on Thunderforge by a storm giant or someone imbued with a storm giant’s strength. Doing so angers a sea god.

fields.Attunement: Required by a Dwarf or a creature attuned to a Belt of Dwarvenkind.
fields.Attack bonus: +3 to attack and damage rolls.
fields.Damage: 1d8 Bludgeoning one-handed or 1d10 two-handed, plus 3 and Strength modifier. A ranged hit adds 1d8 Force, or 4d8 against a Construct, Elemental, or Giant.
fields.Activation: Make a normal attack. After a throw, the hammer returns on a hit or miss.
fields.Shock Wave: Use a Magic action to strike the ground. Chosen creatures on the ground within 60 ft of impact make a DC 20 Constitution save or become Stunned for 1 minute. Repeat the save at the end of each affected turn. Recharges at dawn.
fields.Supernatural Awareness: While held, it reveals the location of hidden doors within 30 ft. You can cast Detect Evil and Good or Locate Object, each once per dawn.
fields.Sentience: Lawful Neutral; Intelligence 15, Wisdom 12, Charisma 15. Hearing and Darkvision to 120 ft. Speaks Dwarvish, Giant, and Goblin and communicates telepathically with its wielder.
fields.Conflict: Whelm seeks to protect dwarves and return to the Mightyhammer clan. It clashes with wielders who reject that purpose.
fields.Destruction: The acidic bile of a recently slain ancient black dragon can dissolve it. The rightful Mightyhammer leader can melt it in the clan’s forges.

fields.Attack bonus: +3 to attack and damage rolls.
fields.Damage: 1d8 Slashing one-handed or 1d10 two-handed, plus 3 and Strength modifier.
fields.Activation: While holding the sword, use a Reaction to make one melee attack with it against a creature in your reach that deals damage to you.
fields.Special powers: You have Advantage on the retaliatory attack. Its damage ignores the target’s Resistance and Immunity to that damage.

fields.Damage: Use the launcher’s damage. If the projectile damages a creature of the designated type, add 6d10 Force on a failed save or half as much on a success.

fields.Expenditure: After dealing its extra damage, the projectile becomes nonmagical.

fields.Don or doff: Utilize action. Shield training is required to gain the AC benefit.

fields.Don or doff: Utilize action. Shield training is required to gain the AC benefit.
fields.Special powers: While holding the shield, resist damage from attacks made with ranged weapons.
fields.Curse: Attunement curses you. If a ranged weapon attack targets a creature within 10 ft of you, you become its target. Removing the shield leaves the curse in effect. Remove Curse or similar magic ends it.

fields.Command: Speak “Khazan” within 10 feet to activate it. It follows the activating creature’s instructions and becomes Incapacitated again after 24 hours without a new instruction. The command can reactivate it.

fields.Control: It understands Common and obeys only Strahd. It appears to be ordinary armor while motionless.
fields.Antimagic: Incapacitated in an Antimagic Field. Dispel Magic forces a Constitution save against the caster’s spell save DC. On failure it falls Unconscious for 1 minute.
fields.Attacks: Two Greatsword attacks or two Shocking Bolts. Greatsword: +6 to hit, reach 5 feet, 2d6 + 3 Slashing plus 1d6 Lightning. Shocking Bolt: +4 to hit at 60 feet, 3d6 Lightning, with Advantage against a target wearing metal armor.

mystara-monstrous-compendium-local:d118f.label: D&D 2024 adaptation · Ash Crawler Hardened Leather Armor

fields.Source locator: Monstrous Compendium: Mystara Appendix, Ash Crawler, Ecology, printed p. 10 (supplied PDF p. 11).
fields.Legacy facts: Tanned ash crawler hide forms hardened leather. The original reduces fire damage and improves saves against magical fire. A halfling suit needs four hides, a typical human suit at least nine.
fields.Special powers: While wearing the armor and attuned to it, you have Resistance to Fire damage.
fields.Conversion notes: Uses the Leather Armor profile. Fire Resistance replaces the legacy reduction per die and the save bonus.
fields.Crafting: For this adaptation, four sound hides for a halfling fit or at least nine for a typical human fit are required. Use the 2024 magic-item crafting rules for Rare armor. A failed preparation can spoil the hides as in the original, when first exposed to flame or within 1d4 weeks, at the DM’s discretion.
