fields.Conversion notes: Models the legacy light as the torch-like illumination of Continual Flame. Use a Utilize action to don or doff, and Shield training to gain the +2 AC.
fields.Crafting: The draft uses Continual Flame cast on the shield, consuming 50 gp of ruby dust. The shield itself costs 10 gp before any campaign adjustments.

fields.Legacy facts: Elemental form of a mundane sword arriving through a wormhole to the Plane of Water. It reverts when leaving the same way. Returning by a different route preserves the form, which the destination environment may destroy.
fields.Conversion notes: Uses a Longsword as the default for the planar example. If converting a different sword, retain its normal weapon profile and change its damage type while in ice form.
fields.Special powers: The sword reverts to its original material when taken back through the same wormhole. If removed by another route, it remains ice and can melt at the DM’s discretion. This adaptation changes its hit damage to Cold while it remains ice.

fields.Activation: Make a normal Quarterstaff attack.
fields.Source locator: Wrath of the Immortals, The Immortals’ Fury, printed p. 34 (supplied PDF p. 169).
fields.Legacy facts: Six-foot enchanted ebony staff made by Rheddrian. The story he tells the party about a matching staff is a cover. Commune reaches Rheddrian directly.
fields.Conversion notes: Uses Quarterstaff proficiency and preserves the source’s exceptional 1d10 attack die. Charges replace the original Temporary Power costs, and a resource restriction translates the legacy mortal forgetfulness drawback.
fields.Special powers: Has 3 charges and regains all at dawn. Spend 1 charge as a Magic action and speak the ward command to gain Resistance to nonmagical ammunition damage for 1 minute. Spend 2 charges after meditating for 1 minute and saying Rheddrian’s name to cast Commune, contacting Rheddrian directly without Material components.
fields.Drawback: While attuned, you have Disadvantage on saves against spells that deal Fire damage. After invoking either power, a mortal wearer rolls 1d10. On a 1 for the ward, or a 1–2 for Commune, they cannot cast one randomly chosen prepared spell until their next Long Rest.

fields.Damage: No direct damage.

fields.Range: 15 feet normally, or 30 feet with Flying.
fields.Activation: Replace one attack of the Attack action to throw the net at one visible creature. A failed save Restrains it until freed. Huge or larger targets succeed automatically.
fields.Escape: The target or a creature within 5 feet of it can take an action and succeed on a DC 10 Strength (Athletics) check to free it. Destroying the net also frees it. Net AC 10, 5 HP, immune to Bludgeoning, Poison, and Psychic damage.
fields.Flying: Once per Long Rest, speak its command as part of throwing it to extend its range to 30 feet. If the target succeeds on the initial save, it immediately flies back to your hand if the path is clear. If it Restrains the target, it stays in place.
fields.Source locator: Wrath of the Immortals, Codex of the Immortals, printed p. 33 (supplied PDF p. 35). Flying talent: supplied PDF p. 99.
fields.Conversion notes: Uses the 2024 Net procedure. The legacy +1 attack bonus has no direct equivalent on this saving throw profile.

fields.Sentience: Intelligence 7, chaotic. It conveys impressions to its attuned wielder. While holding it, you know the location of creatures with the Invisible condition within 20 feet that are not behind Total Cover. This awareness grants no vision.

fields.Legacy facts: Iron and wood swirl together in a heavy staff that deals 1d8 in a nagpa’s hands or 1d6 for another wielder. It stores three spells of levels 1 through 3, usable by others and cast at 8th level under the original rules.

fields.Category: Simple ranged weapon · Very Rare · Requires attunement
fields.Damage: 1d4 Bludgeoning + Dexterity modifier. The +3 enhancement applies to the attack roll only.
fields.Attack bonus: +3 plus Dexterity modifier and Proficiency Bonus if proficient.
fields.Properties: Ammunition (Sling Bullet); requires a free hand to load ordinary ammunition.
fields.Mastery: Slow, if you have mastery with Slings.
fields.Activation: Make a normal Sling attack. Ammunition fired from the sling counts as magical for the attack.
fields.Arsenal: At discovery, roll 1d10 + 10 to determine how many objects the sling can store. Each object must fit in a halfling’s closed fist. Add one object as a Utilize action only in the presence of active Blackflame.
fields.Retrieve: While holding the sling, whisper its command as a Bonus Action to bring one random stored object into its cup. Retrieve at most one object per round. If it is suitable ammunition, it can be used for your next attack.
fields.Loss of contents: Only the sling’s wielder can retrieve stored objects. If the sling is destroyed, the stored items are scattered to another plane chosen by the DM.
fields.Legacy crafting: 90,000 gp and seven days in the original setting’s construction rules.
fields.Conversion notes: Preserves the attack-only bonus, random extradimensional storage, and Blackflame loading restriction. The modern action costs are conversion choices.

fields.Absorb flames: As a Magic action, touch an ordinary fire with the blade to extinguish nonmagical flames in a 10-foot radius of the point touched. If it extinguishes fire, the dagger gains 1 ember, up to 2. Embers fade at the next dawn. This does not stop damage from heat, smoke, or collapsing objects.
fields.Release flames: Once per Long Rest, spend all stored embers to release 2d6 Fire damage per ember. Either use a Magic action to release a 40-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line from the dagger (DC 15 Dexterity save for half damage), or release it on one melee hit to add the damage to that hit with no save.
fields.Legacy crafting: 175,000 gp and seven days in the original setting’s construction rules.
fields.Conversion notes: Preserves flame storage, the 40-foot discharge, and the single-target option. The modern absorption is limited to ordinary fire and uses capped embers.

fields.Attack bonus: +3 plus Strength or Dexterity modifier and Proficiency Bonus if proficient.
fields.Mastery: Vex, if you have mastery with Shortswords.
fields.Activation: Make a Shortsword attack, invoke its Silence, or use Spell Reflection when eligible.
fields.Dim blade: The drawn blade is visually imperceptible in Dim Light or Darkness. This grants no attack advantage by itself.
fields.Silence: Once per Long Rest, use a Magic action to create a 20-foot Emanation centered on the drawn sword for up to 6 rounds, requiring Concentration. Use the Silence spell’s effects within the Emanation. It moves with the sword and ends if you let go or end Concentration.
fields.Spell Reflection: Once per Long Rest when a spell of level 5 or lower targets only you, take a Reaction while holding the sword to negate the spell against you. If the original caster is a valid target within the spell’s range from you, redirect it to that caster using the original slot level, save DC, and attack bonus. Otherwise the spell is absorbed with no further effect.
fields.Legacy crafting: 275,000 gp and twelve days in the original setting’s construction rules.
fields.Conversion notes: Uses a +3 tabletop benchmark for the legacy +4. Reflection applies to single-target spells and leaves area spells to their normal rules.

fields.Special powers: While wielding the shield with training and attunement, add +3 AC normally, or +5 AC total against ranged weapon attack rolls. When Magic Missile targets you while wielding this shield, you can take a Reaction and roll a d10. On 1–2, negate the darts that target you. Resolve darts aimed at other targets normally.
fields.Source locator: AD&D 1e DMG, table III.F Armor and Shield, roll 97.
fields.Conversion notes: Retains the +1 general enhancement and one-in-five chance to negate Magic Missile. Caps the legacy +4 missile-specific enhancement at +3 above the ordinary +2 Shield bonus. The 2024 rules use a Reaction for active interception and omit facing by default.

fields.Special powers: While wearing and attuned to the armor, take a Magic action and speak its command word to expend 1 charge and gain the effect of Etherealness for up to 8 hours. Doffing the armor or repeating its command word as a Magic action ends the effect. Dispel Magic can end the effect as a level 7 spell if the caster can legally target it. A successful dispel suppresses this property until the next dawn. The armor has 20 charges when found and never regains them. Recalculate AC immediately after spending a charge.
fields.Source locator: AD&D 1e DMG, table III.F Armor and Shield, roll 39.
fields.Conversion notes: The 1e bonus drops from +5 to +4, +3, +2, and +1 at 5, 10, 15, and 20 uses. The modern profile caps the bonus at +3 and retains the last two decreases. Dispel Magic substitutes for the legacy Phase Door countermeasure.
fields.Armor class by charges: 21 with 6–20 charges, 20 with 1–5 charges, and 19 with 0 charges.

fields.Special powers: Attuning curses you until Remove Curse or similar magic ends the curse. Doffing the shield leaves the curse active. While you wield it, its curse cancels the ordinary +2 shield bonus. When an attacker makes a ranged weapon attack against a creature within 10 feet of you, you become the target if the attack can legally target you. This redirection is automatic and applies even if you put the shield down.
fields.Source locator: AD&D 1e DMG, table III.F Armor and Shield, roll 98-00.
fields.Conversion notes: Preserves the loss of shield protection. Replaces the legacy random targeting odds with the 2024 counterpart’s forced redirection, without adding damage resistance.

fields.Special powers: When placing the armor, choose cursed AC 14, 15, or 16 (default 16). It appears to be Plate Armor with a bonus of +3, +2, or +1 respectively, and Identify reports that apparent bonus. Its actual AC is 18 before the curse is revealed. The first hit by a hostile creature while the attuned wearer wears the suit reveals the curse after the hit resolves. Use the chosen cursed AC on subsequent attacks. A natural 20 that hits the attuned wearer breaks the suit after resolving the attack, including on the hit that reveals it. A broken suit provides no AC. Remove Curse ends the binding and allows the suit to be discarded. The curse remains on the item.
fields.Source locator: AD&D 1e DMG, table III.F Armor and Shield, roll 40-44.
fields.Conversion notes: Keeps the false positive enhancement, hidden curse, and natural-20 breakage. Ordinary plate AC is an explicit conversion choice before the first hostile hit reveals the true penalty.
fields.Cursed armor class: 14, 15, or 16 once the curse is revealed, while wearing the intact suit.

fields.Special powers: Roll 2d12 charges when the suit is found. While wearing and attuned to it, take a Magic action and speak its command word to expend 1 charge. Each other creature in a 30-foot Emanation makes a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure it is Frightened of you for 1d4 + 1 rounds, rolled once per use. On each of its turns it must move away from you by the safest available route if it can, using Dash if needed. It can repeat the save at the end of each turn to end the effect on itself. Charges never return. The armor remains +1 Plate at 0 charges.
fields.Source locator: AD&D 2e DMG, table 107, roll 13-14.
fields.Conversion notes: The revised printed source gives 2d12 charges and 1d4 + 1 rounds of fear. This conversion uses a Wisdom save and repeat saves for the legacy panic effect.

fields.Special powers: While wielding the shield, take a Magic action to fire a spine at one target. fields.Special powers: The shield holds one inscription of a cantrip or a spell of level 1–3. When a scroll would be consumed, erase the inscription and reuse the strip.

fields.Special powers: While wearing and attuned to this mithral suit, gain +1 AC. It has no Strength minimum or Stealth disadvantage. fields.Conversion notes: Translates the original ten daily rounds into one continuous 2024 Haste casting. Keeps the source’s 25 lb mithral harness.

fields.Special powers: While wearing and attuned to the armor, gain +2 AC. While you openly display the armor, add +2 to Charisma checks made to Influence a creature that can see you. fields.Source locator: D&D 3.5 DMG, p. 220, table 7–7.
fields.Conversion notes: Converts the legacy Charisma bonus and troop morale into the 2024 Influence action and Frightened saves. Both benefits rely on visible armor.

fields.Special powers: While wielding and attuned to the shield, take a Magic action to touch one nonmagical object or a creation of magical force within 5 feet. A Large or smaller target disintegrates. For a Huge or larger target, a 10-foot Cube of the target disintegrates. Carried or worn objects require an unwilling holder to fail a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. The shield regains the power at the second dawn after use.

fields.Conversion notes: Preserves the contact requirement and two-day recharge. Uses 2024 Disintegrate object limits and adds a save for objects held or worn by an unwilling creature.

fields.Special powers: While wielding and attuned to the shield, take a Magic action to cast Fly on yourself without spell components, with Concentration for up to 10 minutes. The spell ends if you stop wielding the shield. The power recharges at dawn.
fields.Source locator: D&D 3.5 DMG, p. 221, table 7–8.
fields.Conversion notes: Retains both load tiers and the original once-per-day flight. The 2024 spell supplies the duration and Concentration.

fields.Damage: Base 1d4 Piercing. Add 1 to normal damage. A failed save against the coating adds 2d10 Poison damage.
fields.Activation: Use a Bonus Action to coat the dagger. The first hit against a creature expends the coating.
fields.Attack bonus: +1 to attack and damage rolls.
fields.Saving throw: DC 15 Constitution. On a failure the target also has the Poisoned condition for 1 minute.
fields.Duration: Coating lasts up to 1 minute. Recharge at the next dawn.
fields.Source locator: D&D 3.5 Dungeon Master’s Guide, p. 227, table 7–16.
fields.Edition notes: The 2024 coating uses a Bonus Action and a fixed Poison damage rider.

fields.Damage: Base 1d8 Piercing. A hit against your sworn enemy adds 3d6 Piercing.
fields.Activation: When making a ranged attack, speak or sign the oath to designate the target as your sworn enemy.
fields.Duration: One sworn enemy at a time, until it dies or dawn seven days later. After it dies, choose a new enemy after the next dawn.
fields.Special powers: Against the sworn enemy, gain Advantage with this bow, ignore Half and Three-Quarters Cover, and ignore Disadvantage from long range. While that enemy lives, attacks with other weapons have Disadvantage.
fields.Source locator: D&D 3.5 Dungeon Master’s Guide, p. 227, table 7–16.
fields.Edition notes: Uses the Longbow variant for the original composite longbow. Use the published sworn-enemy timing and damage.

fields.Damage: Base 1d8 Slashing. Add 2 to normal damage.
fields.Activation: When you roll a natural 20 on an attack against a creature with fewer than 100 HP.
fields.Attack bonus: +2 to attack and damage rolls.
fields.Saving throw: DC 15 Constitution or die instantly. Constructs and Undead succeed automatically.
fields.Charges: Starts with 1d8 + 1 charges. Spend one only if the effect kills the target. The effect is lost at zero charges.
fields.Source locator: D&D 3.5 Dungeon Master’s Guide, p. 227, table 7–16.
fields.Edition notes: Retains the longsword form. Use the 2024 Hit Point threshold, save and charge expenditure.

fields.Damage: 1d8 Radiant one-handed or 1d10 Radiant two-handed, plus 2. Add 1d8 Radiant on a hit against an Undead.
fields.Activation: While gripping the hilt, use a Bonus Action to create or dismiss the blade. While it exists, use a Magic action to adjust the light.
fields.Attack bonus: +2 to attack and damage rolls.
fields.Area: Sunlight. 15 ft Bright Light plus another 15 ft Dim Light. Adjust both bands in 5 ft steps, from 10 ft to 30 ft each.
fields.Source locator: D&D 3.5 Dungeon Master’s Guide, p. 227, table 7–16.
fields.Edition notes: Uses the published 2024 radiant longsword in place of the legacy bastard-sword form.

fields.Damage: Base 1d8 Slashing. A natural 20 adds 15 Necrotic damage against a creature other than a Construct or Undead.
fields.Activation: When the attack die rolls 20 against an eligible creature.
fields.Special powers: Gain temporary HP equal to the Necrotic damage the target actually takes.
fields.Source locator: D&D 3.5 Dungeon Master’s Guide, p. 227, table 7–16.
fields.Edition notes: Retains the longsword form. The 2024 version deals Necrotic damage and grants Temporary Hit Points in place of negative levels.

fields.Damage: Base 1d8 Slashing. Add 2d6 Fire on a hit while the weapon is ablaze.
fields.Activation: While holding it, use a Bonus Action and the command word to light or extinguish it.
fields.Area: 40 ft of Bright Light and another 40 ft of Dim Light while lit.
fields.Duration: Remains lit until dismissed, dropped, stowed, or sheathed.
fields.Source locator: D&D 3.5 Dungeon Master’s Guide, p. 227, table 7–16.
fields.Edition notes: Retains the longsword form. The 2024 flames replace the legacy flaming burst enhancement and daily ray.

fields.Damage: Base 2d6 Slashing. Add 1d6 Cold on a hit.
fields.Activation: On a weapon hit. Drawing it can also extinguish nonmagical flames within 30 ft, once per hour.
fields.Special powers: Resistance to Fire damage while held.
fields.Area: In freezing temperatures, 10 ft of Bright Light and another 10 ft of Dim Light.
fields.Source locator: D&D 3.5 Dungeon Master’s Guide, p. 227, table 7–16.
fields.Edition notes: Retains the greatsword form and uses the 2024 cold damage, Fire Resistance and extinguishing rules.

fields.Damage: Base 1d8 Bludgeoning. Add 3 to normal damage. A ranged hit adds 1d8 Force, or 2d8 Force against a Giant.
fields.Activation: Make a melee or thrown weapon attack. After a throw, it returns to your hand on a hit or miss.
fields.Attunement: Required by a Dwarf or a creature attuned to a Belt of Dwarvenkind.
fields.Attack bonus: +3 to attack and damage rolls.
fields.Source locator: D&D 3.5 Dungeon Master’s Guide, p. 227, table 7–16.
fields.Edition notes: Uses the published returning Warhammer. Check the 2024 attunement eligibility and Force damage.

fields.Damage: Base 1d8 Slashing. Add 3 to normal damage, plus 2d10 Radiant on a hit against a Fiend or Undead.

fields.Attack bonus: +3 to attack and damage rolls.
fields.Area: 10 ft Emanation centered on you, increasing to 30 ft at Paladin level 17.
fields.Special powers: You and Friendly creatures in the aura have Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
fields.Source locator: D&D 3.5 Dungeon Master’s Guide, p. 227, table 7–16.
fields.Edition notes: Retains the longsword form. Uses the published 2024 enhancement, Radiant damage and Paladin aura.

fields.Damage: Base 1d10 Slashing. Add 3 to normal damage and ignore Slashing Resistance. A qualifying natural 20 can sever a head or deal an extra 30 Slashing instead.

fields.Damage: Base 1d6 Bludgeoning. The fear effect deals no damage.
fields.Activation: While holding the mace, use a Magic action and spend 1 charge.
fields.Area: Choose creatures within 30 ft of you.
fields.Saving throw: DC 15 Wisdom. Repeat at the end of each affected turn to end the effect on a success.
fields.Duration: Up to 1 minute. Frightened targets try to move away and cannot make Opportunity Attacks. Their action is limited to Dash or trying to escape restraint on movement. If they cannot move anywhere, they can Dodge.
fields.Charges: 3 charges. Regain 1d3 spent charges at dawn.
fields.Source locator: D&D 3.5 Dungeon Master’s Guide, p. 227, table 7–16.
fields.Edition notes: Uses the 2024 charge pool, fear duration and repeat saving throws.

fields.Damage: Base 1d8 Piercing. Dominate Beast deals no damage.
fields.Activation: While carrying the trident, spend 1 charge to cast Dominate Beast as an action.
fields.Spell target: One Beast with a Swim Speed that you can see within 60 ft.
fields.Special powers: On a failed save, the Beast is Charmed. On the same plane, you can give it telepathic orders on your turn without an action. Spend your own Reaction to order it to take a Reaction.
fields.Saving throw: DC 15 Wisdom. The Beast has Advantage if you or your allies are fighting it. It repeats the save whenever it takes damage, ending the spell on a success.
fields.Charges: 3 charges. Regain 1d3 spent charges at dawn.
fields.Source locator: D&D 3.5 Dungeon Master’s Guide, p. 227, table 7–16.
fields.Edition notes: Uses the published 2024 Trident and aquatic creature command rules.

fields.Damage: Base 1d6 Piercing. On a normal hit, choose Piercing or Lightning. The bolt deals 4d6 Lightning, halved on a successful save.

fields.Area: A 5 ft wide line from you to the target, excluding you.
fields.Saving throw: DC 13 Dexterity for the target and each other creature in the line.
fields.Recharge: The bolt recharges at dawn. The javelin reappears in your hand after the bolt resolves.
fields.Source locator: D&D 3.5 Dungeon Master’s Guide, p. 227, table 7–16.
fields.Edition notes: Uses the 2024 Lightning line, save and ordinary javelin attack.

fields.Damage: Base 1d8 Slashing. Add 3 to normal damage and ignore Slashing Resistance. A qualifying natural 20 can sever a head or deal an extra 30 Slashing instead.
fields.Activation: On a natural 20 when attacking a creature with at least one head. Losing the head kills a creature that needs it to survive.
fields.Attack bonus: +3 to attack and damage rolls.
fields.Exceptions: A creature immune to Slashing, one that does not need its head, or one the DM judges too large to decapitate takes the extra damage instead.
fields.Source locator: AD&D 2e DMG, table 110, section 4, roll 19.
fields.Edition notes: Uses the published Longsword version of the 2024 family. The original weapon’s critical thresholds are edition-specific.

fields.Damage: Base 1d8 Slashing. Add 1 to normal damage.
fields.Activation: While carrying it, reroll a failed D20 Test without an action if you are not Incapacitated. Use the new roll. While holding it, spend a Wish charge to cast Wish.
fields.Attack bonus: +1 to attack and damage rolls.
fields.Special powers: +1 to saving throws while the weapon is on your person.
fields.Charges: The reroll refreshes at dawn. Wish starts with 1d3 charges, is usable once per dawn, and is lost when the last charge is spent.
fields.Source locator: AD&D 2e DMG, table 110, section 3, roll 17.
fields.Edition notes: Uses the published Longsword version. Roll its 2024 Wish charges when found and use the 2024 reroll rules.

fields.Damage: Base 1d6 Bludgeoning. Add 2d6 Radiant on a hit against a Fiend or Undead.
fields.Activation: On a hit against a Fiend or Undead, check its remaining HP after damage.
fields.Saving throw: If the target has 25 HP or fewer, DC 15 Wisdom. Failure destroys it. Success leaves it Frightened until the end of your next turn.
fields.Area: While held, 20 ft Bright Light and another 20 ft Dim Light.
fields.Source locator: AD&D 2e DMG, table 110, section 2, roll 6-7.
fields.Edition notes: Uses the published 2024 Mace and its Fiend and Undead effects.

fields.Damage: 1d6 + 2 Bludgeoning one-handed or 1d8 + 2 with two hands, plus Strength modifier.
fields.Range: 5 ft melee. Spells use their published ranges.
fields.Activation: Make a Quarterstaff attack or cast a listed spell while holding the staff using the spell’s normal casting time.
fields.Attack bonus: Strength modifier + Proficiency Bonus (if proficient) + 2.
fields.Attunement: Required by a Sorcerer, Warlock, or Wizard.
fields.Special powers: While holding it, gain +2 AC, +2 to saving throws, and +2 to spell attack rolls.
fields.Spell costs: Magic Missile and Ray of Enfeeblement cost 1 each. Levitate costs 2. Cone of Cold, Hold Monster, Wall of Force, and level 5 Fireball or Lightning Bolt each cost 5. Globe of Invulnerability costs 6. Use your spell save DC.
fields.Recharge: Regain 2d8 + 4 spent charges at dawn. After spending the final charge, roll a d20. On a 1 only the +2 weapon enhancement remains. On a 20 regain 1d8 + 2 charges.
fields.Retributive Strike: Use a Magic action to break the staff, destroying it and releasing a 30-foot Emanation. You have a 50% chance to escape to a random plane. Otherwise take Force damage equal to 16 times its remaining charges. Each other creature in the area makes a DC 17 Dexterity save, taking Force damage equal to four times the remaining charges on a failure or half on a success.
fields.Source locator: AD&D 2e DMG, table 93, section 1, roll 7.
fields.Edition notes: Use the 2024 spell list, charge pool, and Retributive Strike.

fields.Damage: Base 2d6 Slashing. Add 1d6 Cold on a hit.
fields.Activation: On a weapon hit. Drawing it can also extinguish nonmagical flames within 30 ft, once per hour.
fields.Special powers: Resistance to Fire damage while held.
fields.Area: In freezing temperatures, 10 ft of Bright Light and another 10 ft of Dim Light.
fields.Source locator: AD&D 2e DMG, table 110, section 4, roll 2-3.
fields.Edition notes: Uses the published Greatsword variant for this legacy sword. The printed legacy +3 is retained in the title.

fields.Damage: Base 1d8 Slashing. Add 1 to normal damage. A Giant takes an additional 2d6 of the weapon’s damage type.
fields.Activation: Make a weapon attack. The extra damage and save apply on a hit against a Giant.
fields.Attack bonus: +1 to attack and damage rolls.
fields.Saving throw: Giant target only: DC 15 Strength or the target is Prone.
fields.Source locator: AD&D 2e DMG, table 110, section 3, roll 19.
fields.Edition notes: Uses the 2024 Longsword form of Giant Slayer. The legacy +2 appears in the title. Apply the modern +1 bonus and Giant-specific effects.

fields.Damage: Base 1d8 Bludgeoning. Add 3 to normal damage. A ranged hit adds 1d8 Force, or 2d8 Force against a Giant.
fields.Activation: Make a melee or thrown weapon attack. After a throw, it returns to your hand on a hit or miss.
fields.Attunement: Required by a Dwarf or a creature attuned to a Belt of Dwarvenkind.
fields.Attack bonus: +3 to attack and damage rolls.
fields.Source locator: AD&D 2e DMG, table 110, section 1, roll 18.
fields.Edition notes: Uses the published 2024 returning Warhammer and its attunement requirements.

fields.Damage: 1d6 Bludgeoning one-handed or 1d8 with two hands, plus Strength modifier.
fields.Range: 5 ft melee. Spells use their published ranges.
fields.Activation: Make a Quarterstaff attack or cast a listed spell while holding the staff using the spell’s normal casting time.
fields.Attack bonus: Strength modifier + Proficiency Bonus (if proficient).
fields.Attunement: Required by a Bard, Cleric, Druid, Sorcerer, Warlock, or Wizard.
fields.Spell costs: Giant Insect costs 4 charges and Insect Plague costs 5. Use your spell save DC and spell attack modifier.
fields.Insect Cloud: As a Magic action, spend 1 charge to create a 30-foot Emanation of harmless insects centered on you for up to 10 minutes. The area is Heavily Obscured for everyone except you. A strong wind ends the effect early.
fields.Recharge: Regain 1d6 + 4 spent charges at dawn. After spending the last charge, roll a d20. On a 1, the staff is destroyed.
fields.Source locator: AD&D 2e DMG, table 93, section 1, roll 15.
fields.Edition notes: Uses the 2024 spell list and rechargeable insect cloud.

fields.Damage: Base 1d4 Piercing. Add 1 to normal damage. A failed save against the coating adds 2d10 Poison damage.
fields.Activation: Use a Bonus Action to coat the dagger. The first hit against a creature expends the coating.
fields.Attack bonus: +1 to attack and damage rolls.
fields.Saving throw: DC 15 Constitution. On a failure the target also has the Poisoned condition for 1 minute.
fields.Duration: Coating lasts up to 1 minute. Recharge at the next dawn.
fields.Source locator: AD&D 2e DMG, table 110, section 1, roll 16.
fields.Edition notes: Uses the modern poison coating, save and recharge.

fields.Damage: Base 1d8 Slashing. Add 2 to normal damage.
fields.Activation: When you roll a natural 20 on an attack against a creature with fewer than 100 HP.
fields.Attack bonus: +2 to attack and damage rolls.
fields.Saving throw: DC 15 Constitution or die instantly. Constructs and Undead succeed automatically.
fields.Charges: Starts with 1d8 + 1 charges. Spend one only if the effect kills the target. The effect is lost at zero charges.
fields.Source locator: AD&D 2e DMG, table 110, section 4, roll 1.
fields.Edition notes: Uses the 2024 Longsword form and its modern save, Hit Point threshold and charges.

fields.Damage: Base 1d8 Piercing. Dominate Beast deals no damage.
fields.Activation: While carrying the trident, spend 1 charge to cast Dominate Beast as an action.
fields.Spell target: One Beast with a Swim Speed that you can see within 60 ft.
fields.Special powers: On a failed save, the Beast is Charmed. On the same plane, you can give it telepathic orders on your turn without an action. Spend your own Reaction to order it to take a Reaction.
fields.Saving throw: DC 15 Wisdom. The Beast has Advantage if you or your allies are fighting it. It repeats the save whenever it takes damage, ending the spell on a success.
fields.Charges: 3 charges. Regain 1d3 spent charges at dawn.
fields.Source locator: AD&D 2e DMG, table 110, section 2, roll 16.
fields.Edition notes: Uses the 2024 Trident and aquatic creature command rules.

fields.Damage: Base 1d8 Slashing. Add 2d6 Fire on a hit while the weapon is ablaze.
fields.Activation: While holding it, use a Bonus Action and the command word to light or extinguish it.
fields.Area: 40 ft of Bright Light and another 40 ft of Dim Light while lit.
fields.Duration: Remains lit until dismissed, dropped, stowed, or sheathed.
fields.Source locator: AD&D 2e DMG, table 110, section 3, roll 16.
fields.Edition notes: Uses the Longsword form of the 2024 family. The original printed enhancement is retained in the title.

fields.Damage: Base 1d8 Bludgeoning. Add 1 to normal weapon damage. The thunderclap inflicts Stunned on a failed save.
fields.Range: 5 ft melee; 20/60 ft on the charged throw.
fields.Activation: Spend 1 charge to make a thrown attack. The hammer returns immediately after a hit or miss.
fields.Attack bonus: +1 to attack and damage rolls.
fields.Area: On a thrown hit, the thunderclap affects the target and every creature within 30 ft of it except you. Audible out to 300 ft.
fields.Saving throw: DC 17 Constitution against the thunderclap. Failure leaves a creature Stunned until the end of your next turn.
fields.Charges: 5 charges. Regain 1d4 + 1 spent charges at dawn.
fields.Special powers: While attuned and wearing an attuned Belt of Giant Strength or Gauntlets of Ogre Power, increase the Strength that item grants by 4 (maximum 30). A natural 20 against a Giant then forces DC 17 Constitution or death.
fields.Source locator: AD&D 2e DMG, table 110, section 1, roll 19.
fields.Edition notes: Uses the 2024 Warhammer form. Follow the modern attunement prerequisites, throwing rules and charge recharge.

fields.Damage: Base 1d6 Piercing. On a normal hit, choose Piercing or Lightning. The bolt deals 4d6 Lightning, halved on a successful save.

fields.Area: A 5 ft wide line from you to the target, excluding you.
fields.Saving throw: DC 13 Dexterity for the target and each other creature in the line.
fields.Recharge: The bolt recharges at dawn. The javelin reappears in your hand after the bolt resolves.
fields.Source locator: AD&D 2e DMG, table 110, section 2, roll 2.
fields.Edition notes: Uses the 2024 line, target and recharge rules.

fields.Spear form: Use a Magic action to expose the blade. Deal 1d6 + Strength modifier + 1 Piercing, or 1d8 + Strength modifier + 1 with two hands. Reach 5 feet. Use the Spear’s Sap mastery if you have it. This bound staff is a melee weapon in either spear form.

fields.Damage: 1d6 + Strength modifier + 1 Bludgeoning, or 1d8 + Strength modifier + 1 with two hands.
fields.Range: 5 ft melee in ordinary staff form.
fields.Activation: Make a melee attack with the staff. Use a Magic action while holding it to speak the command word and change its form.
fields.Attack bonus: Strength modifier + 1 + Proficiency Bonus (if proficient).
fields.Enhancement: +1 to attack and damage rolls in every form.
fields.Source locator: AD&D 2e DMG, Quarterstaff, Magical enhancement table, d20 roll 1-5.
fields.Conversion notes: Uses the 2024 Quarterstaff baseline. The transformation action, Attunement, and attack-mode limits are tabletop conversion choices.
fields.Length change: Choose a length from 6 to 12 feet. At 12 feet the staff requires two hands to attack and has 10-foot reach. At shorter lengths use normal Quarterstaff reach and Versatile. The shaft remains as strong as steel.
